15.39.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśinī ..
unmīlinī vaṃjulī ca trispṛśā pakṣavarddhinī .. 1 ..
15.39.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
जया च विजया चैव जयंती पापनाशिनी ..
उन्मीलिनी वंजुली च त्रिस्पृशा पक्षवर्द्धिनी .. 1 ..
15.39.m: Glorious Prahlāda said: / Jayā, Vijayā, and Jayantī, destroying sin, / Unmīlinī, Vañjulī, and Trispṛśā, Pakṣavardhinī— 1

15.39.s:
puṇyaṃ sarvapurāṇānāṃ te labhaṃte dinedine ..
pakvānnaṃ ye prakurvaṃti havirddhānyasamudbhavam .. 2 ..
15.39.d:
पुण्यं सर्वपुराणानां ते लभंते दिनेदिने ..
पक्वान्नं ये प्रकुर्वंति हविर्द्धान्यसमुद्भवम् .. 2 ..
15.39.m: those who prepare cooked food made from sacrificial grain / obtain day by day the merit of all the Purāṇas. 2

15.39.s:
jāgare padmanābhasya ghṛtenaiva supācitam ..
vartidvayasamāyuktaṃ dīpaṃ ghṛtasamanvitam .. 3 ..
15.39.d:
जागरे पद्मनाभस्य घृतेनैव सुपाचितम् ..
वर्तिद्वयसमायुक्तं दीपं घृतसमन्वितम् .. 3 ..
15.39.m: He who during the vigil of the Lotus-navel [Lord offers food] well-cooked with ghee, / and a lamp furnished with two wicks and filled with ghee, 3

15.39.s:
yaḥ kuryyājjāgare viṣṇoḥ śāligrāmaśilāgrataḥ ..
śālagrāmaśilāgre tu ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram .. 4 ..
15.39.d:
यः कुर्य्याज्जागरे विष्णोः शालिग्रामशिलाग्रतः ..
शालग्रामशिलाग्रे तु ये प्रकुर्वंति जागरम् .. 4 ..
15.39.m: who offers this during the vigil of Viṣṇu before a Śāligrāma stone— / indeed, those who perform the vigil in front of a Śāligrāma stone, 4

15.39.s:
kurvaṃti nṛtyavādye ca lokānāṃ raṃjanāya ca ..
saṃchādayaṃti kusumaiḥ śāligrāmaśilāṃ ca ye .. 5 ..
15.39.d:
कुर्वंति नृत्यवाद्ये च लोकानां रंजनाय च ..
संछादयंति कुसुमैः शालिग्रामशिलां च ये .. 5 ..
15.39.m: who perform dance and instrumental music for the delight of the people, / and who cover the Śāligrāma stone with flowers, 5

15.39.s:
cakrāṃkitāṃ viśeṣeṇa pratimāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dvijāḥ ..
caṃdanaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ kṛṣṇāgurusamanvitam .. 6 ..
15.39.d:
चक्रांकितां विशेषेण प्रतिमां वैष्णवीं द्विजाः ..
चंदनं च सकर्पूरं कृष्णागुरुसमन्वितम् .. 6 ..
15.39.m: especially the image of Viṣṇu marked with a discus, O brahmins, / and who applies an unguent of sandalwood along with camphor and black agallochum, 6

15.39.s:
yuktaṃ mṛgamadenāpi yaḥ karoti vilepanam ..
dvādaśyāṃ devadevasya rātrau jāgaraṇe sadā .. 7 ..
15.39.d:
युक्तं मृगमदेनापि यः करोति विलेपनम् ..
द्वादश्यां देवदेवस्य रात्रौ जागरणे सदा .. 7 ..
15.39.m: mixed also with musk, / during the nightly vigil for the God of gods always on the twelfth day, 7

15.39.s:
tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa ca vo'grataḥ ..
tatphalaṃ koṭitīrthe tu ujjayinyāṃ mahālaye .. 8 ..
15.39.d:
तस्य पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि संक्षेपेण च वोऽग्रतः ..
तत्फलं कोटितीर्थे तु उज्जयिन्यां महालये .. 8 ..
15.39.m: I shall declare before you in brief his merit: / That fruit [is identical to that obtained] at Koṭitīrtha, in Ujjayinī, at Mahālaya, 8

15.39.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre mathurāyāṃ tripuṣkare ..
ayodhyāyāṃ prayāge ca tīrthe sāgarasaṃgame .. 9 ..
15.39.d:
वाराणस्यां कुरुक्षेत्रे मथुरायां त्रिपुष्करे ..
अयोध्यायां प्रयागे च तीर्थे सागरसंगमे .. 9 ..
15.39.m: in Vārāṇasī, in Kurukṣetra, in Mathurā, at Tripuṣkara, / in Ayodhyā, and at Prayāga, and at the sacred ford at the confluence of the ocean. 9

15.39.s:
sarvapuṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
kṛtairyajñāyutaistatra vratadānaiśca puṣkalaiḥ .. 7.4.39.10 ..
15.39.d:
सर्वपुण्येषु तीर्थेषु देवतायतनेषु च ..
कृतैर्यज्ञायुतैस्तत्र व्रतदानैश्च पुष्कलैः .. 7.4.39.10 ..
15.39.m: In all sacred tirthas and shrines of the deities, / by means of ten thousand sacrifices performed there, and abundant vows and gifts;

15.39.s:
vedairadhītairyatpuṇyaṃ purāṇaiścāvagāhitaiḥ ..
tapobhiścaritaiḥ puṇyaṃ samyagāśrama pālanaiḥ .. 11 ..
15.39.d:
वेदैरधीतैर्यत्पुण्यं पुराणैश्चावगाहितैः ..
तपोभिश्चरितैः पुण्यं सम्यगाश्रम पालनैः .. 11 ..
15.39.m: whatever merit comes from studying the Vedas and delving into the Purāṇas, / the merit from austerities practiced and the proper observance of life stages;

15.39.s:
yatphalaṃ munibhiḥ proktaṃ vedavyāsena putraka ..
tatphalaṃ jāgare viṣṇoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ .. 12 ..
15.39.d:
यत्फलं मुनिभिः प्रोक्तं वेदव्यासेन पुत्रक ..
तत्फलं जागरे विष्णोः पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः .. 12 ..
15.39.m: the fruit declared by the sages and by Vedavyāsa, O son, / that very fruit is gained by keeping vigil for Viṣṇu during both the light and dark fortnights.

15.39.s:
haimavatyai purā proktaṃ kailāse śūlapāṇinā ..
nāradāya purā proktaṃ brahmaṇā matsamīpataḥ .. 13 ..
15.39.d:
हैमवत्यै पुरा प्रोक्तं कैलासे शूलपाणिना ..
नारदाय पुरा प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मणा मत्समीपतः .. 13 ..
15.39.m: In former times it was told by the trident-bearer on Kailāsa to Haimavatī; / it was told of old to Nārada by Brahmā in my presence;

15.39.s:
aruṇena vajrahastāya kathitaṃ pṛcchate purā ..
dvādaśījāgarasyoktaṃ phalaṃ viprā mayā ca vaḥ..
tatkurudhvaṃ dvijā yūyaṃ jāgaraṃ viṣṇuvāsare .. 14 ..
15.39.d:
अरुणेन वज्रहस्ताय कथितं पृच्छते पुरा ..
द्वादशीजागरस्योक्तं फलं विप्रा मया च वः..
तत्कुरुध्वं द्विजा यूयं जागरं विष्णुवासरे .. 14 ..
15.39.m: and formerly it was narrated by Aruṇa to [Indra], wielder of the thunderbolt, who had questioned him. / Thus the fruit of keeping vigil on the twelfth lunar day has been told by me to you, O brahmins; / therefore, O twice-born, do observe the vigil on the day of Viṣṇu.

15.39.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā brāhmaṇānprāha baliṃ pautraṃ svakaṃ tataḥ ..
tvamapi śraddhayā pautra kuru jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ .. 15 ..
15.39.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणान्प्राह बलिं पौत्रं स्वकं ततः ..
त्वमपि श्रद्धया पौत्र कुरु जागरणं हरेः .. 15 ..
15.39.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus to the brahmins, he then addressed his grandson Bali: / "You too, grandson, with faith observe the night-vigil of Hari.

15.39.s:
dvārakā manasā dhyātā pāpaṃ varṣaśatānvitam ..
kīrtanācchatajanmotthaṃ dahate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 16 ..
15.39.d:
द्वारका मनसा ध्याता पापं वर्षशतान्वितम् ..
कीर्तनाच्छतजन्मोत्थं दहते नात्र संशयः .. 16 ..
15.39.m: When contemplated with the mind, Dvārakā burns away sin gathered over a hundred years; / through singing its praise, it burns [sin] born of a hundred lifetimes—there is no doubt about this.

15.39.s:
pāpaṃ janmasahasrotthaṃ padamātreṇa gacchatām ..
dvārakā harate nūnaṃ muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya darśanāt .. 17 ..
15.39.d:
पापं जन्मसहस्रोत्थं पदमात्रेण गच्छताम् ..
द्वारका हरते नूनं मुक्तिः कृष्णस्य दर्शनात् .. 17 ..
15.39.m: Sin arising from a thousand lifetimes, for those who merely step forward on foot, / Dvārakā truly takes away; liberation comes from the sight of Kṛṣṇa.

15.39.s:
na śaknoti yadā gaṃtuṃ dvārakāṃ caiva mānavaḥ ..
māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ tu dvārakāsaṃbhavaṃ gṛhe .. 18 ..
15.39.d:
न शक्नोति यदा गंतुं द्वारकां चैव मानवः ..
माहात्म्यं पठनीयं तु द्वारकासंभवं गृहे .. 18 ..
15.39.m: When a man is unable to go to Dvārakā, / the māhātmya relating to Dvārakā should certainly be recited in his house.

15.39.s:
dātavyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu śrotavyaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ ..
dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa paṭhanīyaṃ tu jāgare .. 19 ..
15.39.d:
दातव्यं वैष्णवानां तु श्रोतव्यं भक्तिभावतः ..
द्वादश्यां च विशेषेण पठनीयं तु जागरे .. 19 ..
15.39.m: It should be given to Vaiṣṇavas and heard with devoted feeling; / and it should especially be recited on the twelfth lunar day during the night-vigil.

15.39.s:
dvārakā saṃbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ sa saṃprāpnoti mānavaḥ ..
prasādādvāsudevasya satyaṃsatyaṃ ca bhāṣitam .. 7.4.39.20 ..
15.39.d:
द्वारका संभवं पुण्यं स संप्राप्नोति मानवः ..
प्रसादाद्वासुदेवस्य सत्यंसत्यं च भाषितम् .. 7.4.39.20 ..
15.39.m: That man obtains the merit that arises from Dvārakā / by the grace of Vāsudeva; this is spoken as truth upon truth.

15.39.s:
gṛhe saṃtiṣṭhate nityaṃ mathurā dvārakā tathā ..
avaṃtī ca tathā māyā prayāgaṃ kurujāṃgalam .. 21 ..
15.39.d:
गृहे संतिष्ठते नित्यं मथुरा द्वारका तथा ..
अवंती च तथा माया प्रयागं कुरुजांगलम् .. 21 ..
15.39.m: In his house there abide continually Mathurā, likewise Dvārakā, / Avantī, and also Māyā, Prayāga, and Kurujāṅgala;

15.39.s:
tripuṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ ca gaṃgādvāraṃ ca saukaram ..
caṃdreśaṃ caiva kedāraṃ tathā rudramahālayam .. 22 ..
15.39.d:
त्रिपुष्करं नैमिषं च गंगाद्वारं च सौकरम् ..
चंद्रेशं चैव केदारं तथा रुद्रमहालयम् .. 22 ..
15.39.m: Tripuṣkara, Naimiṣa, Gaṅgādvāra, and Saukara, / Candreśa, Kedāra, and Rudramahālaya;

15.39.s:
vastrāpathaṃ mahādevaṃ mahākālaṃ tathaiva ca ..
bhūteśvaraṃ bhasmagātraṃ somanāthamumāpatim.. 23 ..
15.39.d:
वस्त्रापथं महादेवं महाकालं तथैव च ..
भूतेश्वरं भस्मगात्रं सोमनाथमुमापतिम्.. 23 ..
15.39.m: Vastrāpatha, Mahādeva, Mahākāla as well, / Bhūteśvara, Bhasmagātra, Somanātha, the lord of Umā;

15.39.s:
koṭiliṃgaṃ trinetraṃ ca devaṃ bhṛguvanecaram ..
dīpeśvaraṃ mahānādaṃ devaṃ caivācaleśvaram .. 24 ..
15.39.d:
कोटिलिंगं त्रिनेत्रं च देवं भृगुवनेचरम् ..
दीपेश्वरं महानादं देवं चैवाचलेश्वरम् .. 24 ..
15.39.m: Koṭiliṅga, Trinetra, the god who ranges the Bhṛgu forest, / Dīpeśvara, Mahānāda, and the god Acaleśvara.

15.39.s:
brahmādayaḥ suragaṇā gṛhe tiṣṭhaṃti sarvadā ..
pitaro nāgagaṃdharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ .. 25 ..
15.39.d:
ब्रह्मादयः सुरगणा गृहे तिष्ठंति सर्वदा ..
पितरो नागगंधर्वा मुनयः सिद्धचारणाः .. 25 ..
15.39.m: Brahmā and the hosts of gods always reside in his house, / as do the ancestors, Nāgas, Gandharvas, sages, Siddhas, and Cāraṇas.

15.39.s:
tīrthāni yāni kāni syuraśvamedhādayo makhāḥ ..
kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ pautra yaḥ karoti viśeṣataḥ .. 26 ..
15.39.d:
तीर्थानि यानि कानि स्युरश्वमेधादयो मखाः ..
कृष्णजन्माष्टमीं पौत्र यः करोति विशेषतः .. 26 ..
15.39.m: Whatever sacred tirthas there may be, or sacrifices like the horse-sacrifice— / [all these belong to him,] O grandson, who especially observes the eighth day of Kṛṣṇa's birth.

15.39.s:
yathā bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ tathā bhāgavato naraḥ ..
ubhayoraṃtaraṃ nāsti haraharyostathaiva ca .. 27 ..
15.39.d:
यथा भागवतं शास्त्रं तथा भागवतो नरः ..
उभयोरंतरं नास्ति हरहर्योस्तथैव च .. 27 ..
15.39.m: As is the Bhāgavata scripture, so is the man who is a devotee of the Lord; / between the two there is no distinction, just as between Hara and Hari.

15.39.s:
nīlīkṣetraṃ tu yo yāti mūlakaṃ bhakṣayettu yaḥ ..
naivāsti narakoddhāraṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi .. 28 ..
15.39.d:
नीलीक्षेत्रं तु यो याति मूलकं भक्षयेत्तु यः ..
नैवास्ति नरकोद्धारं कल्पकोटिशतैरपि .. 28 ..
15.39.m: He who enters an indigo field, or he who eats a radish, / has no deliverance from hell even through hundreds of millions of eons.

15.39.s:
nīlīkarma tu yaḥ kuryyādbrāhmaṇo lobhamohitaḥ ..
nāpnoti sukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkuryyādvā rasavikrayam .. 29 ..
15.39.d:
नीलीकर्म तु यः कुर्य्याद्ब्राह्मणो लोभमोहितः ..
नाप्नोति सुकृतं किंचित्कुर्य्याद्वा रसविक्रयम् .. 29 ..
15.39.m: A brahmin deluded by greed who engages in the indigo trade, / or sells juices, does not attain any good deed.

15.39.s:
prasīdati na viśvātmā vaiṣṇave cāpamānite ..
aśvatthaṃ chedayedyo vai ekaikasmiṃśca parvaṇi .. 7.4.39.30 ..
15.39.d:
प्रसीदति न विश्वात्मा वैष्णवे चापमानिते ..
अश्वत्थं छेदयेद्यो वै एकैकस्मिंश्च पर्वणि .. 7.4.39.30 ..
15.39.m: The Soul of the Universe is never pleased when a Vaiṣṇava is insulted; / and he who cuts down an aśvattha tree on every sacred occasion

15.39.s:
manvaṃtarāṇi tāvaṃti raurave vasatirbhavet ..
ariṣṭakāṣṭhairdaityeṃdra kāryyaṃ yaḥ kurute kvacit ..
na pūjāmarghadānaṃ ca tasya gṛhṇāti bhāskaraḥ .. 31 ..
15.39.d:
मन्वंतराणि तावंति रौरवे वसतिर्भवेत् ..
अरिष्टकाष्ठैर्दैत्येंद्र कार्य्यं यः कुरुते क्वचित् ..
न पूजामर्घदानं च तस्य गृह्णाति भास्करः .. 31 ..
15.39.m: shall dwell in Raurava hell for that many manvantaras. / If anyone ever makes an object using ariṣṭa wood, O king of the Daityas, / the Sun does not accept his worship or offering of water.

15.39.s:
chedāpakasya cārke tu cchedakasya ca daityaja ..
śataṃ janmāni dāridyaṃ jāyate ca sarogatā .. 32 ..
15.39.d:
छेदापकस्य चार्के तु च्छेदकस्य च दैत्यज ..
शतं जन्मानि दारिद्यं जायते च सरोगता .. 32 ..
15.39.m: For the one who causes an arka tree to be cut, and for the one who cuts it, O born of the Daityas, / poverty and disease arise for a hundred lifetimes.

15.39.s:
ropayetpālayedyo vai sūryyavṛkṣaṃ narottamaḥ ..
saptakalpaṃ vasetso'tra samīpe bhāskarasya hi .. 33 ..
15.39.d:
रोपयेत्पालयेद्यो वै सूर्य्यवृक्षं नरोत्तमः ..
सप्तकल्पं वसेत्सोऽत्र समीपे भास्करस्य हि .. 33 ..
15.39.m: The best among men who plants and protects a sun-tree / shall dwell there near the Sun for seven eons.

15.39.s:
ropitairdevavṛkṣaistu yatphalaṃ lakṣakoṭibhiḥ ..
nyagrodhavṛkṣeṇaikena ropitena phalaṃ hi tat .. 34 ..
15.39.d:
रोपितैर्देववृक्षैस्तु यत्फलं लक्षकोटिभिः ..
न्यग्रोधवृक्षेणैकेन रोपितेन फलं हि तत् .. 34 ..
15.39.m: Whatever fruit comes from planting hundreds of thousands and millions of divine trees, / that very fruit is attained by planting a single banyan tree.

15.39.s:
dhātrīdrume'pyevameva phalaṃ bhavati ropite ..
tulasīropaṇe caiva adhikaṃ cāpi suvrata ..
amaratvaṃ ca te yāṃti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā .. 35 ..
15.39.d:
धात्रीद्रुमेऽप्येवमेव फलं भवति रोपिते ..
तुलसीरोपणे चैव अधिकं चापि सुव्रत ..
अमरत्वं च ते यांति नात्र कार्य्या विचारणा .. 35 ..
15.39.m: In the same way there is fruit when an myrobalan tree is planted; / and even greater, O one of good vows, when tulasī is planted; / and they attain immortality—no doubt should be entertained here.

15.39.s:
dvārakāṃ kalikāle tu prātarutthāya kīrtayet ..
sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ svargaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ .. 36 ..
15.39.d:
द्वारकां कलिकाले तु प्रातरुत्थाय कीर्तयेत् ..
स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गं याति न संशयः .. 36 ..
15.39.m: One who rises in the morning in the Kali age and proclaims [the name of] Dvārakā, / freed from all sins, goes to heaven—there is no doubt.

15.39.s:
rohiṇīsahitā ye na dvādaśī samupoṣitā ..
mahāpātakasaṃyuktaḥ kalpāṃte nākamāpnuyāt .. 37 ..
15.39.d:
रोहिणीसहिता ये न द्वादशी समुपोषिता ..
महापातकसंयुक्तः कल्पांते नाकमाप्नुयात् .. 37 ..
15.39.m: By whom the twelfth lunar day combined with Rohiṇī is fasted, / even if burdened with great sins, he attains heaven at the end of the eon.

15.39.s:
vāsaraḥ ko vinā sūryyaṃ vinā somena kā niśā ..
vinā vṛkṣeṇa ko grāmo dvādaśī kiṃ vrataṃ vinā .. 38 ..
15.39.d:
वासरः को विना सूर्य्यं विना सोमेन का निशा ..
विना वृक्षेण को ग्रामो द्वादशी किं व्रतं विना .. 38 ..
15.39.m: What is a day without the sun? What is a night without the moon? / What is a village without a tree? What is a twelfth lunar day without a vow?

15.39.s:
gṛhaṃ ca narakaṃ tasya yamadaṇḍaṃ dvitīyakam ..
na yatra paṭhate nityaṃ viṣṇornāmasahasrakam .. 39 ..
15.39.d:
गृहं च नरकं तस्य यमदण्डं द्वितीयकम् ..
न यत्र पठते नित्यं विष्णोर्नामसहस्रकम् .. 39 ..
15.39.m: His house is a hell and a second punishment of Yama, / where the Thousand Names of Viṣṇu are not recited daily.

15.39.s:
narakaṃ ca bhavettasya dvitīyaṃ yamaśāsanam ..
naiva bhāgavataṃ yatra purāṇaṃ gīyate kalau ..
andhakūpeṣu kṣipyaṃte jvaliteṣu hutāśane .. 7.4.39.40 ..
15.39.d:
नरकं च भवेत्तस्य द्वितीयं यमशासनम् ..
नैव भागवतं यत्र पुराणं गीयते कलौ ..
अन्धकूपेषु क्षिप्यंते ज्वलितेषु हुताशने .. 7.4.39.40 ..
15.39.m: It becomes a hell for him, a second decree of Yama, / where the Bhāgavata Purāṇa is not sung in the Kali age; / [such people] are cast into blinded wells blazing with fire.

15.39.s:
dviṣaṃti ye bhāgavataṃ na kurvaṃti dinaṃ hareḥ ..
yamadūtaiśca nīyante tathā bhūmau bhavaṃti te .. 41 ..
15.39.d:
द्विषंति ये भागवतं न कुर्वंति दिनं हरेः ..
यमदूतैश्च नीयन्ते तथा भूमौ भवंति ते .. 41 ..
15.39.m: Those who hate the Bhāgavata and do not observe the day of Hari, / are carried off by Yama's messengers, and thus they remain upon the earth [in misery].

15.39.s:
vācyamānaṃ na śṛṇvaṃti hareścaritamuttamam ..
karapatraiśca pīḍyaṃte sutīvrairyama śāsanāt.. 42 ..
15.39.d:
वाच्यमानं न शृण्वंति हरेश्चरितमुत्तमम् ..
करपत्रैश्च पीड्यंते सुतीव्रैर्यम शासनात्.. 42 ..
15.39.m: Those who do not listen to the excellent deeds of Hari being recited / are tormented with extremely sharp saws by the decree of Yama.

15.39.s:
nindāṃ kurvaṃti ye pāpā vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām ..
teṣāṃ nirayapātastu yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 43 ..
15.39.d:
निन्दां कुर्वंति ये पापा वैष्णवानां महात्मनाम् ..
तेषां निरयपातस्तु यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 43 ..
15.39.m: Those sinners who insult noble Vaiṣṇavas / suffer a fall into hell that lasts until the cosmic dissolution.

15.39.s:
gokoṭitīrthādadhikaṃ snānaṃ tatrādhikaṃ bhavet ..
ye paśyaṃti mahāpuṇyā gopīcaṃdanamṛttikām..
gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 44 ..
15.39.d:
गोकोटितीर्थादधिकं स्नानं तत्राधिकं भवेत् ..
ये पश्यंति महापुण्या गोपीचंदनमृत्तिकाम्..
गंगास्नानफलं तेषां जायते नात्र संशयः .. 44 ..
15.39.m: The ablution there becomes greater than at a sacred ford of ten million cows; / those highly meritorious people who see the gopīcandana clay— / for them the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā arises, there is no doubt.

15.39.s:
vaiṣṇavānāṃ prayacchaṃti gopīcaṃ danamṛttikām ..
yeṣāṃ lalāṭe tilakaḥ gopīcaṃdanasaṃbhavam.. 45 ..
15.39.d:
वैष्णवानां प्रयच्छंति गोपीचं दनमृत्तिकाम् ..
येषां ललाटे तिलकः गोपीचंदनसंभवम्.. 45 ..
15.39.m: They give gopīcandana clay to Vaiṣṇavas; / those on whose forehead is the tilaka made of gopīcandana,

15.39.s:
gopīcaṃdanapuṃḍreṇa dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte ..
viṣṇornāmasahasrasya pāṭhena muktimāpnuyāt .. 46 ..
15.39.d:
गोपीचंदनपुंड्रेण द्वादश्यां जागरे कृते ..
विष्णोर्नामसहस्रस्य पाठेन मुक्तिमाप्नुयात् .. 46 ..
15.39.m: having applied the vertical mark with gopīcandana and kept vigil on the twelfth lunar day, / attain liberation through reciting the Thousand Names of Viṣṇu.

15.39.s:
ye nityaṃ prātarutthāya vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu kīrtanam..
gomatīsmaraṇaṃ kuryuḥ kṛṣṇatulyā na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
15.39.d:
ये नित्यं प्रातरुत्थाय वैष्णवानां तु कीर्तनम्..
गोमतीस्मरणं कुर्युः कृष्णतुल्या न संशयः .. 47 ..
15.39.m: Those who, rising daily in the morning, praise the Vaiṣṇavas / and remember the Gomatī, are equal to Kṛṣṇa—there is no doubt.

15.39.s:
ye nityaṃ prātarutthāya dvāraketi vadaṃti ca ..
tīrthakoṭibhavaṃ puṇyaṃ labhaṃte ca dinedine .. 48 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśīvratādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 39 ..
15.39.d:
ये नित्यं प्रातरुत्थाय द्वारकेति वदंति च ..
तीर्थकोटिभवं पुण्यं लभंते च दिनेदिने .. 48 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वादशीव्रतादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 39 ..
15.39.m:
Those who, rising daily in the morning, say "Dvārakā", / obtain day by day the merit arising from ten million sacred fords.
Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of the Twelfth Lunar Day Vow and Other Rites," in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

15.40.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
svanāmāṃkita patraistu śrīpatiṃ yo'rcayeta vai ..
saptalokānanuprāpya saptadvīpādhipo bhavet.. 1 ..
15.40.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
स्वनामांकित पत्रैस्तु श्रीपतिं योऽर्चयेत वै ..
सप्तलोकाननुप्राप्य सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत्.. 1 ..
15.40.m: Śrī Prahlāda said: / One who worships the Lord of Śrī with leaves marked with his own name, / having attained the seven worlds, becomes the lord of the seven continents.

15.40.s:
mākāntavṛkṣapatraistu yo'rcayeta sadā harim ..
puṇyaṃ bhavati tasyeha vājimedhāyutaṃ kalau .. 2 ..
15.40.d:
माकान्तवृक्षपत्रैस्तु योऽर्चयेत सदा हरिम् ..
पुण्यं भवति तस्येह वाजिमेधायुतं कलौ .. 2 ..
15.40.m: One who always worships Hari with the leaves of the mākānta tree / gains the merit in this Kali age of ten thousand horse sacrifices.

15.40.s:
lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ devīṃ sāvitrīṃ caṃḍikāṃ tathā ..
pūjayitvā divaṃ yāti patraiḥ śrīvṛkṣasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 3 ..
15.40.d:
लक्ष्मीं सरस्वतीं देवीं सावित्रीं चंडिकां तथा ..
पूजयित्वा दिवं याति पत्रैः श्रीवृक्षसंभवैः .. 3 ..
15.40.m: Having worshipped Lakṣmī, the goddess Sarasvatī, Sāvitrī, and Caṇḍikā / with leaves produced from the bilva tree, he goes to heaven.

15.40.s:
tulasyā adhikaṃ proktaṃ dalaṃ śrīvṛkṣasaṃbhavam..
tasmānnityaṃ prayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadā'cyutaḥ .. 4 ..
15.40.d:
तुलस्या अधिकं प्रोक्तं दलं श्रीवृक्षसंभवम्..
तस्मान्नित्यं प्रयत्नेन पूजनीयः सदाऽच्युतः .. 4 ..
15.40.m: A leaf produced from the bilva tree is declared superior to tulasī; / therefore, Acyuta should always be worshipped with effort.

15.40.s:
dvādaśyāṃ ravivāreṇa śrīvṛkṣamarcayanti ye ..
brahmahatyādikaiḥ pāpairna lipyaṃte kṛtairapi .. 5 ..
15.40.d:
द्वादश्यां रविवारेण श्रीवृक्षमर्चयन्ति ये ..
ब्रह्महत्यादिकैः पापैर्न लिप्यंते कृतैरपि .. 5 ..
15.40.m: Those who worship the bilva tree on a Dvādaśī that falls on a Sunday / are not tainted even by sins committed such as the killing of a brahmin.

15.40.s:
yathā karipade'nyāni praviśaṃti padāni ca ..
tathā sarvāṇi puṇyāni praviṣṭāni harerdine .. 6 ..
15.40.d:
यथा करिपदेऽन्यानि प्रविशंति पदानि च ..
तथा सर्वाणि पुण्यानि प्रविष्टानि हरेर्दिने .. 6 ..
15.40.m: Just as other footprints enter into an elephant's footprint, / so all merits are entered into Hari's day.

15.40.s:
adhruveṇaiva dehena pratikṣa ṇavināśinā ..
kathaṃ nopāsate jaṃturdvādaśīṃ jāgarānvitām .. 7 ..
15.40.d:
अध्रुवेणैव देहेन प्रतिक्ष णविनाशिना ..
कथं नोपासते जंतुर्द्वादशीं जागरान्विताम् .. 7 ..
15.40.m: With an impermanent body that is destroyed at every moment, / why does a living being not observe the Dvādaśī accompanied by a vigil?

15.40.s:
atītānpuruṣānsapta bhaviṣyāṃśca caturddaśa ..
narakāttārayetsarvām̐llokānkṛṣṇeti kīrtanāt ..
na te jīvaṃti loke'sminyatratatra sthitā narāḥ .. 8 ..
15.40.d:
अतीतान्पुरुषान्सप्त भविष्यांश्च चतुर्द्दश ..
नरकात्तारयेत्सर्वाम्̐ल्लोकान्कृष्णेति कीर्तनात् ..
न ते जीवंति लोकेऽस्मिन्यत्रतत्र स्थिता नराः .. 8 ..
15.40.m: From chanting 'Kṛṣṇa', one delivers all people from hell— / seven ancestors and fourteen descendants. / Men residing anywhere do not truly live in this world [without it].

15.40.s:
dvārakāyāṃ ca saṃprāptāstriṣu lokeṣu vaṃditāḥ..
dvārakāyāṃ prakurvaṃti yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ sthitim ..
grāsegrāse makhaśataṃ te labhaṃte phalaṃ narāḥ ..9 ..
15.40.d:
द्वारकायां च संप्राप्तास्त्रिषु लोकेषु वंदिताः..
द्वारकायां प्रकुर्वंति यतीनां भोजनं स्थितिम् ..
ग्रासेग्रासे मखशतं ते लभंते फलं नराः ..9 ..
15.40.m: And when they reach Dvārakā, they are praised in the three worlds. / Men who provide food and lodging for ascetics in Dvārakā / obtain the reward of a hundred sacrifices at every mouthful.

15.40.s:
yatīnāṃ ye prayacchaṃti kaupīnācchādanādikam ..
vasatāṃ dvārakāmadhye yathāśaktyā tu bhojanam ..
śṛṇu puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsena hi daityaja .. 7.4.40.10 ..
15.40.d:
यतीनां ये प्रयच्छंति कौपीनाच्छादनादिकम् ..
वसतां द्वारकामध्ये यथाशक्त्या तु भोजनम् ..
शृणु पुण्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन हि दैत्यज .. 7.4.40.10 ..
15.40.m: Those who give loincloths, garments, and the like to ascetics, / and food according to their capacity to those living within Dvārakā— / hear, O son of Daitya, I shall declare the merit in brief.

15.40.s:
koṭibhirvedavidvadbhirgayāyāṃ pitṛvatsalaiḥ ..
bhojitairyatsamāpnoti tatphalaṃ daityanāyaka .. 11 ..
15.40.d:
कोटिभिर्वेदविद्वद्भिर्गयायां पितृवत्सलैः ..
भोजितैर्यत्समाप्नोति तत्फलं दैत्यनायक .. 11 ..
15.40.m: The reward that one attains at Gayā by feeding crores of brahmins / learned in the Veda and loving to their ancestors, O leader of the Daityas,

15.40.s:
ekasminbhojite pautra bhikṣuke phalamīdṛśam..
dātavyaṃ bhikṣuke cānnaṃ kuryyādvai cātmavikrayam .. 12 ..
15.40.d:
एकस्मिन्भोजिते पौत्र भिक्षुके फलमीदृशम्..
दातव्यं भिक्षुके चान्नं कुर्य्याद्वै चात्मविक्रयम् .. 12 ..
15.40.m: such a reward is obtained, O grandson, when a single mendicant is fed. / Food should be given to a mendicant, even if one must sell oneself.

15.40.s:
dhanyāste yatayaḥ sarve ye vasaṃti kalau yuge ..
kṛṣṇamāśritya daityendra dvārakāyāṃ dinedine .. 13 ..
15.40.d:
धन्यास्ते यतयः सर्वे ये वसंति कलौ युगे ..
कृष्णमाश्रित्य दैत्येन्द्र द्वारकायां दिनेदिने .. 13 ..
15.40.m: Fortunate are all those ascetics who dwell in the Kali age, / having taken refuge in Kṛṣṇa in Dvārakā day after day, O lord of Daityas.

15.40.s:
prāṇino ye mṛtāḥ keciddvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ..
pāpinastatpadaṃ yāṃti bhittvā sūryasya maṃḍalam .. 14 ..
15.40.d:
प्राणिनो ये मृताः केचिद्द्वारकां कृष्णसन्निधौ ..
पापिनस्तत्पदं यांति भित्त्वा सूर्यस्य मंडलम् .. 14 ..
15.40.m: Whatever living creatures die in Dvārakā in the presence of Kṛṣṇa, / even though sinners, piercing the orb of the sun, go to that abode.

15.40.s:
dvārakācakratīrthe ye nivasaṃti narottamāḥ ..
teṣāṃ nivāritāḥ sarve yamena yamakiṃkarāḥ .. 15 ..
15.40.d:
द्वारकाचक्रतीर्थे ये निवसंति नरोत्तमाः ..
तेषां निवारिताः सर्वे यमेन यमकिंकराः .. 15 ..
15.40.m: The best among men who reside at the Cakratīrtha of Dvārakā— / for them, all the servants of Yama have been turned away by Yama.

15.40.s:
snātvā paśyaṃti gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham ..
na teṣāṃ viṣaye yūyaṃ na cāsmadviṣaye tu te .. 16 ..
15.40.d:
स्नात्वा पश्यंति गोमत्यां कृष्णं कलिमलापहम् ..
न तेषां विषये यूयं न चास्मद्विषये तु ते .. 16 ..
15.40.m: Having bathed in the Gomatī, they behold Kṛṣṇa, who removes the impurities of the Kali age. / 'You have no authority over them, nor do they belong in our domain.'

15.40.s:
api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā vṛkṣā vā ye tadāśritāḥ ..
yāṃti te kṛṣṇasadanaṃ saṃsāre na punarhiṃ te .. 17 ..
15.40.d:
अपि कीटः पतंगो वा वृक्षा वा ये तदाश्रिताः ..
यांति ते कृष्णसदनं संसारे न पुनर्हिं ते .. 17 ..
15.40.m: Even a worm or an insect or trees that have taken refuge there, / they go to Kṛṣṇa's abode; they never again enter into saṃsāra.

15.40.s:
kiṃ punardvijavaryyāśca kṣatriyāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
trivarṇapūjāsaṃyuktāḥ śūdrāstatra nivāsinaḥ .. 18 ..
15.40.d:
किं पुनर्द्विजवर्य्याश्च क्षत्रियाश्च विशेषतः ..
त्रिवर्णपूजासंयुक्ताः शूद्रास्तत्र निवासिनः .. 18 ..
15.40.m: How much more so the best of the twice-born, and especially the kṣatriyas, / and the śūdras dwelling there engaged in serving the three classes!

15.40.s:
gītāṃ paṭhaṃti kṛṣṇāgre kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ dvijāḥ ..
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca .. 19 ..
15.40.d:
गीतां पठंति कृष्णाग्रे कार्तिकं सकलं द्विजाः ..
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च .. 19 ..
15.40.m: The twice-born who recite the Gītā before Kṛṣṇa throughout the entire month of Kārtika, / by eating once a day, eating at night, or eating unasked food,

15.40.s:
trirātreṇāpi kṛcchreṇa tathā cāndrāyaṇena ca ..
yāvakaistaptakṛcchrādyaiḥ pakṣamāsamupoṣaṇaiḥ .. 7.4.40.20 ..
15.40.d:
त्रिरात्रेणापि कृच्छ्रेण तथा चान्द्रायणेन च ..
यावकैस्तप्तकृच्छ्राद्यैः पक्षमासमुपोषणैः .. 7.4.40.20 ..
15.40.m: by a three-night fast, a kṛcchra penance, and a cāndrāyaṇa penance, / by barley meals, the taptakṛcchra, and other penances, and by fasting for a fortnight or a month,

15.40.s:
kṣapayaṃti ca ye māsaṃ kārtikaṃ vratacāriṇaḥ ..
snātvā vai gomatīnīre tathā vai rukmiṇīhrade .. 21 ..
15.40.d:
क्षपयंति च ये मासं कार्तिकं व्रतचारिणः ..
स्नात्वा वै गोमतीनीरे तथा वै रुक्मिणीह्रदे .. 21 ..
15.40.m: and those practicing vows who spend the month of Kārtika, / having bathed in the water of the Gomatī and also in the Rukmiṇī pool,

15.40.s:
śaṃkhacakragadā hastāḥ kṛṣṇarūpā bhavaṃti te ..
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ daśamīsaṃgavarjitām .. 22 ..
15.40.d:
शंखचक्रगदा हस्ताः कृष्णरूपा भवंति ते ..
उपोष्यैकादशीं शुद्धां दशमीसंगवर्जिताम् .. 22 ..
15.40.m: they become forms of Kṛṣṇa, with conch, discus, and mace in hand. / Having fasted on the pure Ekādaśī, free from contact with Daśamī,

15.40.s:
śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃti dvādaśyāṃ cakratīrthe ca nirmale ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca madhupāyasasarpiṣā .. 23 ..
15.40.d:
श्राद्धं कुर्वंति द्वादश्यां चक्रतीर्थे च निर्मले ..
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा च मधुपायससर्पिषा .. 23 ..
15.40.m: they perform a śrāddha on Dvādaśī at the spotless Cakratīrtha, / and having fed brahmins with honey, milk-rice, and ghee,

15.40.s:
saṃtarpya vidhivadbhaktyā śaktyā dattvā tu dakṣiṇām ..
gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi tāṃbūlaṃ ca phalāni ca .. 24 ..
15.40.d:
संतर्प्य विधिवद्भक्त्या शक्त्या दत्त्वा तु दक्षिणाम् ..
गोभूहिरण्यवासांसि तांबूलं च फलानि च .. 24 ..
15.40.m: having gratified them duly with devotion and given a dakṣiṇā according to their means, / [namely] cows, land, gold, garments, betel, and fruits,

15.40.s:
upānahau cchatrasumaṃ jalapūrṇā ghaṭāstathā ..
pakvānnasaṃyutāḥ śubhrāḥ saphalā dakṣiṇānvitāḥ.. 25 ..
15.40.d:
उपानहौ च्छत्रसुमं जलपूर्णा घटास्तथा ..
पक्वान्नसंयुताः शुभ्राः सफला दक्षिणान्विताः.. 25 ..
15.40.m: shoes, an umbrella, flowers, and jars filled with water, / bright, accompanied by cooked food, with fruits, and accompanied by a dakṣiṇā—

15.40.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyakkṛṣṇamuddiśya kārtike ..
mārkaṃḍeya samā prītiḥ pitṝṇāṃ jāyate dhruvam .. 26 ..
15.40.d:
एवं यः कुरुते सम्यक्कृष्णमुद्दिश्य कार्तिके ..
मार्कंडेय समा प्रीतिः पितॄणां जायते ध्रुवम् .. 26 ..
15.40.m: one who performs this properly dedicated to Kṛṣṇa in Kārtika, / O Mārkaṇḍeya, an equal pleasure surely arises for his ancestors,

15.40.s: kṛṣṇasya tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ tuṣṭirbhavati cākṣayā .. 27 ..
15.40.d: कृष्णस्य त्रिदशैः सार्द्धं तुष्टिर्भवति चाक्षया .. 27 ..
15.40.m: and imperishable satisfaction arises for Kṛṣṇa together with the gods.

15.40.s:
ye kārtike puṇyatamā manuṣyāstiṣṭhaṃti māsaṃ vratadānayuktāḥ ..
rathāṃgatīrthe kṛtapūtagātrāste yāṃti puṇyaṃ padamavyayaṃ ca .. 28 ..
15.40.d:
ये कार्तिके पुण्यतमा मनुष्यास्तिष्ठंति मासं व्रतदानयुक्ताः ..
रथांगतीर्थे कृतपूतगात्रास्ते यांति पुण्यं पदमव्ययं च .. 28 ..
15.40.m: Those most virtuous men who stay for a month in Kārtika engaged in vows and gifts, / their bodies purified at the Rathāṅgatīrtha, go to the auspicious and imperishable realm.

15.40.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kārtike cakratīrthasnānadānaśrāddhādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 40 ..
15.40.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये कार्तिके चक्रतीर्थस्नानदानश्राद्धादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः.. 40 ..
15.40.m: Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bathing, Giving, and Śrāddha at Cakratīrtha in Kārtika', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

15.41.s:
.. śrīprahlāda uvāca .. ..
dhanyāstu naralokāste gomatyāṃ tu kṛtodakāḥ ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ ketakītulasīdalaiḥ .. 1 ..
15.41.d:
.. श्रीप्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
धन्यास्तु नरलोकास्ते गोमत्यां तु कृतोदकाः ..
पूजयिष्यंति ये कृष्णं केतकीतुलसीदलैः .. 1 ..
15.41.m: Śrī Prahlāda said: / Fortunate are those mortals who have offered libations in the Gomatī / and who worship Kṛṣṇa with ketakī flowers and tulasī leaves.

15.41.s:
na teṣāṃ saṃbhavo'stīha ghorasaṃsā ragahvare ..
teṣāṃ mṛtyuḥ punarnāsti hyamaratvaṃ hi te gatāḥ .. 2 ..
15.41.d:
न तेषां संभवोऽस्तीह घोरसंसा रगह्वरे ..
तेषां मृत्युः पुनर्नास्ति ह्यमरत्वं हि ते गताः .. 2 ..
15.41.m: There is no rebirth for them here in the terrible abyss of saṃsāra; / there is no death for them again, for they have attained immortality.

15.41.s:
anyatra vai yatīnāṃ tu koṭīnāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet ..
dvārakāyāṃ tu caikena bhojitena tato'dhikam .. 3 ..
15.41.d:
अन्यत्र वै यतीनां तु कोटीनां यत्फलं भवेत् ..
द्वारकायां तु चैकेन भोजितेन ततोऽधिकम् .. 3 ..
15.41.m: Whatever reward there may be elsewhere from feeding crores of ascetics, / that and more is gained in Dvārakā by feeding just one.

15.41.s:
atītaṃ varttamānaṃ ca bhaviṣyadyacca pātakam ..
nirddahennāsti saṃdeho dvārakā manasā smṛtā .. 4 ..
15.41.d:
अतीतं वर्त्तमानं च भविष्यद्यच्च पातकम् ..
निर्द्दहेन्नास्ति संदेहो द्वारका मनसा स्मृता .. 4 ..
15.41.m: Dvārakā, when remembered with the mind, burns away sin— / past, present, and future; of this there is no doubt.

15.41.s:
jñātvā kaliyuge ghore hāhābhūtamacetanam..
dvārakāṃ ye na muñcanti kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ .. 5 ..
15.41.d:
ज्ञात्वा कलियुगे घोरे हाहाभूतमचेतनम्..
द्वारकां ये न मुञ्चन्ति कृतार्थास्ते नरोत्तमाः .. 5 ..
15.41.m: Knowing that in the terrible Kali age the world has become lifeless and filled with lamentation, / those best of men who do not leave Dvārakā have attained their life's purpose.

15.41.s: mṛtānāṃ yatra jaṃtūnāṃ śvetadvīpe sthitiḥ sadā .. 6 ..
15.41.d: मृतानां यत्र जंतूनां श्वेतद्वीपे स्थितिः सदा .. 6 ..
15.41.m: For creatures who die there, residence is always in Śvetadvīpa.

15.41.s:
agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāśca ye ..
ekaviṃśatiḥ pitṛgaṇā dvārakāyāṃ vasaṃti te.. 7 ..
15.41.d:
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषद आज्यपाः सोमपाश्च ये ..
एकविंशतिः पितृगणा द्वारकायां वसंति ते.. 7 ..
15.41.m: The Agniṣvāttas, Barhiṣads, Ājyapas, and Somapas— / the twenty-one classes of ancestors, they dwell in Dvārakā.

15.41.s:
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā ..
kurukṣetrādi kṣetrāṇi kāśyādīnyūṣarāṇi ca .. 8 ..
15.41.d:
पुष्करादीनि तीर्थानि गंगाद्याः सरितस्तथा ..
कुरुक्षेत्रादि क्षेत्राणि काश्यादीन्यूषराणि च .. 8 ..
15.41.m: Tīrthas such as Puṣkara, rivers such as the Gaṅgā, / sacred fields such as Kurukṣetra, and saline grounds such as Kāśī,

15.41.s:
gayādipitṛtīrthāni prabhāsādyāni yāni ca ..
sthānāni yāni puṇyāni grāmāśca nivasaṃti vai .. 9 ..
15.41.d:
गयादिपितृतीर्थानि प्रभासाद्यानि यानि च ..
स्थानानि यानि पुण्यानि ग्रामाश्च निवसंति वै .. 9 ..
15.41.m: ancestral tīrthas such as Gayā, and whatever ones such as Prabhāsa, / and whatever sacred places and villages exist, they indeed dwell [there].

15.41.s:
kāśyādipuryo yā nityaṃ nivasaṃti kalau yuge ..
nityaṃ kṛṣṇasya sadane pāpināṃ muktide sadā .. 7.4.41.10 ..
15.41.d:
काश्यादिपुर्यो या नित्यं निवसंति कलौ युगे ..
नित्यं कृष्णस्य सदने पापिनां मुक्तिदे सदा .. 7.4.41.10 ..
15.41.m: The cities such as Kāśī that continually dwell in the Kali age, / constantly reside in the abode of Kṛṣṇa, which always grants liberation to sinners.

15.41.s:
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ prabodhinyāṃ śeṣataḥ ..
vaiśākhyāṃ daityaśārdūla kalpādiṣu yugādiṣu .. 11 ..
15.41.d:
वैशाखशुक्लद्वादश्यां प्रबोधिन्यां शेषतः ..
वैशाख्यां दैत्यशार्दूल कल्पादिषु युगादिषु .. 11 ..
15.41.m: Especially on the bright Dvādaśī of Vaiśākha, on the Prabodhinī, / on the full moon of Vaiśākha, O tiger among Daityas, on the beginnings of kalpas and yugas,

15.41.s:
caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu manvādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ ..
vyatīpāteṣu saṃkrāṃtau vaidhṛtau daityanāyaka .. 12 ..
15.41.d:
चंद्रसूर्योपरागेषु मन्वादिषु न संशयः ..
व्यतीपातेषु संक्रांतौ वैधृतौ दैत्यनायक .. 12 ..
15.41.m: during eclipses of the moon and sun, and on the beginnings of manvantaras—without a doubt— / on Vyatīpātas, at a saṃkrānti, and on Vaidhṛti, O lord of the Daityas,

15.41.s:
tilodakaṃ ca yaddatta tatsthale pitṛbhaktitaḥ ..
tatsarvamakṣayaṃ proktaṃ gomatyāṃ snānapūrvakam ..13 ..
15.41.d:
तिलोदकं च यद्दत्त तत्स्थले पितृभक्तितः ..
तत्सर्वमक्षयं प्रोक्तं गोमत्यां स्नानपूर्वकम् ..13 ..
15.41.m: whatever water with sesame seeds is offered in that place out of devotion to ancestors / preceded by a bath in the Gomatī, all of that is declared to be imperishable.

15.41.s:
ye'tra śrāddhaṃ prakurvaṃti piṃḍadānapuraḥsaram ..
teṣāmatrākṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāmupajāyate .. 14 ..
15.41.d:
येऽत्र श्राद्धं प्रकुर्वंति पिंडदानपुरःसरम् ..
तेषामत्राक्षया तृप्तिः पितॄणामुपजायते .. 14 ..
15.41.m: For those who perform a śrāddha here preceded by offering balls of rice, / everlasting satisfaction of their ancestors arises here.

15.41.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturtha dvārakāmāhātmye gomatīsnāna kṛṣṇapūjana yatibhojana dāna śrāddhādisatphalavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 41 ..
15.41.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थ द्वारकामाहात्म्ये गोमतीस्नान कृष्णपूजन यतिभोजन दान श्राद्धादिसत्फलवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 41 ..
15.41.m: Thus ends the forty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Virtuous Fruits of Bathing in the Gomatī, Worshiping Kṛṣṇa, Feeding Ascetics, Giving Gifts, Śrāddha, and the Like', in the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

15.42.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
vṛṣotsargaṃ kariṣyaṃti vaiśākhyāṃ caiva kārtike ..
dvārakāyāṃ piśācatvaṃ muktvā yāṃti pitāmahāḥ .. 1 ..
15.42.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
वृषोत्सर्गं करिष्यंति वैशाख्यां चैव कार्तिके ..
द्वारकायां पिशाचत्वं मुक्त्वा यांति पितामहाः .. 1 ..
15.42.m: Prahlāda said: / Those who perform the release of a bull in Dvārakā on the full moon of Vaiśākha and in Kārtika, / their ancestors are freed from ghosthood and depart [to heaven].

15.42.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ ..
evaṃvidhāni pāpāni kṛtvā caiva gurūṇyapi.. 2 ..
15.42.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वंगनागमः ..
एवंविधानि पापानि कृत्वा चैव गुरूण्यपि.. 2 ..
15.42.m: Even having committed such heavy sins / as murdering a brahmin, drinking liquor, theft, and union with the guru's wife,

15.42.s:
snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca darśanāt ..
vilayaṃ yāti daityendra kalpakoṭikṛtānyapi .. 3 ..
15.42.d:
स्नानमात्रेण गोमत्यां श्रीकृष्णस्य च दर्शनात् ..
विलयं याति दैत्येन्द्र कल्पकोटिकृतान्यपि .. 3 ..
15.42.m: by merely bathing in the Gomatī and seeing the glorious Kṛṣṇa, / O lord of Daityas, even those [sins] committed over ten million kalpas dissolve away.

15.42.s:
rukmiṇīṃ ye prapaśyaṃti bhaktiyuktāḥ kalau narāḥ ..
purīṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā japtvā nāmasahasrakam .. 4 ..
15.42.d:
रुक्मिणीं ये प्रपश्यंति भक्तियुक्ताः कलौ नराः ..
पुरीं प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा जप्त्वा नामसहस्रकम् .. 4 ..
15.42.m: Those men in the Kali age who, endowed with devotion, look upon Rukmiṇī, / circumambulate the city, and recite the Thousand Names,

15.42.s:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
mahādānaistu cānyatra yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam..
dvārakāyāṃ tu rukmiṇyāṃ dṛṣṭāyāṃ jāyate tadā .. 5 ..
15.42.d:
प्रदक्षिणीकृतं सर्वं ब्रह्मांडं नात्र संशयः ..
महादानैस्तु चान्यत्र यत्फलं परिकीर्तितम्..
द्वारकायां तु रुक्मिण्यां दृष्टायां जायते तदा .. 5 ..
15.42.m: have circumambulated the entire universe, no doubt about it. / The fruit that is proclaimed for great gifts elsewhere, / that arises then upon seeing Rukmiṇī in Dvārakā.

15.42.s:
dvādaśīvāsare prāpte māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
paṭhate saṃnidhau viṣṇoḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tatphalam .. 6 ..
15.42.d:
द्वादशीवासरे प्राप्ते माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
पठते संनिधौ विष्णोः शृणु वक्ष्यामि तत्फलम् .. 6 ..
15.42.m: When the day of Dvādaśī has arrived, / hear, I shall speak of the fruit for one who reads the Dvārakā māhātmya in the presence of Viṣṇu.

15.42.s:
sarveṣu caiva lokeṣu kāmacārī virājate ..
padmavarṇena yānena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā .. 7 ..
15.42.d:
सर्वेषु चैव लोकेषु कामचारी विराजते ..
पद्मवर्णेन यानेन किंकिणीजालमालिना .. 7 ..
15.42.m: Moving at will, he shines in all the worlds, / mounted on a lotus-colored vehicle adorned with a network of tinkling bells,

15.42.s:
divyaśvetāśvayuktena kāmagena yathāsukham ..
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatkrīḍate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ .. 8 ..
15.42.d:
दिव्यश्वेताश्वयुक्तेन कामगेन यथासुखम् ..
आभूतसंप्लवं यावत्क्रीडतेऽप्सरसां गणैः .. 8 ..
15.42.m: yoked with divine white horses, moving at will, comfortably as he pleases; / he sports with multitudes of apsarases until the dissolution of beings.

15.42.s:
kṛtakṛtyaśca bhavati kalpakoṭisamanvitaḥ ..
yathā nirmathanādagniḥ sarvakāṣṭheṣu dṛśyate ..
tathā ca dṛśyate dharmo dvādaśīsevanānnare ..9..
15.42.d:
कृतकृत्यश्च भवति कल्पकोटिसमन्वितः ..
यथा निर्मथनादग्निः सर्वकाष्ठेषु दृश्यते ..
तथा च दृश्यते धर्मो द्वादशीसेवनान्नरे ..9..
15.42.m: And he becomes fulfilled in purpose, accompanied by tens of millions of kalpas. / Just as fire is seen in all pieces of wood by churning, / so is dharma seen in a man through honoring the Dvādaśī.

15.42.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pitṛbhiḥ parikīrtitam ..
api syātsa kule'smākaṃ gomatyāṃ śraddhayā naraḥ ..
snātvā saṃpūjya kṛṣṇaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ kuryātsapiṇḍakam .. 7.4.42.10..
15.42.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि पितृभिः परिकीर्तितम् ..
अपि स्यात्स कुलेऽस्माकं गोमत्यां श्रद्धया नरः ..
स्नात्वा संपूज्य कृष्णं च श्राद्धं कुर्यात्सपिण्डकम् .. 7.4.42.10..
15.42.m: Hereafter I shall proclaim what is declared by the ancestors: / 'May there be a man in our family who, with faith, / having bathed in the Gomatī and worshiped Kṛṣṇa, performs a śrāddha with rice balls!

15.42.s:
api syātsa kule'smākaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ..
snātvā paśyati yaḥ kṛṣṇamasmākaṃ tāraṇāya vai .. 11 ..
15.42.d:
अपि स्यात्स कुलेऽस्माकं गोमत्युदधिसंगमे ..
स्नात्वा पश्यति यः कृष्णमस्माकं तारणाय वै .. 11 ..
15.42.m: May there be someone in our family who, having bathed at the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean, / beholds Kṛṣṇa for our deliverance!

15.42.s:
apisyātsa kula'smākaṃ yaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇānanāt ..
dvārakāmāhātmyamidaṃ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ .. 12 ..
15.42.d:
अपिस्यात्स कुलऽस्माकं यः श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणाननात् ..
द्वारकामाहात्म्यमिदं पूजयिष्यति भक्तितः .. 12 ..
15.42.m: May there be someone in our family who, having heard this Dvārakāmāhātmya / from the mouth of a brahmin, will worship it with devotion!

15.42.s:
bhaviṣyati kule'smākaṃ yo gaccheddvārakāṃ purīm ..
saṃprāpya dvādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati jāgaram .. 13 ..
15.42.d:
भविष्यति कुलेऽस्माकं यो गच्छेद्द्वारकां पुरीम् ..
संप्राप्य द्वादशीं शुद्धां यः करिष्यति जागरम् .. 13 ..
15.42.m: May there be someone in our family who goes to the city of Dvārakā, / and having reached the pure Dvādaśī, keeps a night-vigil!

15.42.s:
bhaviṣyati kule'smākaṃ putro vā duhitā tathā ..
stuvannāmasahasraṃ tu kṛṣṇasyāgre paṭhiṣyati .. 14 ..
15.42.d:
भविष्यति कुलेऽस्माकं पुत्रो वा दुहिता तथा ..
स्तुवन्नामसहस्रं तु कृष्णस्याग्रे पठिष्यति .. 14 ..
15.42.m: May there be a son or daughter in our family / who, praising, will recite the Thousand Names before Kṛṣṇa!

15.42.s:
api syātsa kule'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati dhṛtavrataḥ ..
gopīcandanadānena yastoṣayati vaiṣṇavān.. .. 15 ..
15.42.d:
अपि स्यात्स कुलेऽस्माकं भविष्यति धृतव्रतः ..
गोपीचन्दनदानेन यस्तोषयति वैष्णवान्.. .. 15 ..
15.42.m: May there be someone in our family, firm in his vow, / who pleases the Vaiṣṇavas with the gift of white clay [gopīcandana]!

15.42.s:
api syātsa kule'smākaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu sannidhau ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ paṭhiṣyati jitendriyaḥ .. 16 ..
15.42.d:
अपि स्यात्स कुलेऽस्माकं वैष्णवानां तु सन्निधौ ..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं पठिष्यति जितेन्द्रियः .. 16 ..
15.42.m: May there be someone in our family with subdued senses / who will recite the Dvārakā māhātmya in the presence of Vaiṣṇavas!

15.42.s:
bhaviṣyati kule'smākaṃ māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
likhitvā kṛṣṇatuṣṭyarthaṃ svagṛhe dhārayiṣyati .. 17 ..
15.42.d:
भविष्यति कुलेऽस्माकं माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
लिखित्वा कृष्णतुष्ट्यर्थं स्वगृहे धारयिष्यति .. 17 ..
15.42.m: May there be someone in our family who, having written down the Dvārakā māhātmya / for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa, keeps it in his home!'

15.42.s:
svarṇadānaṃ ca godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tathaiva ca ..
yāvajjīvaṃ bhaveddattaṃ yenedaṃ dhāritaṃ kalau .. 18 ..
15.42.d:
स्वर्णदानं च गोदानं भूमिदानं तथैव च ..
यावज्जीवं भवेद्दत्तं येनेदं धारितं कलौ .. 18 ..
15.42.m: The gift of gold, the gift of a cow, and likewise the gift of land / have been given for as long as he lives by the one who has kept this [māhātmya] in the Kali age.

15.42.s:
taptakṛcchraṃ mahākṛcchraṃ māsopoṣaṇameva ca ..
yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenedaṃ śrāvitaṃ kalau .. 19 ..
15.42.d:
तप्तकृच्छ्रं महाकृच्छ्रं मासोपोषणमेव च ..
यावज्जीवं कृतं तेन येनेदं श्रावितं कलौ .. 19 ..
15.42.m: The Taptakṛcchra, the Mahākṛcchra, and fasting for a whole month / have been performed for life by him who has caused this to be heard in the Kali age.

15.42.s:
prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni pāpānāṃ nāśanāya ? ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yena vistāritaṃ kalau .. 7.4.42.20 ..
15.42.d:
प्रायश्चित्तानि चीर्णानि पापानां नाशनाय ? ..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं येन विस्तारितं कलौ .. 7.4.42.20 ..
15.42.m: Expiations have been observed for the destruction of sins / by him by whom the Dvārakā māhātmya has been propagated in the Kali age.

15.42.s:
tāvattiṣṭhaṃti puruṣe brahmahatyādikāni ca ..
yāvanna likhate jaṃturmāhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam .. 21 ..
15.42.d:
तावत्तिष्ठंति पुरुषे ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च ..
यावन्न लिखते जंतुर्माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् .. 21 ..
15.42.m: Sins like killing a brahmin remain in a person only for that long: / until a creature writes down the Dvārakā māhātmya.

15.42.s:
dānaiḥ sarvaiśca kiṃ tasya sarvatīrthāvagāhanaiḥ ..
dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yenedaṃ likhitaṃ gṛhe .. 22 ..
15.42.d:
दानैः सर्वैश्च किं तस्य सर्वतीर्थावगाहनैः ..
द्वारकायाश्च माहात्म्यं येनेदं लिखितं गृहे .. 22 ..
15.42.m: What need has he for all gifts, or for bathing in all sacred fords, / by whom this Dvārakā māhātmya has been written down in his home?

15.42.s:
sarva duḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvakāryyaprasādhanam..
caturvargapradaṃ nityaṃ haribhaktivivarddhanam .. 23 ..
15.42.d:
सर्व दुःखप्रशमनं सर्वकार्य्यप्रसाधनम्..
चतुर्वर्गप्रदं नित्यं हरिभक्तिविवर्द्धनम् .. 23 ..
15.42.m: It pacifies all suffering, accomplishes all objectives, / constantly grants the four goals of life, and increases devotion to Hari.

15.42.s:
na cādhirbhavate nūnaṃ yāmyaṃ tasya bhayaṃ nahi ..
māhātmyaṃ paṭhate yatra dvārakāyāḥ samudbhavam.. 24 ..
15.42.d:
न चाधिर्भवते नूनं याम्यं तस्य भयं नहि ..
माहात्म्यं पठते यत्र द्वारकायाः समुद्भवम्.. 24 ..
15.42.m: No mental agony occurs, and indeed there is no fear of Yama for him, / wherever the Dvārakā māhātmya is recited.

15.42.s:
likhitaṃ tiṣṭhate yasya gṛhe tattīrthameva ca ..
balācchuṇuṣva māhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāḥ samudbhavam .. 25 ..
15.42.d:
लिखितं तिष्ठते यस्य गृहे तत्तीर्थमेव च ..
बलाच्छुणुष्व माहात्म्यं द्वारकायाः समुद्भवम् .. 25 ..
15.42.m: The house in which it stays written down is indeed a sacred ford itself. / O Bala, listen to the māhātmya that has arisen from Dvārakā!

15.42.s:
vidhi mantrakriyāhīnāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti keśavaḥ ..
māhātmyaṃ tiṣṭhate nityaṃ likhitaṃ yasya veśmani ..
na tasyāgaḥsahasraistu kṛtairlipyati mānavaḥ .. 26 ..
15.42.d:
विधि मन्त्रक्रियाहीनां पूजां गृह्णाति केशवः ..
माहात्म्यं तिष्ठते नित्यं लिखितं यस्य वेश्मनि ..
न तस्यागःसहस्रैस्तु कृतैर्लिप्यति मानवः .. 26 ..
15.42.m: Keśava accepts worship even if lacking rules and ritual mantras [from one] / in whose dwelling the māhātmya constantly remains written down; / that man is not stained even by thousands of committed sins.

15.42.s:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇute vāpi māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
na bhavedbhūtavaikalyaṃ dharmavaikalyameva ca .. 27 ..
15.42.d:
यः पठेच्छृणुते वापि माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
न भवेद्भूतवैकल्यं धर्मवैकल्यमेव च .. 27 ..
15.42.m: Whoever reads or hears the Dvārakā māhātmya, / no affliction from ghosts and no failure in dharma occurs [for him].

15.42.s:
yaḥ smaretprātarutthāya māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
dvādaśīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ yaccoktaṃ labhate phalam .. 28 ..
15.42.d:
यः स्मरेत्प्रातरुत्थाय माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
द्वादशीनां च सर्वासां यच्चोक्तं लभते फलम् .. 28 ..
15.42.m: Rising at dawn, whoever remembers the Dvārakā māhātmya / obtains whatever fruit has been declared for all the Dvādaśī days.

15.42.s:
tridaśaiḥ pūjyate nityaṃ vandyate siddhacāraṇaiḥ ..
māhātmyaṃ paṭhate yo vai dvārakāyāḥ samudbhavam .. 29 ..
15.42.d:
त्रिदशैः पूज्यते नित्यं वन्द्यते सिद्धचारणैः ..
माहात्म्यं पठते यो वै द्वारकायाः समुद्भवम् .. 29 ..
15.42.m: He is constantly worshiped by the thirty [gods] and praised by Siddhas and Cāraṇas, / who recites the māhātmya that has arisen from Dvārakā.

15.42.s:
dvārakā vasate yatra tatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ..
tatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
yajñā vedāśca ṛṣayastrailokyaṃ sacarā caram .. 7.4.42.30 ..
15.42.d:
द्वारका वसते यत्र तत्र विष्णुः सनातनः ..
तत्र तीर्थानि सर्वाणि सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
यज्ञा वेदाश्च ऋषयस्त्रैलोक्यं सचरा चरम् .. 7.4.42.30 ..
15.42.m: Where Dvārakā resides, there is eternal Viṣṇu; / there are all sacred fords, all the gods along with Indra, / the sacrifices, the Vedas, the seers, and the three worlds moving and unmoving.

15.42.s:
śakto hi dvārakāṃ gaṃtuṃ mānavo na hi putraka ..
kṛṣṇadarśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ paṭhato bhavet ..31 ..
15.42.d:
शक्तो हि द्वारकां गंतुं मानवो न हि पुत्रक ..
कृष्णदर्शनजं पुण्यं माहात्म्यं पठतो भवेत् ..31 ..
15.42.m: A mortal may not indeed be able to go to Dvārakā, my son; / the merit born of seeing Kṛṣṇa belongs to one reciting the māhātmya.

15.42.s:
satyaṃ śaucaṃ śrutaṃ vittaṃ suśīlaṃ ca kṣamā''rjavam ..
sarvaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ na śṛṇoti yaḥ .. 32 ..
15.42.d:
सत्यं शौचं श्रुतं वित्तं सुशीलं च क्षमा'ऽर्जवम् ..
सर्वं च निष्फलं तस्य माहात्म्यं न शृणोति यः .. 32 ..
15.42.m: Truth, purity, sacred learning, wealth, good conduct, patience, and straightforwardness— / everything is fruitless for him who does not listen to the māhātmya.

15.42.s:
ṣaṇmāse ca bhavetputro lakṣmīścaiva vivarddhate ..
tasya yaḥ śṛṇute bhaktyā māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam .. 33 ..
15.42.d:
षण्मासे च भवेत्पुत्रो लक्ष्मीश्चैव विवर्द्धते ..
तस्य यः शृणुते भक्त्या माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् .. 33 ..
15.42.m: Within six months a son is born and fortune increases / for him who listens to the Dvārakā māhātmya with devotion.

15.42.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakākṣetre vṛṣotsargādikriyākaraṇa dvārakāmāhātmyaśravaṇādiphalavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 42 ..
15.42.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकाक्षेत्रे वृषोत्सर्गादिक्रियाकरण द्वारकामाहात्म्यश्रवणादिफलवर्णनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 42 ..
15.42.m: Thus ends the forty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Fruits of Performing Rites Such as Bull-Release and Listening to the Dvārakāmāhātmya in the Dvārakākṣetra', in the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

15.43.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
sāvitrīṃ ca bhavānīṃ ca durgāṃ caiva sarasvatīm ..
yo'rcayettulasīpatraiḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ .. 1 ..
15.43.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
सावित्रीं च भवानीं च दुर्गां चैव सरस्वतीम् ..
योऽर्चयेत्तुलसीपत्रैः सर्वकामसमन्वितः .. 1 ..
15.43.m: Prahlāda said: / Sāvitrī, Bhavānī, Durgā, and Sarasvatī: / whoever, possessed of all desires, worships them with tulasī leaves,

15.43.s:
gṛhītvā tulasīpatraṃ bhaktyā viṣṇuṃ samarcayet ..
arcitaṃ tena sakalaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam.. 2 ..
15.43.d:
गृहीत्वा तुलसीपत्रं भक्त्या विष्णुं समर्चयेत् ..
अर्चितं तेन सकलं सदेवासुरमानुषम्.. 2 ..
15.43.m: or having taken a tulasī leaf worships Viṣṇu with devotion— / everything has been worshiped by him, including gods, asuras, and humans.

15.43.s:
caturddaśyāṃ maheśānaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ pitāmaham ..
ye'rcayanti ca saptamyāṃ tulasyā ca gaṇādhipam ..3 ..
15.43.d:
चतुर्द्दश्यां महेशानं पौर्णमास्यां पितामहम् ..
येऽर्चयन्ति च सप्तम्यां तुलस्या च गणाधिपम् ..3 ..
15.43.m: [And those] who worship the Great Lord on the fourteenth day, the Grandfather on the full moon day, / and Gaṇādhipa with tulasī on the seventh day—

15.43.s:
śaṃkhodakaṃ tīrthavarādvariṣṭhaṃ pādodakaṃ tīrthavarādvariṣṭham..
naivedyaśeṣaṃ kratukoṭitulyaṃ nirmālyaśeṣaṃ vratadānatulyam .. 4 ..
15.43.d:
शंखोदकं तीर्थवराद्वरिष्ठं पादोदकं तीर्थवराद्वरिष्ठम्..
नैवेद्यशेषं क्रतुकोटितुल्यं निर्माल्यशेषं व्रतदानतुल्यम् .. 4 ..
15.43.m: Water from a conch is superior even to the best of sacred fords; water from [the Lord's] feet is superior even to the best of sacred fords; / the remnant of food offering equals ten million sacrifices; the remnant of floral offering equals vows and donations.

15.43.s:
mukundāśanaśeṣaṃ tu yo bhunakti dinedine ..
sikthesikthe bhavetpuṇyaṃ cāndrāyaṇaśatādhikam .. 5 ..
15.43.d:
मुकुन्दाशनशेषं तु यो भुनक्ति दिनेदिने ..
सिक्थेसिक्थे भवेत्पुण्यं चान्द्रायणशताधिकम् .. 5 ..
15.43.m: The man who eats day by day the remnant of Mukunda's meal / gains, with every mouthful of boiled rice, merit exceeding a hundred Cāndrāyaṇa penances.

15.43.s:
naivedyaśeṣaṃ tulasīvimiśraṃ viśeṣataḥ pādajalena viṣṇoḥ ..
yo'śnāti nityaṃ puruṣo murāreḥ prāpnoti yajñāyutakoṭipuṇyam .. 6 ..
15.43.d:
नैवेद्यशेषं तुलसीविमिश्रं विशेषतः पादजलेन विष्णोः ..
योऽश्नाति नित्यं पुरुषो मुरारेः प्राप्नोति यज्ञायुतकोटिपुण्यम् .. 6 ..
15.43.m: The man who constantly eats Murāri's food offering mixed with tulasī, / especially with the water from Viṣṇu's feet, obtains the merit of ten thousand million sacrifices.

15.43.s:
yaḥ śrāddhakāle haribhuktaśeṣaṃ dadāti bhaktyā pitṛdevatānām ..
tenaiva piṃḍātsutilairvimiśrādākalpakoṭiṃ pitaraḥ sutṛptāḥ .. 7 ..
15.43.d:
यः श्राद्धकाले हरिभुक्तशेषं ददाति भक्त्या पितृदेवतानाम् ..
तेनैव पिंडात्सुतिलैर्विमिश्रादाकल्पकोटिं पितरः सुतृप्ताः .. 7 ..
15.43.m: He who at the time of ancestral rites devotedly gives to the ancestors what was left over from Hari's meal, / by that alone, from the ball mixed with good sesame seeds, the ancestors remain well satisfied for ten million kalpas.

15.43.s:
snānārcanakriyākāle ghaṃṭāvādyaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
purato vāsudevasya gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ labhet .. 8 ..
15.43.d:
स्नानार्चनक्रियाकाले घंटावाद्यं करोति यः ..
पुरतो वासुदेवस्य गवां कोटिफलं लभेत् .. 8 ..
15.43.m: He who rings a bell at the time of the ritual of bathing and worshipping / before Vāsudeva obtains the fruit of [donating] ten million cows.

15.43.s:
sarvavādyamayī ghaṃṭā keśavasya sadā priyā ..
vādanāllabhate puṇyaṃ yajñakoṭiphalaṃ naraḥ .. 9 ..
15.43.d:
सर्ववाद्यमयी घंटा केशवस्य सदा प्रिया ..
वादनाल्लभते पुण्यं यज्ञकोटिफलं नरः .. 9 ..
15.43.m: The bell embodies all musical instruments, and is always dear to Keśava; / from ringing it, a man gains the meritorious fruit of ten million sacrifices.

15.43.s:
vāditrāṇāmabhāve tu pūjākāle ca sarvadā ..
ghaṃṭāvādyaṃ naraiḥ kāryyaṃ sarvavādyamayī yataḥ .. 7.4.43.10 ..
15.43.d:
वादित्राणामभावे तु पूजाकाले च सर्वदा ..
घंटावाद्यं नरैः कार्य्यं सर्ववाद्यमयी यतः .. 7.4.43.10 ..
15.43.m: In the absence of musical instruments, at the time of worship, / men should always ring a bell, since it embodies all instruments.

15.43.s:
tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtaṃ candanaṃ yacchate hareḥ ..
nirddahetpātakaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvajanmaśatārjitam .. 11 ..
15.43.d:
तुलसीकाष्ठसंभूतं चन्दनं यच्छते हरेः ..
निर्द्दहेत्पातकं सर्वं पूर्वजन्मशतार्जितम् .. 11 ..
15.43.m: He who offers to Hari sandalwood paste produced from tulasī wood / burns away all sin accumulated across hundreds of previous lives.

15.43.s:
dadāti pitṛ piṃḍeṣu tulasīkāṣṭhacandanam ..
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptirgayāśrāddhena vai tathā .. 12 ..
15.43.d:
ददाति पितृ पिंडेषु तुलसीकाष्ठचन्दनम् ..
पितॄणां जायते तृप्तिर्गयाश्राद्धेन वै तथा .. 12 ..
15.43.m: [If] he places sandalwood paste from tulasī wood upon the ancestral balls, / satisfaction arises for the ancestors just as through an ancestral rite at Gayā.

15.43.s:
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhacandanam ..
pitṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa sadā'bhīṣṭaṃ hareḥ kalau .. 13 ..
15.43.d:
सर्वेषामेव देवानां तुलसीकाष्ठचन्दनम् ..
पितॄणां च विशेषेण सदाऽभीष्टं हरेः कलौ .. 13 ..
15.43.m: Sandalwood paste from tulasī wood is desired by all the gods, / and especially by the ancestors; in the Kali age, it is always dear to Hari.

15.43.s:
harerbhāgavatā bhūtvā tulasīkāṣṭhacandanam ..
nārpayati sadā viṣṇorna te bhāgavatāḥ kalau .. 14 ..
15.43.d:
हरेर्भागवता भूत्वा तुलसीकाष्ठचन्दनम् ..
नार्पयति सदा विष्णोर्न ते भागवताः कलौ .. 14 ..
15.43.m: Those who, having become devotees of Hari, do not always offer to Viṣṇu / sandalwood paste from tulasī wood, are not [true] devotees in the Kali age.

15.43.s:
śarīraṃ dahyate yasya tulasīkāṣṭhavahninā ..
nīyamāno yamenāpi viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 15 ..
15.43.d:
शरीरं दह्यते यस्य तुलसीकाष्ठवह्निना ..
नीयमानो यमेनापि विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 15 ..
15.43.m: He whose body is cremated by a fire of tulasī wood, / even though seized by Yama, goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

15.43.s:
yadyekaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhaṃ madhye kāṣṭhasya yasya hi ..
dāhakāle bhavenmuktaḥ pāpakoṭiśatāyutaiḥ .. 16 ..
15.43.d:
यद्येकं तुलसीकाष्ठं मध्ये काष्ठस्य यस्य हि ..
दाहकाले भवेन्मुक्तः पापकोटिशतायुतैः .. 16 ..
15.43.m: If indeed there is a single piece of tulasī wood amidst the [funeral] wood, / at the time of cremation he becomes freed from tens of billions of sins.

15.43.s:
dahyamānaṃ naraṃ dṛṣṭvā tulasīkāṣṭhavahninā ..
janmakoṭisahasraistu toṣitastairjanārdanaḥ .. 17 ..
15.43.d:
दह्यमानं नरं दृष्ट्वा तुलसीकाष्ठवह्निना ..
जन्मकोटिसहस्रैस्तु तोषितस्तैर्जनार्दनः .. 17 ..
15.43.m: Seeing a man being cremated by a fire of tulasī wood, / Janārdana is pleased by them as if through a thousand tens of millions of births.

15.43.s:
dahyamānaṃ naraṃ sarve tulasīkāṣṭhavahninā ..
vimānasthāḥ suragaṇāḥ kṣipaṃti kusumāṃjalīn .. 18 ..
15.43.d:
दह्यमानं नरं सर्वे तुलसीकाष्ठवह्निना ..
विमानस्थाः सुरगणाः क्षिपंति कुसुमांजलीन् .. 18 ..
15.43.m: [Seeing] a man being cremated by a fire of tulasī wood, / all the hosts of gods standing in aerial chariots shower handfuls of flowers.

15.43.s:
nṛtyaṃtyo'psaraso hṛṣṭā gītaṃ gāyanti susvaram ..
jvalate yatra daityendra tulasīkāṣṭhapāvakaḥ .. 19 ..
15.43.d:
नृत्यंत्योऽप्सरसो हृष्टा गीतं गायन्ति सुस्वरम् ..
ज्वलते यत्र दैत्येन्द्र तुलसीकाष्ठपावकः .. 19 ..
15.43.m: Delighted apsarases dance and sing with sweet voices / wherever, O lord of the daityas, a fire of tulasī wood burns.

15.43.s: kurute vīkṣaṇaṃ viṣṇuḥ santuṣṭaḥ saha śaṃbhunā .. 7.4.43.20 ..
15.43.d: कुरुते वीक्षणं विष्णुः सन्तुष्टः सह शंभुना .. 7.4.43.20 ..
15.43.m: Content, Viṣṇu gazes [upon him] together with Śambhu.

15.43.s:
gṛhītvā taṃ kare śauriḥ puruṣaṃ svayamagrataḥ..
mārjate tasya pāpāni paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām ..
mahotsavaṃ ca kṛtvā tu jayaśabdapuraḥsaram .. 21 ..
15.43.d:
गृहीत्वा तं करे शौरिः पुरुषं स्वयमग्रतः..
मार्जते तस्य पापानि पश्यतां त्रिदिवौकसाम् ..
महोत्सवं च कृत्वा तु जयशब्दपुरःसरम् .. 21 ..
15.43.m: Taking that man by the hand himself before [them], Śauri / wipes away his sins while the denizens of heaven look on, / and makes a great festival accompanied by shouts of 'Victory!'

15.43.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prahlādenoditaṃ śrutvā māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam ..
prahṛṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve tathā daityeśvaro baliḥ .. 22 ..
15.43.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
प्रह्लादेनोदितं श्रुत्वा माहात्म्यं द्वारकाभवम् ..
प्रहृष्टा ऋषयः सर्वे तथा दैत्येश्वरो बलिः .. 22 ..
15.43.m: Sūta said: / Hearing the māhātmya pertaining to Dvārakā spoken by Prahlāda, / all the seers were exceedingly delighted, and likewise Bali, the lord of the daityas.

15.43.s:
tataḥ sarve'bhinandyainaṃ prahlādaṃ daityapuṅgavam ..
udyuktā dvārakāṃ gatvā draṣṭuṃ kṛṣṇamukhāmbujam .. 23 ..
15.43.d:
ततः सर्वेऽभिनन्द्यैनं प्रह्लादं दैत्यपुङ्गवम् ..
उद्युक्ता द्वारकां गत्वा द्रष्टुं कृष्णमुखाम्बुजम् .. 23 ..
15.43.m: Then, having all praised him, Prahlāda, the foremost of daityas, / they set out to go to Dvārakā to see Kṛṣṇa's lotus-face.

15.43.s:
tataste balinā sārdhaṃ munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ..
āgatya dvārakāṃ snātvā gomatyāṃ vidhipūrvakam .. 24 ..
15.43.d:
ततस्ते बलिना सार्धं मुनयः संशितव्रताः ..
आगत्य द्वारकां स्नात्वा गोमत्यां विधिपूर्वकम् .. 24 ..
15.43.m: Then the sages of strict vows, together with Bali, / having arrived at Dvārakā and bathed in the Gomatī according to rule,

15.43.s:
kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā samabhyarcya kṛtvā yātrāṃ yathāvidhi ..
dattvā dānāni bahuśaḥ kṛtakṛtyāstato'bhavan .. 25 ..
15.43.d:
कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा समभ्यर्च्य कृत्वा यात्रां यथाविधि ..
दत्त्वा दानानि बहुशः कृतकृत्यास्ततोऽभवन् .. 25 ..
15.43.m: having seen and worshipped Kṛṣṇa, having performed the pilgrimage according to rule, / and having given gifts in abundance, became accomplished in their purpose.

15.43.s:
jagmuḥ svīyāni sthānāni baliḥ pātālamāyayau ..
prahlādaṃ ca praṇamyāśu mene svasya kṛtārthatām .. 26 ..
15.43.d:
जग्मुः स्वीयानि स्थानानि बलिः पातालमाययौ ..
प्रह्लादं च प्रणम्याशु मेने स्वस्य कृतार्थताम् .. 26 ..
15.43.m: They went to their own places, and Bali returned to Pātāla; / and having bowed swiftly to Prahlāda, he considered himself fulfilled.

15.43.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāmāhātmyaśravaṇādiphalaśrutivarṇanapuraḥsaratulasīpatrakāṣṭhamahimavarṇanapūrvakaṃ prahlādadvijasaṃvāda samāptyanaṃtaraṃ balinā saha dvijakṛtadvārakāyātrāvidhivarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 43 ..
15.43.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये द्वारकामाहात्म्यश्रवणादिफलश्रुतिवर्णनपुरःसरतुलसीपत्रकाष्ठमहिमवर्णनपूर्वकं प्रह्लादद्विजसंवाद समाप्त्यनंतरं बलिना सह द्विजकृतद्वारकायात्राविधिवर्णनंनाम त्रिचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 43 ..
15.43.m: Thus ends the forty-third chapter, named 'The description of the procedure of the pilgrimage to Dvārakā undertaken by the twice-born with Bali, following the conclusion of the dialogue between Prahlāda and the twice-born, preceded by the description of the greatness of tulasī leaves and wood along with the declaration of fruits from hearing the Dvārakā-māhātmya and so on', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [section] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

15.44.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etatpurāṇamakhilaṃ purā skandena bhāṣitam ..
bhṛgave brahmaputrāya tasmāllebhe tathāṃ'girāḥ .. 1 ..
15.44.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतत्पुराणमखिलं पुरा स्कन्देन भाषितम् ..
भृगवे ब्रह्मपुत्राय तस्माल्लेभे तथांऽगिराः .. 1 ..
15.44.m: Sūta said: / In ancient times, this entire Purāṇa was spoken by Skanda / to Bhṛgu, the son of Brahmā; from him, Aṅgiras obtained it likewise.

15.44.s:
tataśca cyavanaḥ prāpa ṛcīkaśca tato muniḥ ..
evaṃ paraṃparā prāptaṃ sarveṣu bhuvaneṣvapi .. 2 ..
15.44.d:
ततश्च च्यवनः प्राप ऋचीकश्च ततो मुनिः ..
एवं परंपरा प्राप्तं सर्वेषु भुवनेष्वपि .. 2 ..
15.44.m: And from him Cyavana obtained it, and from him the sage Ṛcīka. / In this way, it was received through tradition in all worlds.

15.44.s:
skāndaṃ purāṇametacca kumāreṇa puroddhṛtam ..
yaḥ śṛṇoti satāṃ madhye naraḥ pāpādvimucyate .. 3 ..
15.44.d:
स्कान्दं पुराणमेतच्च कुमारेण पुरोद्धृतम् ..
यः शृणोति सतां मध्ये नरः पापाद्विमुच्यते .. 3 ..
15.44.m: This Skānda Purāṇa was formerly proclaimed by Kumāra. / The man who hears it amidst good people is freed from sin.

15.44.s:
idaṃ purāṇamāyuṣyaṃ caturvarṇasukhapradam ..
nirmitaṃ ṣaṇmukheneha niyataṃ sumahātmanā .. 4 ..
15.44.d:
इदं पुराणमायुष्यं चतुर्वर्णसुखप्रदम् ..
निर्मितं षण्मुखेनेह नियतं सुमहात्मना .. 4 ..
15.44.m: This Purāṇa bestows long life and grants happiness to the four classes; / it was composed here by the Six-faced One, the noble-minded, with certainty.

15.44.s: evametatsamākhyātamākhyānaṃ bhadramastu vaḥ .. 5 ..
15.44.d: एवमेतत्समाख्यातमाख्यानं भद्रमस्तु वः .. 5 ..
15.44.m: Thus has this narrative been related; may there be well-being for you!

15.44.s:
maṇḍitaṃ saptabhiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ skāndaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ ..
na tasya puṇyasaṃkhyānaṃ kartuṃ śakyeta kenacit .. 6 ..
15.44.d:
मण्डितं सप्तभिः खण्डैः स्कान्दं यः शृणुयान्नरः ..
न तस्य पुण्यसंख्यानं कर्तुं शक्येत केनचित् .. 6 ..
15.44.m: The man who hears the Skānda adorned with seven sections— / no one would be able to count his merit.

15.44.s:
ya idaṃ dharmamāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati ..
svargaloke vasettāvadyāvadakṣarasaṃkhyayā .. 7 ..
15.44.d:
य इदं धर्ममाहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणाय प्रयच्छति ..
स्वर्गलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदक्षरसंख्यया .. 7 ..
15.44.m: He who presents this māhātmya of dharma to a brahmin / shall dwell in the heavenly world for as many [years] as the number of syllables.

15.44.s:
yathā hi varṣato dhārā yathā vā divi tārakāḥ ..
gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā yadvattadvatsaṃkhyā na vidyate .. 8 ..
15.44.d:
यथा हि वर्षतो धारा यथा वा दिवि तारकाः ..
गंगायां सिकता यद्वत्तद्वत्संख्या न विद्यते .. 8 ..
15.44.m: Just like the torrents of rain, or like the stars in the sky, / or like the sands in the Gaṅgā, so there is no counting [his merit].

15.44.s:
yo naraḥ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā dināni ca kiyanti vai ..
sarvārthasiddho bhavati ya etatpaṭhate naraḥ .. 9 ..
15.44.d:
यो नरः शृणुयाद्भक्त्या दिनानि च कियन्ति वै ..
सर्वार्थसिद्धो भवति य एतत्पठते नरः .. 9 ..
15.44.m: A man who hears it with devotion even for a few days / attains all his aims; and [likewise] the man who recites this.

15.44.s:
putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
labhate patikāmā yā patiṃ kanyā manoramam .. 7.4.44.10..
15.44.d:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रान्धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
लभते पतिकामा या पतिं कन्या मनोरमम् .. 7.4.44.10..
15.44.m: One who desires a son obtains sons; one who desires wealth obtains wealth; / a maiden who desires a husband obtains a charming husband.

15.44.s:
samāgamaṃ labhante ca bāndhavāśca pravāsibhiḥ ..
skāndaṃ purāṇaṃ śrutvā tu pumānāpnoti vāñchitam .. 11 ..
15.44.d:
समागमं लभन्ते च बान्धवाश्च प्रवासिभिः ..
स्कान्दं पुराणं श्रुत्वा तु पुमानाप्नोति वाञ्छितम् .. 11 ..
15.44.m: And relatives obtain reunion with those residing abroad. / By hearing the Skānda Purāṇa, a man attains his wish.

15.44.s: śṛṇvataḥ paṭhataścaiva sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām..12..
15.44.d: शृण्वतः पठतश्चैव सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम्..12..
15.44.m: For those who hear it and recite it, it grants all desires to mortals.

15.44.s:
puṇyaṃ śrutvā purāṇaṃ vai dīrghamāyuśca vindati..
mahīṃ vijayate rājā śatrūṃścāpyadhitiṣṭhati..13..
15.44.d:
पुण्यं श्रुत्वा पुराणं वै दीर्घमायुश्च विन्दति..
महीं विजयते राजा शत्रूंश्चाप्यधितिष्ठति..13..
15.44.m: By hearing this sacred Purāṇa, one indeed attains long life; / a king conquers the earth and triumphs over his enemies.

15.44.s:
vedavicca bhavidvipraḥ kṣatriyo rājyamāpnuyāt..
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt..14..
15.44.d:
वेदविच्च भविद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो राज्यमाप्नुयात्..
धनं धान्यं तथा वैश्यः शूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात्..14..
15.44.m: A brahmin becomes knower of the Vedas; a kṣatriya attains a kingdom; / a vaiśya [attains] wealth and grain; a śūdra attains happiness.

15.44.s:
adhyāyamekaṃ śṛṇuyācchlokaṃ ślokārdhameva vā..
yaḥ ślokapādaṃ śṛṇuyādviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 15 ..
15.44.d:
अध्यायमेकं शृणुयाच्छ्लोकं श्लोकार्धमेव वा..
यः श्लोकपादं शृणुयाद्विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 15 ..
15.44.m: He who hears one chapter, a verse, or even half a verse, / or he who hears a single quarter-verse, goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

15.44.s:
śrutvā purāṇametaddhi vācakaṃ yastu pūjayet..
tena brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva prapūjitaḥ .. 16 ..
15.44.d:
श्रुत्वा पुराणमेतद्धि वाचकं यस्तु पूजयेत्..
तेन ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्चैव प्रपूजितः .. 16 ..
15.44.m: Having heard this Purāṇa, he who worships the reciter / has worshipped Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra.

15.44.s:
ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet ..
pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā hyanṛṇī bhavet .. 17 ..
15.44.d:
एकमप्यक्षरं यस्तु गुरुः शिष्ये निवेदयेत् ..
पृथिव्यां नास्ति तद्द्रव्यं यद्दत्त्वा ह्यनृणी भवेत् .. 17 ..
15.44.m: Even if the guru imparts a single syllable to the student, / there is no object on earth which, by giving it, one would be free of debt.

15.44.s:
ataḥ saṃpūjanīyastu vyāsaḥ śāstropadeśakaḥ ..
gobhū hiraṇyavastrādyairbhojanaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ .. 18 ..
15.44.d:
अतः संपूजनीयस्तु व्यासः शास्त्रोपदेशकः ..
गोभू हिरण्यवस्त्राद्यैर्भोजनैः सार्वकामिकैः .. 18 ..
15.44.m: Therefore, the Vyāsa who teaches the scripture must be fully honored / with cows, land, gold, garments, and the like, and with meals fulfilling all desires. 18

15.44.s:
ya evaṃ bhaktiyuktastu śrutvā śāstramanuttamam ..
pūjayedupadeṣṭāraṃ sa śaivaṃ padamāpnuyāt .. 19 ..
15.44.d:
य एवं भक्तियुक्तस्तु श्रुत्वा शास्त्रमनुत्तमम् ..
पूजयेदुपदेष्टारं स शैवं पदमाप्नुयात् .. 19 ..
15.44.m: He who, filled with devotion, having heard the supreme scripture, / thus honors the teacher, shall attain the realm of Śiva. 19

15.44.s:
purāṇaśra vaṇādeva anekabhavasaṃcitam ..
pāpaṃ praśamamāyāti sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet .. 7.4.44.20 ..
15.44.d:
पुराणश्र वणादेव अनेकभवसंचितम् ..
पापं प्रशममायाति सर्वतीर्थफलं लभेत् .. 7.4.44.20 ..
15.44.m: By the very hearing of the Purāṇa, the sin accumulated over many births / comes to an end, and one obtains the fruit of all sacred fords. 20

15.44.s:
amṛtenodarasthena mriyante sarvadevatāḥ ..
kaṇṭhasthitaviṣeṇāpi yo jīvati sa pātu vaḥ .. 21 ..
15.44.d:
अमृतेनोदरस्थेन म्रियन्ते सर्वदेवताः ..
कण्ठस्थितविषेणापि यो जीवति स पातु वः .. 21 ..
15.44.m: All the gods die though nectar is in their bellies; / may he protect you, who lives even with poison lodged in his throat! 21

15.44.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
ityuktvoparate sūte śaunakādi maharṣayaḥ ..
saṃpūjya vidhivatsūtaṃ praśasyāthābhyanandayan .. .. 22 ..
15.44.d:
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वोपरते सूते शौनकादि महर्षयः ..
संपूज्य विधिवत्सूतं प्रशस्याथाभ्यनन्दयन् .. .. 22 ..
15.44.m: Vyāsa said: / Having spoken thus, when Sūta ceased, Śaunaka and the great seers, / having duly honored Sūta and praised him, congratulated him. 22

15.44.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathito bhavatā sargaḥ pratisargastathaiva ca ..
vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇānāmanukramaḥ .. 23 ..
15.44.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथितो भवता सर्गः प्रतिसर्गस्तथैव च ..
वंशानुवंशचरितं पुराणानामनुक्रमः .. 23 ..
15.44.m: The seers said: / You have told of the creation and likewise the secondary creation, / the history of the lineages and dynasties, and the order of the Purāṇas, 23

15.44.s:
manvantarapramāṇaṃ ca brahmāṇḍasya ca vistaraḥ ..
jyotiścakrasvarūpaṃ ca yathāvadanuvarṇitam .. 24 ..
15.44.d:
मन्वन्तरप्रमाणं च ब्रह्माण्डस्य च विस्तरः ..
ज्योतिश्चक्रस्वरूपं च यथावदनुवर्णितम् .. 24 ..
15.44.m: and the extent of the manvantaras, the expansion of the universe, / and the nature of the wheel of constellations, properly described. 24

15.44.s:
dhanyāḥ sma kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma vayaṃ tava mukhāmbujāt ..
skāndaṃ mahāpurāṇa hi śrutvā sūtātiharṣitāḥ .. 25 ..
15.44.d:
धन्याः स्म कृतकृत्याः स्म वयं तव मुखाम्बुजात् ..
स्कान्दं महापुराण हि श्रुत्वा सूतातिहर्षिताः .. 25 ..
15.44.m: We are blessed, we have accomplished our purpose, having heard from your lotus face / this Skānda Mahāpurāṇa, O Sūta, and are overjoyed! 25

15.44.s:
vayaṃ maharṣayo viprāḥ pradadmo'dya tavā''śiṣaḥ ..
vyāsaśiṣya mahāprājña ciraṃ jīva sukhī bhava .. 26 ..
15.44.d:
वयं महर्षयो विप्राः प्रदद्मोऽद्य तवा'ऽशिषः ..
व्यासशिष्य महाप्राज्ञ चिरं जीव सुखी भव .. 26 ..
15.44.m: We, the great seers, the brahmins, give you blessings today: / O disciple of Vyāsa, of great wisdom, live long and be happy! 26

15.44.s:
iti dattvā''śiṣastasmai dattvā vāsovibhūṣaṇam ..
visṛjya lomaśaṃ sūtaṃ yajñakarmāṇyathācaran .. 27 ..
15.44.d:
इति दत्त्वा'ऽशिषस्तस्मै दत्त्वा वासोविभूषणम् ..
विसृज्य लोमशं सूतं यज्ञकर्माण्यथाचरन् .. 27 ..
15.44.m: Having thus bestowed blessings upon him and given him garments and ornaments, / having dismissed Sūta Lomaśa, they then performed the sacrificial rites. 27

15.44.s:
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye skandamahāpurāṇaśravaṇapaṭhanapustakapradānapaurāṇikavyāsapūjanamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakaṃ samastaskāndamahā purāṇagranthasamāptyupasaṃhārasūtasatkāravṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 44 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthaṃ dvārakāmāhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam .. (7-4) ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptamaṃ prabhāsakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam.. 7 ..
15.44.d:
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये स्कन्दमहापुराणश्रवणपठनपुस्तकप्रदानपौराणिकव्यासपूजनमाहात्म्यवर्णनपूर्वकं समस्तस्कान्दमहा पुराणग्रन्थसमाप्त्युपसंहारसूतसत्कारवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 44 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराणे सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थं द्वारकामाहात्म्यं सम्पूर्णम् .. (7-4) ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराणे सप्तमं प्रभासखण्डं सम्पूर्णम्.. 7 ..
15.44.m:
Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Account of Sūta's Honor and the Conclusion and Completion of the Entire Skandamahāpurāṇa Text Preceded by the Description of the Māhātmya of the Worship of the Paurāṇika Vyāsa, the Gift of the Manuscript, the Recitation, and the Hearing of the Skandamahāpurāṇa', in the fourth [section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses. 44
Thus the fourth [section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa is complete. (7-4)
Thus the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa is complete. 7

15.45.m: Now begins the fourth [section], the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa. (7-4)

15.45.s: 1 kalau yuge prāpte viṣṇoḥ kvā''vāsasthānamiti śaunakādibhiḥ pṛṣṭena sūtena kaliyuga- sthitivarṇanam, tatra svāvatārādikāni kāryāṇi kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇe deve'nante svasthānaṃ gate lupraprāyadharmaṃ kaliṃ dṛṣṭvā kva vā'smatsadṛśānāṃ sthitirbhāvyeti manasaḥ vicintya ṛṣīnpratyuddālakoktiḥ, taduddālakavākyaṃ śrutvā kalikālasaṃpīḍitaja- nānāṃ muktiprāptyarthamupāyaṃ yojayitumṛṣīṇā brahmaṇo'gre gamanam, uddālakādyṛṣi- bhirbrahmastutikaraṇam, tato brahmapṛcchayarṣibhiḥ svāgamanakāraṇakathanam, tadā brahmaṇā 'nāhaṃ viṣṇoravasthitiṃ jānāmi' ityuttaradānam, brahmottaraṃ śrutvā prāṇatyāgakaraṇe pravṛttānṛṣīndṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā ṛṣibhiḥ saha prahlādasamīpe gamanam, prahlādena sarva- rṣīṇāṃ brahmaṇaścātithyakaraṇam, brahmamukhenarṣibhiḥ prahlādāya svāgamanakāraṇakathanam, ṛpibhiḥ prahlādāya kaliyuge bhagavatsthitiviṣayakapraśnakaraṇam ..... 279 1
15.45.d: 1 कलौ युगे प्राप्ते विष्णोः क्वा'ऽवासस्थानमिति शौनकादिभिः पृष्टेन सूतेन कलियुग- स्थितिवर्णनम्, तत्र स्वावतारादिकानि कार्याणि कृत्वा श्रीकृष्णे देवेऽनन्ते स्वस्थानं गते लुप्रप्रायधर्मं कलिं दृष्ट्वा क्व वाऽस्मत्सदृशानां स्थितिर्भाव्येति मनसः विचिन्त्य ऋषीन्प्रत्युद्दालकोक्तिः, तदुद्दालकवाक्यं श्रुत्वा कलिकालसंपीडितज- नानां मुक्तिप्राप्त्यर्थमुपायं योजयितुमृषीणा ब्रह्मणोऽग्रे गमनम्, उद्दालकाद्यृषि- भिर्ब्रह्मस्तुतिकरणम्, ततो ब्रह्मपृच्छयर्षिभिः स्वागमनकारणकथनम्, तदा ब्रह्मणा ऽनाहं विष्णोरवस्थितिं जानामि' इत्युत्तरदानम्, ब्रह्मोत्तरं श्रुत्वा प्राणत्यागकरणे प्रवृत्तानृषीन्दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणा ऋषिभिः सह प्रह्लादसमीपे गमनम्, प्रह्लादेन सर्व- र्षीणां ब्रह्मणश्चातिथ्यकरणम्, ब्रह्ममुखेनर्षिभिः प्रह्लादाय स्वागमनकारणकथनम्, ऋपिभिः प्रह्लादाय कलियुगे भगवत्स्थितिविषयकप्रश्नकरणम् ..... 279 1
15.45.m: 1. When the Kali age arrived, asked by Śaunaka and others, "Where is the dwelling place of Viṣṇu?", Sūta describes the condition of the Kali age; there, having performed his acts such as his incarnations, when the divine, infinite Lord Kṛṣṇa went to his own abode, Uddālaka spoke to the seers having reflected in his mind, "Seeing the Kali age wherein dharma is almost destroyed, where indeed should be the residence of people like us?"; hearing those words of Uddālaka, the seers go before Brahmā to devise an expedient for the attainment of liberation for the people afflicted by the time of Kali; the seers led by Uddālaka utter praise of Brahmā; then, at Brahmā's inquiry, the seers state the purpose of their arrival; then Brahmā gives the answer, "I do not know the whereabouts of Viṣṇu"; hearing Brahmā's answer, seeing the seers resolved upon abandoning their lives, Brahmā goes with the seers into the presence of Prahlāda; Prahlāda offers hospitality to all the seers and Brahmā; through the mouth of Brahmā, the seers state the purpose of their arrival to Prahlāda; the seers question Prahlāda concerning the Lord's abode in the Kali age. ..... 279 1

15.45.s:
2 prahlādena ṛṣīnpratyuttaraṃ dātuṃ kaliyugasyārambhasthitivarṇanam, tatroddhavakṛṣṇayoḥ saṃvāde pravṛtte tāvaddurvāsaso yātrāṃ kartuṃ pravṛttasya gomatītīraṃ pratyāgamanamiti śrutvā kṛṣṇarukmiṇyostatra durvāsordarśanārthaṃ gamanam, tato durvāsasā kṛṣṇāya kuśalādipraśnakaraṇam, tato mithaḥ kuśalaṃ kathayitvā śrīkṛṣṇena durvāsase dvārakāṃ pratyetumāgrahakaraṇam, durvāsasā svāgamārthaṃ prārthayānaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prati svasvabhāva- nivedanam , tathāpi kṛṣṇasyātyāgrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇarukmiṇyau rathavāhakatve niyojya durvāsaso dvārakāgamanapravṛttivarṇanam, madhyemārgaṃ tṛṣitāṃ rukmiṇīṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīkṛṣṇena pādākrāntyā dharātalaṃ nirbhidya pātālato bhogāvatyā ānayanam, tato rukmiṇyā śrīkṛṣṇānītabhogāvatījalasya prāśanakaraṇam, durvāsasā 'madā- jñayā vinā rukmiṇyā jalaprāśanaṃ kṛtam iti matvā tadasahamānena tasyai rukmiṇyai śāpadānam- tato durvāsasā rathādavaruhya bhūmāvavasthitikaraṇam, tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇena rukmiṇyā ca durvāsasa āśvāsanam, tato durvāsasaṃ svagṛhaṃ nītvā tadṛṣipādodaka-
kṣālanena svadehakṛtārthīkaraṇam... ... ..... ... 280 1
15.45.d:
2 प्रह्लादेन ऋषीन्प्रत्युत्तरं दातुं कलियुगस्यारम्भस्थितिवर्णनम्, तत्रोद्धवकृष्णयोः संवादे प्रवृत्ते तावद्दुर्वाससो यात्रां कर्तुं प्रवृत्तस्य गोमतीतीरं प्रत्यागमनमिति श्रुत्वा कृष्णरुक्मिण्योस्तत्र दुर्वासोर्दर्शनार्थं गमनम्, ततो दुर्वाससा कृष्णाय कुशलादिप्रश्नकरणम्, ततो मिथः कुशलं कथयित्वा श्रीकृष्णेन दुर्वाससे द्वारकां प्रत्येतुमाग्रहकरणम्, दुर्वाससा स्वागमार्थं प्रार्थयानं कृष्णं प्रति स्वस्वभाव- निवेदनम् , तथापि कृष्णस्यात्याग्रहं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णरुक्मिण्यौ रथवाहकत्वे नियोज्य दुर्वाससो द्वारकागमनप्रवृत्तिवर्णनम्, मध्येमार्गं तृषितां रुक्मिणीं दृष्ट्वा श्रीकृष्णेन पादाक्रान्त्या धरातलं निर्भिद्य पातालतो भोगावत्या आनयनम्, ततो रुक्मिण्या श्रीकृष्णानीतभोगावतीजलस्य प्राशनकरणम्, दुर्वाससा ऽमदा- ज्ञया विना रुक्मिण्या जलप्राशनं कृतम् इति मत्वा तदसहमानेन तस्यै रुक्मिण्यै शापदानम्- ततो दुर्वाससा रथादवरुह्य भूमाववस्थितिकरणम्, ततः श्रीकृष्णेन रुक्मिण्या च दुर्वासस आश्वासनम्, ततो दुर्वाससं स्वगृहं नीत्वा तदृषिपादोदक-
क्षालनेन स्वदेहकृतार्थीकरणम्... ... ..... ... 280 1
15.45.m: 2. In order to give an answer to the seers, Prahlāda describes the condition at the beginning of the Kali age; there, when a dialogue between Uddhava and Kṛṣṇa took place, hearing that Durvāsas, who had set out on a journey, had arrived at the bank of the Gomatī, Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī went there for the darśana of Durvāsas; then Durvāsas inquires about Kṛṣṇa's welfare and the like; then, having exchanged greetings of welfare, Lord Kṛṣṇa insists that Durvāsas come to Dvārakā; Durvāsas discloses his own nature to Kṛṣṇa who was entreating his arrival; nevertheless, seeing Kṛṣṇa's intense insistence, Durvāsas harnesses Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī to draw his chariot, and his departure for Dvārakā is described; seeing Rukmiṇī thirsty on the way, Lord Kṛṣṇa strikes the ground with his foot, splits it open, and brings the Bhogāvatī from Pātāla; then Rukmiṇī drinks the water of the Bhogāvatī brought by Lord Kṛṣṇa; Durvāsas, thinking "Rukmiṇī drank water without my permission," unable to tolerate it, curses Rukmiṇī; then Durvāsas descends from the chariot and stands on the ground; then Lord Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī pacify Durvāsas; then, having brought Durvāsas to his home, [Kṛṣṇa] fulfills himself by washing the seer's feet with water. ... 280 1

15.45.s: 3 rukmiṇyā durvāsodattaśāpaṃ smṛtvā bahuśokakaraṇam, rukmiṇyagre nāradāgamanam, nāradena bahuprakāreṇa rukmiṇyai vodhaṃ kṛtvā rukmiṇyā saha rukmiṇīśāpa-nivṛttyarthaṃ bhāgīrathītīrthe gamanam tatra bhāgīrathītīrastharukmiṇīvane sukhena ramamāṇāyā rukmiṇyā vṛttāntaṃ kṣutvā 'svavākyaṃ kathaṃ mṛṣā bhavet iti manasi kṛtvā durvāsasā bhāgīrathyai rukmiṇīvanasthitebhyo'nyavṛkṣebhyaśca śāpadānam, tato rukmiṇyā maraṇe niścayakaraṇya, kaṇṭhapāśakarāṃ rukmiṇīṃ maraṇodyatāṃ jñātvā garuḍamāruhya śrīkṛṣṇasya tatrāgamanama, tato durvāsasā'pi 'mayā kimidaṃ kṛtam ityeva svayaṃ paścāttāpaṃ kṛtvā rukmiṇīsamīpametya śrīrukmiṇīkṛṣṇayoḥ kṣamayā santoṣīkaraṇam, rukmiṇīduḥkhaśāpamocanakaraṇam. ... ... 281 1
15.45.d: 3 रुक्मिण्या दुर्वासोदत्तशापं स्मृत्वा बहुशोककरणम्, रुक्मिण्यग्रे नारदागमनम्, नारदेन बहुप्रकारेण रुक्मिण्यै वोधं कृत्वा रुक्मिण्या सह रुक्मिणीशाप-निवृत्त्यर्थं भागीरथीतीर्थे गमनम् तत्र भागीरथीतीरस्थरुक्मिणीवने सुखेन रममाणाया रुक्मिण्या वृत्तान्तं क्षुत्वा ऽस्ववाक्यं कथं मृषा भवेत् इति मनसि कृत्वा दुर्वाससा भागीरथ्यै रुक्मिणीवनस्थितेभ्योऽन्यवृक्षेभ्यश्च शापदानम्, ततो रुक्मिण्या मरणे निश्चयकरण्य, कण्ठपाशकरां रुक्मिणीं मरणोद्यतां ज्ञात्वा गरुडमारुह्य श्रीकृष्णस्य तत्रागमनम, ततो दुर्वाससाऽपि ऽमया किमिदं कृतम् इत्येव स्वयं पश्चात्तापं कृत्वा रुक्मिणीसमीपमेत्य श्रीरुक्मिणीकृष्णयोः क्षमया सन्तोषीकरणम्, रुक्मिणीदुःखशापमोचनकरणम्. ... ... 281 1
15.45.m: 3. Remembering the curse given by Durvāsas, Rukmiṇī grieves greatly; Nārada arrives before Rukmiṇī; Nārada instructs Rukmiṇī in many ways and goes with Rukmiṇī to the sacred ford of the Bhāgīrathī to remove Rukmiṇī's curse; hearing the account of Rukmiṇī happily sporting there in the Rukmiṇī grove on the bank of the Bhāgīrathī, thinking in his mind "How could my word prove false?", Durvāsas curses the Bhāgīrathī and the other trees standing in the Rukmiṇī grove; then Rukmiṇī resolves to die; knowing that Rukmiṇī has put a noose around her neck and is intent on death, Lord Kṛṣṇa arrives there mounted on Garuḍa; then Durvāsas also repents of his own accord, thinking "What is this that I have done?", approaches Rukmiṇī, and gratifies Śrī Rukmiṇī and Kṛṣṇa with his forgiveness; and he frees Rukmiṇī from sorrow and the curse. ... 281 1
