15.45.s: 4 śrīkṛṣṇadurvāsasoḥ parasparaṃ varaṃ dattvā gomatītīre svasvaṣoḍaśakalayā janopakārārtha-māvāsakaraṇam, tatra gomatītīramāhātmyavarṇanam, samāsato dvārakāmathurā-māhātmyavarṇanam, tatra bṛhaspatīndrasaṃvāde kalikālamāhātmyavarṇanaprasaṃgaḥ, tatra cakrartārthādyanekatīrthasnānadānādinā kalikālodbhūtonmattamlecchādibādhāvināśa iti kathayitvā bṛhaspatinā sendradevānāṃ sāṃtvanakaraṇam, dvārakāyātrāvidhi-varṇanam. ..... ............... 283 1
15.45.d: 4 श्रीकृष्णदुर्वाससोः परस्परं वरं दत्त्वा गोमतीतीरे स्वस्वषोडशकलया जनोपकारार्थ-मावासकरणम्, तत्र गोमतीतीरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, समासतो द्वारकामथुरा-माहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र बृहस्पतीन्द्रसंवादे कलिकालमाहात्म्यवर्णनप्रसंगः, तत्र चक्रर्तार्थाद्यनेकतीर्थस्नानदानादिना कलिकालोद्भूतोन्मत्तम्लेच्छादिबाधाविनाश इति कथयित्वा बृहस्पतिना सेन्द्रदेवानां सांत्वनकरणम्, द्वारकायात्राविधि-वर्णनम्. ..... ............... 283 1
15.45.m: 4. Description of Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Durvāsas granting boons to each other and establishing an abode with their sixteenfold parts on the bank of the Gomatī for the benefit of humanity; description of the māhātmya of the bank of the Gomatī therein; brief description of the māhātmya of Dvārakā and Mathurā; the context of the description of the māhātmya of the Kali age in the dialogue between Bṛhaspati and Indra therein; Bṛhaspati consoling the gods headed by Indra by explaining that through ritual ablution, gifts, and the like at many sacred fords such as Cakratīrtha, the afflictions caused by mad mlecchas and others born in the Kali age are destroyed; description of the rules for the pilgrimage to Dvārakā. ................ 283 1

5. In the dialogue between Prahlāda and the seer, description of the māhātmya of the origin of the Gomatī, preceded by an account of the manifestation of the Lord through the power of Sanatkumāra's austerities. .......... 285
6. Description of the procedure for the worship of Kṛṣṇa; description of the māhātmya of ritual ablution, gifting, and feeding brahmins. 286 2

7. In the description of the māhātmya of the sacred ford called Cakra, description of the stages of worship with the sixteen offerings; recitation of the mantra for the offering of arghya therein; description of the māhātmya of Cakratīrtha located on the shore of the confluence of the Gomatī and the ocean. 288 1

15.45.s: 8 gomatyarghyadānamaṃtravarṇanam , snānavidhivarṇanam, viśvedevapūjanapūrvaka śrāddhamāhātmyavarṇanam, gomatīsaṃgamasnānamāhātmyavarṇanam, gomatītīrastha bhagavatsvarūpamāhātmyavarṇanam 288 2
15.45.d: 8 गोमत्यर्घ्यदानमंत्रवर्णनम् , स्नानविधिवर्णनम्, विश्वेदेवपूजनपूर्वक श्राद्धमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, गोमतीसंगमस्नानमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, गोमतीतीरस्थ भगवत्स्वरूपमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 288 2
15.45.m: 8. Description of the mantra for offering arghya to the Gomatī; description of the rules for ritual ablution; description of the māhātmya of the ancestral rite preceded by the worship of the Viśvedevas; description of the māhātmya of ritual ablution at the confluence of the Gomatī; description of the māhātmya of the form of the Lord situated on the bank of the Gomatī. 288 2
9. Description of the māhātmya of Rukmiṇīhrada. ......... 290 1

15.45.s: 10 kṛkalāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇane nṛgeṇa rājñā yajñādikaṃ vidhāya tatra nityaṃ viprebhyaḥ sālaṃkṛtagosahasradānakaraṇavṛttāntavarṇanam, tato rājñaikasmindine jaiminisaṃjñaka-rṣaye godānakaraṇam, tatastasyā gorbrāhmaṇagṛhānnirgatya nṛgarājagoṣṭhāne gama-nam, paścānnṛgeṇa tasyā eva goranyabrāhmaṇāya dānakaraṇam, tāṃ gṛhītvā gacchato brāhmaṇasya madhyemārge jaimininā darśanam, nṛgadattāṃ svakīyāṃ svāvāsānnirgatāṃ gāṃ dṛṣṭvā tena brāhmaṇena saha jaimininā vādakaraṇam ,mithaḥ prajalpatostayorjaiminibrāhma-ṇayornṛgamaṃdire gamanam, tatastābhyāṃ kṛkalāso bhava iti rājñe śāpapradānam, tacchā-pena kṛkalāsatvaṃ gatasya nṛgasya rājñaḥ kṛṣṇena nijakareṇoddharaṇakaraṇam, śrīkṛṣṇena nṛgarājāya varadānam, vimānamāruhya śrīkṛṣṇaprasādato nṛgasya svarge gamanam, kṛkalāsāparanāmakanṛgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam - . - - ... 290 2
15.45.d: 10 कृकलासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने नृगेण राज्ञा यज्ञादिकं विधाय तत्र नित्यं विप्रेभ्यः सालंकृतगोसहस्रदानकरणवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, ततो राज्ञैकस्मिन्दिने जैमिनिसंज्ञक-र्षये गोदानकरणम्, ततस्तस्या गोर्ब्राह्मणगृहान्निर्गत्य नृगराजगोष्ठाने गम-नम्, पश्चान्नृगेण तस्या एव गोरन्यब्राह्मणाय दानकरणम्, तां गृहीत्वा गच्छतो ब्राह्मणस्य मध्येमार्गे जैमिनिना दर्शनम्, नृगदत्तां स्वकीयां स्वावासान्निर्गतां गां दृष्ट्वा तेन ब्राह्मणेन सह जैमिनिना वादकरणम् ,मिथः प्रजल्पतोस्तयोर्जैमिनिब्राह्म-णयोर्नृगमंदिरे गमनम्, ततस्ताभ्यां कृकलासो भव इति राज्ञे शापप्रदानम्, तच्छा-पेन कृकलासत्वं गतस्य नृगस्य राज्ञः कृष्णेन निजकरेणोद्धरणकरणम्, श्रीकृष्णेन नृगराजाय वरदानम्, विमानमारुह्य श्रीकृष्णप्रसादतो नृगस्य स्वर्गे गमनम्, कृकलासापरनामकनृगतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् - . - - ... 290 2
15.45.m: 10. In the description of the māhātmya of Kṛkalāsatīrtha, an account of King Nṛga performing sacrifices and the like and daily bestowing a thousand adorned cows upon brahmins there; then on a certain day the king bestowing a gift of a cow on the seer named Jaimini; then that cow wandering out from the brahmin's house and entering King Nṛga's cowshed; later, Nṛga bestowing that very cow upon another brahmin; Jaimini seeing the brahmin on the way as he was taking her away; seeing his own cow, given by Nṛga, which had wandered away from his home, Jaimini's dispute with that brahmin; as the two of them, Jaimini and the [other] brahmin, argued with each other, their going to Nṛga's palace; then both of them cursing the king, saying: 'Become a chameleon!'; King Nṛga, who had become a chameleon on account of that curse, being delivered by Kṛṣṇa with his own hand; Śrī Kṛṣṇa granting a boon to King Nṛga; Nṛga ascending an aerial chariot and going to heaven by the grace of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; description of the māhātmya of Nṛgatīrtha, also known as Kṛkalāsatīrtha. ..... 290 2
11. Description of the māhātmya of Viṣṇupadatīrtha. ......... 292 1

15.45.s:
12 gopracāratīrthamāhātmyavarṇane kaṃsavadhottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇenoddhavasya svakuśalakathanārthaṃ gopī-kuśalajñānārthaṃ gopyupadeśavidhānārthaṃ ca gokule saṃpreṣaṇam, uddhavamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā naṃdā-dibhiruddhavasyātithyāsanādisatkārakaraṇam, gopībhiruddhavāyāgamanakāraṇapraśnaka-raṇam, uddhavenāpi svāgamanakāraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇādīnāṃ kṣemaṃ ca kathayitvā gopīduḥkha-sāṃtvanakaraṇam, gopībhiḥ pṛthaktvena praṇayakopabhaṅgayā śrīkṛṣṇalīlāvarṇanam, tataḥ śrīkṛpṇadidṛkṣayotkaṇṭhitānāṃ tāsāṃ gopikānāṃ samūhena sahoddhavasya mayasa-rasyāgamanam, gopībhiḥ kṛtaṃ śokaṃ jñātvā śrīkṛṣṇasyākasmāttatra sarasyāgamanam, śrīkṛṣṇadarśanena gopīnāṃ bahvāhlādaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇagopīsaṃvāde tatsarasi snānadānapū-
jādividhimaṃtrakathanam, mayanirmitasaromāhātmyavaṇarnam-....... .... 292 2
15.45.d:
12 गोप्रचारतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णने कंसवधोत्तरं श्रीकृष्णेनोद्धवस्य स्वकुशलकथनार्थं गोपी-कुशलज्ञानार्थं गोप्युपदेशविधानार्थं च गोकुले संप्रेषणम्, उद्धवमागतं दृष्ट्वा नंदा-दिभिरुद्धवस्यातिथ्यासनादिसत्कारकरणम्, गोपीभिरुद्धवायागमनकारणप्रश्नक-रणम्, उद्धवेनापि स्वागमनकारणं श्रीकृष्णादीनां क्षेमं च कथयित्वा गोपीदुःख-सांत्वनकरणम्, गोपीभिः पृथक्त्वेन प्रणयकोपभङ्गया श्रीकृष्णलीलावर्णनम्, ततः श्रीकृप्णदिदृक्षयोत्कण्ठितानां तासां गोपिकानां समूहेन सहोद्धवस्य मयस-रस्यागमनम्, गोपीभिः कृतं शोकं ज्ञात्वा श्रीकृष्णस्याकस्मात्तत्र सरस्यागमनम्, श्रीकृष्णदर्शनेन गोपीनां बह्वाह्लादः, श्रीकृष्णगोपीसंवादे तत्सरसि स्नानदानपू-
जादिविधिमंत्रकथनम्, मयनिर्मितसरोमाहात्म्यवणर्नम्-....... .... 292 2
15.45.m: 12. In the description of the māhātmya of Gopracāratīrtha, after the slaying of Kaṃsa, Śrī Kṛṣṇa sending Uddhava to Gokula to report his own welfare, to inquire about the welfare of the gopīs, and to instruct the gopīs; Nanda and the others, seeing Uddhava arrived, honoring him with hospitality, seats, and the like; the gopīs questioning Uddhava regarding the purpose of his arrival; Uddhava also stating the reason for his arrival and the welfare of Śrī Kṛṣṇa and the others, and comforting the grief of the gopīs; the description of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's playful pastimes by the gopīs individually with feigned anger and affection; then Uddhava going to Mayasaras together with the assembly of those gopikās longing to see Śrī Kṛṣṇa; Śrī Kṛṣṇa suddenly arriving at that lake upon learning of the grief felt by the gopīs; the immense joy of the gopīs upon seeing Śrī Kṛṣṇa; in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs, recitation of the rules and mantras for ritual ablution, gifting, worship, and the like at that lake; description of the māhātmya of the lake built by Maya. ............ 292 2

15.45.s: 13 mayasarasa utpattivarṇanam, tatraiva gopībhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñayā'nyasarornirmāṇakaraṇam, tatraiva gopīsarasi śrīkṛṣṇena svāvasthānakaraṇam, śrīkṛṣṇena svamukhato gopīsarastīrthamāhātmyavarṇanam. ................ 294 1
15.45.d: 13 मयसरस उत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, तत्रैव गोपीभिः श्रीकृष्णाज्ञयाऽन्यसरोर्निर्माणकरणम्, तत्रैव गोपीसरसि श्रीकृष्णेन स्वावस्थानकरणम्, श्रीकृष्णेन स्वमुखतो गोपीसरस्तीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. ................ 294 1
15.45.m: 13. Description of the origin of Mayasaras; right there, the gopīs constructing another lake by the command of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; Śrī Kṛṣṇa taking up his residence right there at the Gopīsaras; description of the māhātmya of Gopīsarastīrtha from Śrī Kṛṣṇa's own mouth. ................ 294 1

17. Description of the sequence of rules for the worship of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; an account of the subduing of Rukmin's pride preceded by a description of the retinue of the Lord's attendants. . 298 1

15.45.s: 18 yajanadānaprāṇāyāmādyanyakarmato'pi śrīkṛṣṇadarśanasya phalādhikyavarṇanam, trivi-kramatīrthavarṇane valinigrahādivṛttāntasya samāsato varṇanam, gomatīsaṃgamasthacakra-tīrthe'nekatīrthānyaṭato durvāsasa āgamanam, yāvaddurvāsāḥ snānāya pravṛttastāvaddai-tyairdurvāsasaṃ prati bahutāḍanakaraṇam, tato daityakṛtatāḍanena duḥkhitasya durvāsaso balidvāḥsthavāmanāya daityakṛtāṃ nijadurdaśāṃ nivedayituṃ pātālaṃ prati gamanam, vāmanāya cakratīrthagatasarvavṛttāntakathanaṃ ca.... ....... 299 2
15.45.d: 18 यजनदानप्राणायामाद्यन्यकर्मतोऽपि श्रीकृष्णदर्शनस्य फलाधिक्यवर्णनम्, त्रिवि-क्रमतीर्थवर्णने वलिनिग्रहादिवृत्तान्तस्य समासतो वर्णनम्, गोमतीसंगमस्थचक्र-तीर्थेऽनेकतीर्थान्यटतो दुर्वासस आगमनम्, यावद्दुर्वासाः स्नानाय प्रवृत्तस्तावद्दै-त्यैर्दुर्वाससं प्रति बहुताडनकरणम्, ततो दैत्यकृतताडनेन दुःखितस्य दुर्वाससो बलिद्वाःस्थवामनाय दैत्यकृतां निजदुर्दशां निवेदयितुं पातालं प्रति गमनम्, वामनाय चक्रतीर्थगतसर्ववृत्तान्तकथनं च.... ....... 299 2
15.45.m: 18. Description of the superior fruits of the darśana of Śrī Kṛṣṇa even beyond sacrifices, gifts, breath-control, and other rites; in the description of Trivikramatīrtha, a brief narration of the restraint of Bali and other events; the arrival of Durvāsas, while wandering to many sacred fords, at Cakratīrtha situated at the confluence of the Gomatī; just as Durvāsas set about to take his ritual ablution, demons severely beating Durvāsas; then Durvāsas, afflicted by the beating delivered by the demons, going to Pātāla to report his own miserable plight inflicted by the demons to Vāmana who stands as doorkeeper to Bali; and his recounting to Vāmana of everything that occurred at Cakratīrtha. ............... 299 2

15.45.s: 19 vāmanena taddurvāsaso vacanaṃ śrutvā parādhīnatvānnaiva mayi svātantryamiti durvāsasaṃ kathayitvā yadi balerājñā bhavettarhyahaṃ daityanāśārthamāgamiṣyāmīti ca śaṃsitvā durvāsasaṃ prati balerājñāgrahaṇāya preraṇam, tato balinā durvāsasaḥ prārthanāmanaṅgī-kṛtya bhagavataścaraṇayordṛḍhagrahaṇam, tato bhagavatā svarūpasya vṛddhikaraṇapūrvakaṃ durvā-sasā balabhadreṇa ca saha cakratīrthe gamanam, tatra cakratīrthe kṛṣṇabalarāmadurvāsasāmā-gamanottaraṃ durvāsasaḥ snānādyāhnikavidhividhānavarṇanam ......... 300 2
15.45.d: 19 वामनेन तद्दुर्वाससो वचनं श्रुत्वा पराधीनत्वान्नैव मयि स्वातन्त्र्यमिति दुर्वाससं कथयित्वा यदि बलेराज्ञा भवेत्तर्ह्यहं दैत्यनाशार्थमागमिष्यामीति च शंसित्वा दुर्वाससं प्रति बलेराज्ञाग्रहणाय प्रेरणम्, ततो बलिना दुर्वाससः प्रार्थनामनङ्गी-कृत्य भगवतश्चरणयोर्दृढग्रहणम्, ततो भगवता स्वरूपस्य वृद्धिकरणपूर्वकं दुर्वा-ससा बलभद्रेण च सह चक्रतीर्थे गमनम्, तत्र चक्रतीर्थे कृष्णबलरामदुर्वाससामा-गमनोत्तरं दुर्वाससः स्नानाद्याह्निकविधिविधानवर्णनम् ......... 300 2
15.45.m: 19. Hearing those words of Durvāsas, Vāmana saying to Durvāsas: 'Because I am dependent on another, I have no freedom; and if there is Bali's permission, then I shall go to destroy the demons', and directing Durvāsas to obtain Bali's permission; then Bali refusing Durvāsas's request and holding firmly onto the feet of the Lord; then the Lord, after expanding his form, going to Cakratīrtha together with Durvāsas and Balabhadra; after the arrival of Kṛṣṇa, Balarāma, and Durvāsas at that Cakratīrtha, description of Durvāsas performing the daily rites of ritual ablution and the like. ......... 300 2

15.45.s:
20 tatra gomatītīrasthacakratīrthe vedādhyayanakāriṇaṃ durvāsasamavekṣya taṃ prati tāḍanaṃ kartuṃ tatpradeśarakṣakasya daityasyāgamanam, samāgataṃ taṃ daitya dṛṣṭvā śrīkṛṣṇena tasya daityasya
sudarśanacakreṇa śiraśchedakaraṇam, taṃ daityaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā'nyadaityaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇabalarā-mābhyāṃ saha yuddhavarṇanam, tataḥ kuśadaityasya balarāmaśrīkṛpṇābhyāṃ yuddhavarṇanam, tatra śrīkṛṣṇena kuśarākṣasaṃ hastagataṃ kṛtvā tasyopari śivaliṃgasthāpanavṛttāṃtavarṇanam 301 1
15.45.d:
20 तत्र गोमतीतीरस्थचक्रतीर्थे वेदाध्ययनकारिणं दुर्वाससमवेक्ष्य तं प्रति ताडनं कर्तुं तत्प्रदेशरक्षकस्य दैत्यस्यागमनम्, समागतं तं दैत्य दृष्ट्वा श्रीकृष्णेन तस्य दैत्यस्य
सुदर्शनचक्रेण शिरश्छेदकरणम्, तं दैत्यं निहतं दृष्ट्वाऽन्यदैत्यैः श्रीकृष्णबलरा-माभ्यां सह युद्धवर्णनम्, ततः कुशदैत्यस्य बलरामश्रीकृप्णाभ्यां युद्धवर्णनम्, तत्र श्रीकृष्णेन कुशराक्षसं हस्तगतं कृत्वा तस्योपरि शिवलिंगस्थापनवृत्तांतवर्णनम् 301 1
15.45.m: 20. Description of the arrival of the Daitya guarding that region to strike Durvāsas who was studying the Veda at the Cakra-tīrtha located on the bank of the Gomatī; of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, seeing the arrived Daitya, severing the Daitya's head with the Sudarśana discus; of the battle with Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma waged by the other Daityas upon seeing that Daitya slain; then of the battle of the Daitya Kuśa with Balarāma and Śrī Kṛṣṇa; of the account of Śrī Kṛṣṇa seizing the demon Kuśa and installing a Śiva liṅga upon him. 301 1
21. Then, in the dialogue between the demon Kuśa and Śrī Kṛṣṇa, description of the māhātmya of the worship of the Lord in the sacred field situated on the bank of the Gomatī. 303 2
22. Description of the māhātmya of the worship of Rukmiṇī. 303 2

15.45.s: 23 śrīkṛṣṇakathāphalaśrutivarṇanam, dvārakāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇadarśanaphalavarṇanam, rukyiṇīdarśana-phalavarṇanam, dvāravatīgamanadarśanasmaraṇaphalakathanam, svargaṃ gantuṃ niśreṇībhūtāyā dvārakāyā māhātmyavarṇanaprasaṃgena candraśarmabrāhmaṇavṛttāntavarṇanam, tatra candraśarmaṇo dvārakāpuryagamanena śaivavratānāṃ naiṣphalyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatpitṛbhiḥ svapna āgatya tasmā upadeśakaraṇam, pitṛṇāmupadeśaṃ śrutvā candraśarmaṇā brāhmaṇena dvārakāgamanena pitṝṇāṃ narakataḥ samuddharaṇavarṇanam, dvārakāśrayakaraṇaphalakathanam, dvārakāgamana-māhātmyatulasīdhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanam-... ... .... 305 1
15.45.d: 23 श्रीकृष्णकथाफलश्रुतिवर्णनम्, द्वारकायां श्रीकृष्णदर्शनफलवर्णनम्, रुक्यिणीदर्शन-फलवर्णनम्, द्वारवतीगमनदर्शनस्मरणफलकथनम्, स्वर्गं गन्तुं निश्रेणीभूताया द्वारकाया माहात्म्यवर्णनप्रसंगेन चन्द्रशर्मब्राह्मणवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, तत्र चन्द्रशर्मणो द्वारकापुर्यगमनेन शैवव्रतानां नैष्फल्यं दृष्ट्वा तत्पितृभिः स्वप्न आगत्य तस्मा उपदेशकरणम्, पितृणामुपदेशं श्रुत्वा चन्द्रशर्मणा ब्राह्मणेन द्वारकागमनेन पितॄणां नरकतः समुद्धरणवर्णनम्, द्वारकाश्रयकरणफलकथनम्, द्वारकागमन-माहात्म्यतुलसीधारणमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्-... ... .... 305 1
15.45.m: 23. Description of the hearing of the fruits of the narrative of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; description of the fruit of the darśana of Śrī Kṛṣṇa in Dvārakā; description of the fruit of the darśana of Rukmiṇī; statement of the fruit of journeying to, seeing, and remembering Dvāravatī; in connection with the description of the māhātmya of Dvārakā serving as a ladder to ascend to heaven, description of the account of the brahmin Candraśarman; therein, seeing the fruitlessness of his Śaiva vows because Candraśarman did not go to the city of Dvārakā, the instruction given to him by his ancestors who appeared in a dream; hearing the instruction of the ancestors, description of the deliverance of the ancestors from hell by the brahmin Candraśarman through his journey to Dvārakā; statement of the fruit of taking refuge in Dvārakā; description of the māhātmya of journeying to Dvārakā and the māhātmya of wearing tulasī. 305 1
24. Description of the māhātmya of the supremacy of the city of Dvārakā, beginning with the journey to Dvārakā and receiving boons granted by Kṛṣṇa. 309 1
25. In the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Indradyumna, description of the māhātmya of Vañjulī, Dvārakā, Gaṅgā, Gayā, Govinda, Gomatī, Gokula, Gītā, and gopīcandana. 311 1

26. Statement of the means to wash away the fourfold sin acquired over ten million lifetimes; description of the characteristics of a devotee of the Lord; statement of the fruit of a night-vigil for Hari; statement of the fruit of gifting cows, gold, sesame seeds, garments, and other offerings; statement of the fruit of daily reciting the Bhāgavata, Skanda [Purāṇa], the exploits of the Gopīs, the Gītā, the thousand names, and the like; description of the māhātmya of the night-vigil on the twelfth lunar day. 312 2
27. Description of the māhātmya of the twelfth-day night-vigil of Viṣṇu, preceded by the description of its superiority over all else. 313 2
28. Description of the arrival of all deities, sacred fords, and sacred fields at the site of the twelfth-day night-vigil of Viṣṇu; description of the māhātmya of the twelfth-day night-vigil. 314 1

15.45.s: 29 pāpijanasaṃsargādaśuddhiṃ gatāyā gautamyā nāradādyṛṣīnprati svāśuddhinirasanopāya-vijñānāya praśnakaraṇam, tasyā gautamyāḥ praśnasyottaraṃ dātumaśakyatayā vimohi-tānnāradādīndṛṣṭvā gautamyā śokakaraṇam, tato gautamīduḥkhaparihārāya divya-vāṇyā dvārakākṣetraṃ gaccheti gautamyai kathanam, tato dvārakāgamanotsukatāpūrvaka-gomatīvarṇanam 30 nāradagautamayordvārakāgamanotsukatādarśanam, dvārakāṃ prati godāvaryāditīrthakṣetradeva-maharṣigamanotsavayātrāvarṇanam............ .. 316 2
15.45.d: 29 पापिजनसंसर्गादशुद्धिं गताया गौतम्या नारदाद्यृषीन्प्रति स्वाशुद्धिनिरसनोपाय-विज्ञानाय प्रश्नकरणम्, तस्या गौतम्याः प्रश्नस्योत्तरं दातुमशक्यतया विमोहि-तान्नारदादीन्दृष्ट्वा गौतम्या शोककरणम्, ततो गौतमीदुःखपरिहाराय दिव्य-वाण्या द्वारकाक्षेत्रं गच्छेति गौतम्यै कथनम्, ततो द्वारकागमनोत्सुकतापूर्वक-गोमतीवर्णनम् 30 नारदगौतमयोर्द्वारकागमनोत्सुकतादर्शनम्, द्वारकां प्रति गोदावर्यादितीर्थक्षेत्रदेव-महर्षिगमनोत्सवयात्रावर्णनम्............ .. 316 2
15.45.m: 29. Gautamī, having become impure due to contact with sinners, questioning seers such as Nārada in order to learn the means to dispel her impurity; Gautamī grieving upon seeing Nārada and the others bewildered and unable to answer Gautamī's question; then, to relieve Gautamī's distress, a divine voice telling Gautamī, “Go to the sacred field of Dvārakā”; then description of the Gomatī preceded by eagerness to go to Dvārakā; 30. Seeing the eagerness of Nārada and Gautamī to go to Dvārakā; description of the festive pilgrimage of sacred fords, sacred fields, gods, and great seers—beginning with Godāvarī—heading towards Dvārakā. 316 2
31. Description of the arrival there of all sacred fords and sacred fields; darśana of Dvāravatī in embodied form. 317 1

15.45.s: 32 nāradādibhirdvārakāgamanaṃ kṛtvā''hlādavaśānnṛtyakaraṇam, śaṅkarādidevairgautamādyṛṣibhi- rgautamyāditīrthakṣetrairapi dvārakāyāṃ nṛtyakaraṇam; tataḥ sarvairbhagavaddarśanaṃ gṛhītvā bhagavatstutikaraṇam, viṣṇupārṣadavarṇitadvārakāmāhātmyavarṇanam ... .... 318 1
15.45.d: 32 नारदादिभिर्द्वारकागमनं कृत्वा'ऽह्लादवशान्नृत्यकरणम्, शङ्करादिदेवैर्गौतमाद्यृषिभि- र्गौतम्यादितीर्थक्षेत्रैरपि द्वारकायां नृत्यकरणम्; ततः सर्वैर्भगवद्दर्शनं गृहीत्वा भगवत्स्तुतिकरणम्, विष्णुपार्षदवर्णितद्वारकामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... .... 318 1
15.45.m: 32. Nārada and the others, having arrived at Dvārakā, dancing out of intense joy; gods beginning with Śaṅkara, seers beginning with Gautama, and also sacred fords and sacred fields beginning with Gautamī dancing in Dvārakā; then all of them receiving the darśana of the Lord and singing praise to the Lord; description of the māhātmya of Dvārakā related by an attendant of Viṣṇu. 318 1
33. Description of many sacred fords and sacred fields—beginning with Kāśī, Gayā, and Prayāga—taking up residence all around in every direction of Dvārakā. 320 1

15.45.s: 34 dvārakāpānthadarśanamātrataḥ kāśyāṃ kṛtasya pāpavajralepasya vināśane yativṛttānta-pūrvakaṃ dilīpakṛtadvārakāyātrāmāhātmyavarṇanam ..... ... 320 2
15.45.d: 34 द्वारकापान्थदर्शनमात्रतः काश्यां कृतस्य पापवज्रलेपस्य विनाशने यतिवृत्तान्त-पूर्वकं दिलीपकृतद्वारकायात्रामाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ..... ... 320 2
15.45.m: 34. Description of the māhātmya of the pilgrimage to Dvārakā made by Dilīpa, introduced by the account of an ascetic regarding the destruction, merely by the sight of a traveler to Dvārakā, of an adamantine coat of sin contracted in Kāśī. 320 2

15.45.d: 35 द्वारकाक्षेत्रस्थस्थावरजङ्गमपदार्थानां माहात्म्यवर्णनम्, द्वारकावासमाहात्म्यम्, द्वार-कायां भगवद्दर्शनमाहात्म्यम्, द्वारकानाममाहात्म्यवर्णनम्..... 322 1
15.45.m: 35. Description of the māhātmya of the stationary and moving entities in the sacred field of Dvārakā; māhātmya of residing in Dvārakā; māhātmya of receiving the darśana of the Lord in Dvārakā; description of the māhātmya of the name Dvārakā. 322 1
36. Description of the māhātmya of the ritual rules for seeing Dvārakā and bathing in the river Gomatī. 323 1

37. Statement of the fruit of worshipping the stones marked with infinite emblems of the discus—foremost among them Sudarśana—found in the sacred field of Dvārakā, preceded by the description of their māhātmya. 323 2
38. Description of the māhātmya of holding a night-vigil and other rites at Dvārakā and Cakra-tīrtha on the bank of the Gomatī. 324 1
39. Description of the māhātmya of the vow of the twelfth lunar day and related observances. 325 1
40. Description of the māhātmya of ritual ablution, giving gifts, performing ancestral rites, and other ceremonies at Cakra-tīrtha during the month of Kārttika. 326 1
41. Description of the good fruit of ritual ablution in the Gomatī, worship of Kṛṣṇa, feeding ascetics, giving gifts, ancestral rites, and other deeds. 327 1
42. Description of the fruit of performing the setting free of a bull and other rituals, and of hearing the Dvārakā-māhātmya. 327 1

15.45.s: 43 dvārakāmāhātmyaśravaṇādiphalaśrutivarṇanapuraḥsaratulasīpatrakāṣṭhamahimavarṇanapūrvakaṃ prahlā-dadvijasaṃvādasamāptyanantaraṃ balinā saha dvijaiḥ kṛtasya dvārakāyātrāvidhervarṇanam 328 1
15.45.d: 43 द्वारकामाहात्म्यश्रवणादिफलश्रुतिवर्णनपुरःसरतुलसीपत्रकाष्ठमहिमवर्णनपूर्वकं प्रह्ला-दद्विजसंवादसमाप्त्यनन्तरं बलिना सह द्विजैः कृतस्य द्वारकायात्राविधेर्वर्णनम् 328 1
15.45.m: 43. Description of the procedure for the pilgrimage to Dvārakā performed by the twice-born along with Bali following the conclusion of the dialogue between Prahlāda and the twice-born, preceded by the description of the greatness of the leaves and wood of tulasī and the statement of the hearing of fruits of hearing the Dvārakā-māhātmya. 328 1

44. Description of the account of the honor rendered to Sūta by the great seers led by Śaunaka, closing with the completion of the entire work of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, preceded by the description of the māhātmya of hearing, reciting, and gifting the manuscript of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, and worshipping the narrator of the Purāṇas and Vyāsa. 328 2
Thus ends the fourth [sub-section], the Dvārakāmāhātmyam, in the glorious Prabhāsakhaṇḍa. (7.4)

16.1.s:
.. athaśrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptamaṃ prabhāsakhaṇḍam .. 7 ..
.. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ..
.. atha prabhāsakhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate ..
.. tatredaṃ prathamaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyam .. 5 ..
oṃnamaḥ śrīparamātmane paramapuruṣottamāya ..
oṃ namo hariharahiraṇyagarbhebhyo namo vyāsavālmīkiśukaparāśarebhyaḥ ..
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
yaścādyaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇa iti yaḥ saṃstūyate sarvataḥ someśaḥ surasaṃyutaḥ kṣititale yairvīkṣito hīkṣaṇaiḥ..
te tīrtvā vitatāṃtaraṃ bhavabhayaṃ bhūtyā'bhisaṃbhūṣitāḥ svargaṃ yānavaraiḥprayānti sukṛtairyajñai yathā yajvinaḥ .. 1 ..
prasaradbindunādāya śuddhāmṛtamayātmane ..
ṣaḍtriṃśattattvadehāya namaścinmātramūrtaye .. 2 ..
amṛtenodarasthena mriyante sarvadevatāḥ ..
kaṃṭhasthita viṣeṇāpi yo jīvati sa pātuḥ vaḥ .. 3 ..
16.1.d:
.. अथश्रीस्कान्दे महापुराणे सप्तमं प्रभासखण्डम् .. 7 ..
.. श्रीगणेशाय नमः ..
.. अथ प्रभासखण्डं प्रारभ्यते ..
.. तत्रेदं प्रथमं प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यम् .. 5 ..
ओंनमः श्रीपरमात्मने परमपुरुषोत्तमाय ..
ओं नमो हरिहरहिरण्यगर्भेभ्यो नमो व्यासवाल्मीकिशुकपराशरेभ्यः ..
.. व्यास उवाच .. ..
यश्चाद्यः पुरुषः पुराण इति यः संस्तूयते सर्वतः सोमेशः सुरसंयुतः क्षितितले यैर्वीक्षितो हीक्षणैः..
ते तीर्त्वा विततांतरं भवभयं भूत्याऽभिसंभूषिताः स्वर्गं यानवरैःप्रयान्ति सुकृतैर्यज्ञै यथा यज्विनः .. 1 ..
प्रसरद्बिन्दुनादाय शुद्धामृतमयात्मने ..
षड्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वदेहाय नमश्चिन्मात्रमूर्तये .. 2 ..
अमृतेनोदरस्थेन म्रियन्ते सर्वदेवताः ..
कंठस्थित विषेणापि यो जीवति स पातुः वः .. 3 ..
16.1.m:
Now begins the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 7.
Obeisance to the glorious Gaṇeśa.
Now the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa begins.
Here begins the first, the māhātmya of the Prabhāsa sacred field. 5.
Oṃ, obeisance to the glorious Supreme Self, the Supreme Person.
Oṃ, obeisance to Hari, Hara, and Hiraṇyagarbha; obeisance to Vyāsa, Vālmīki, Śuka, and Parāśara.
Vyāsa said: / He who is the primeval Puruṣa, who is praised everywhere as ancient, / Someśa, accompanied by the gods—those by whose eyes he is beheld on the surface of the earth, / having crossed the vast expanse of the fear of worldly existence, adorned with sacred ash, / go to heaven in excellent aerial chariots, just as sacrificers [go] through well-performed sacrifices. 1.
To him who is expanding bindu and nāda, whose nature consists of pure nectar, / whose body is the thirty-six principles of reality, whose form is pure consciousness alone—obeisance. 2.
Though nectar rests within their bellies, all the gods perish; / may he who lives even with poison resting in his throat protect you! 3.

16.1.s:
satrānte sūtamanaghaṃ naimiṣeyā maharṣayaḥ..
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ puṇyāṃ papracchū romaharṣaṇam.. 4 ..
tvayā sūta mahā buddhe bhagavānbrahmavittamaḥ ..
itihāsapurāṇārthe vyāsaḥ samyagupāsitaḥ .. 5 ..
tasya te sarvaromāṇi vacasā harṣitāni yat ..
dvaipāyanasyānubhāvāttato'bhū romaharṣaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
bhavantameva prathamaṃ vyājahāra svayaṃ prabhuḥ ..
munīnāṃ saṃhitāṃ vaktuṃ vyāsaḥ paurāṇikīṃ kathām .. 7 ..
16.1.d:
सत्रान्ते सूतमनघं नैमिषेया महर्षयः..
पुराणसंहितां पुण्यां पप्रच्छू रोमहर्षणम्.. 4 ..
त्वया सूत महा बुद्धे भगवान्ब्रह्मवित्तमः ..
इतिहासपुराणार्थे व्यासः सम्यगुपासितः .. 5 ..
तस्य ते सर्वरोमाणि वचसा हर्षितानि यत् ..
द्वैपायनस्यानुभावात्ततोऽभू रोमहर्षणः .. 6 ..
भवन्तमेव प्रथमं व्याजहार स्वयं प्रभुः ..
मुनीनां संहितां वक्तुं व्यासः पौराणिकीं कथाम् .. 7 ..
16.1.m:
At the conclusion of the sacrificial session, the great seers dwelling in Naimiṣāraṇya / asked the sinless Sūta, Romaharṣaṇa, about the sacred Purāṇa collection: 4.
“By you, O Sūta of great intellect, the lord Vyāsa, the foremost knower of Brahman, / was properly served for the purpose of the Itihāsas and Purāṇas. 5.
Because all your bodily hairs thrilled with joy at his words, / by the power of Dvaipāyana, you therefore became known as Romaharṣaṇa. 6.
The Lord Vyāsa himself directly called upon you first / to recite the collection of purāṇic lore to the sages. 7.

16.1.s:
tvaṃ hi svāyaṃbhuve yajñe sutyāhe vitate hariḥ ..
saṃbhūtaḥ saṃhitāṃ vaktuṃ svāṃśena puruṣottamaḥ .. 8 ..
16.1.d:
त्वं हि स्वायंभुवे यज्ञे सुत्याहे वितते हरिः ..
संभूतः संहितां वक्तुं स्वांशेन पुरुषोत्तमः .. 8 ..
16.1.m: For in the sacrifice of Svāyambhuva, on the extensive day of soma-pressing, Hari, / the Supreme Person, was born by his own portion to recite the collection. 8.

16.1.s:
tasmādbhavantaṃ pṛcchāmaḥ purāṇe skandakīrtite ..
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brāhmī yātrā śrutā purā .. 9 ..
16.1.d:
तस्माद्भवन्तं पृच्छामः पुराणे स्कन्दकीर्तिते ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्राह्मी यात्रा श्रुता पुरा .. 9 ..
16.1.m: Therefore we ask you: in the Purāṇa proclaimed by Skanda, / in the māhātmya of the Prabhāsa sacred field, the pilgrimage pertaining to Brahmā was heard previously. 9.

16.1.s:
adhunā vaiṣṇavīṃ raudrīṃ yātrāṃ sarvārthasaṃyutām ..
vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ purāṇārthaviśārada .. 7.1.1.10 ..
16.1.d:
अधुना वैष्णवीं रौद्रीं यात्रां सर्वार्थसंयुताम् ..
वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं पुराणार्थविशारद .. 7.1.1.10 ..
16.1.m: Now, O expert in the meaning of the Purāṇas, / you ought to tell us of the pilgrimage pertaining to Viṣṇu and that pertaining to Rudra, which bestow all aims. 7.1.1.10.

16.1.s:
munīnā vacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ ..
praṇamya śirasā prāha vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam .. 11 ..
16.1.d:
मुनीना वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा प्राह व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम् .. 11 ..
16.1.m: Having heard the words of the sages, Sūta, the best of purāṇic narrators, / bowed his head to Vyāsa, the son of Satyavatī, and spoke: 11.

16.1.s:
.. romaharṣaṇa uvāca .. ..
śrīvatsāṃkaṃ jagadyoniṃ harimoṃkārarūpiṇam ..
aprameyaṃ guruṃ devaṃ nirmalaṃ nirmalāśrayam .. 12 ..
16.1.d:
.. रोमहर्षण उवाच .. ..
श्रीवत्सांकं जगद्योनिं हरिमोंकाररूपिणम् ..
अप्रमेयं गुरुं देवं निर्मलं निर्मलाश्रयम् .. 12 ..
16.1.m: Romaharṣaṇa said: / [Bowing to] Hari, marked with the Śrīvatsa, the source of the universe, who has the form of the syllable Oṃ, / the immeasurable, the guru, the deity, the taintless one, the refuge of the taintless, 12.

16.1.s:
haṃsaṃ śuciṣadaṃ vyoma vyāpakaṃ sarvadaṃ śivam ..
udāsīnaṃ nirāyāsaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ nirañjanam .. 13 ..
16.1.d:
हंसं शुचिषदं व्योम व्यापकं सर्वदं शिवम् ..
उदासीनं निरायासं निष्प्रपञ्चं निरञ्जनम् .. 13 ..
16.1.m: the goose dwelling in the clear [sky], the all-pervading space, the giver of everything, the auspicious, / the indifferent, the effortless, the unmanifest, the taintless, 13.

16.1.s:
śūnyaṃ biṃdusvarūpaṃ tu dhyeyaṃ dhyānavivarjitam ..
asti nāstīti yaṃ prāhuḥ sudūre cāntike ca yat .. 14 ..
16.1.d:
शून्यं बिंदुस्वरूपं तु ध्येयं ध्यानविवर्जितम् ..
अस्ति नास्तीति यं प्राहुः सुदूरे चान्तिके च यत् .. 14 ..
16.1.m: the void, whose true form is the bindu, the object of meditation devoid of meditation, / whom they call ‘it is’ and ‘it is not,’ who is very far and also near, 14.

16.1.s:
manogrāhyaṃ paraṃ dhāma puruṣākhyaṃ jaganmayam ..
hṛtpaṃkajasamāsīnaṃ tejorūpaṃ nirindriyam .. 15 ..
16.1.d:
मनोग्राह्यं परं धाम पुरुषाख्यं जगन्मयम् ..
हृत्पंकजसमासीनं तेजोरूपं निरिन्द्रियम् .. 15 ..
16.1.m: grasped by the mind, the supreme abode, named Puruṣa, consisting of the world, / seated upon the lotus of the heart, whose form is splendour, devoid of sense organs— 15.

16.1.s:
evaṃvidhaṃ namaskṛtya paramātmānamīśvaram ..
kathāṃ vadiṣye dvividhāṃ dviśarīrāṃ tathaiva tu .. 16 ..
16.1.d:
एवंविधं नमस्कृत्य परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ..
कथां वदिष्ये द्विविधां द्विशरीरां तथैव तु .. 16 ..
16.1.m: having bowed to such a Supreme Self, the Lord, / I shall relate the twofold story, which likewise possesses two bodies. 16.

16.1.s:
divyabhāṣāsamopetāṃ vedādhiṣṭhānasaṃyutām ..
pañcasaṃdhisamāyuktāṃ ṣaḍalaṃkārabhūṣitām .. 17 ..
16.1.d:
दिव्यभाषासमोपेतां वेदाधिष्ठानसंयुताम् ..
पञ्चसंधिसमायुक्तां षडलंकारभूषिताम् .. 17 ..
16.1.m: endowed with divine speech, resting on the foundation of the Vedas, / accompanied by the five junctures, adorned with the six ornaments,

16.1.s:
saptasādhanasaṃyuktāṃ rasāṣṭaguṇaraṃjitām ..
guṇairnavabhirākīrṇāṃ daśadoṣavivarjitām .. 18 ..
16.1.d:
सप्तसाधनसंयुक्तां रसाष्टगुणरंजिताम् ..
गुणैर्नवभिराकीर्णां दशदोषविवर्जिताम् .. 18 ..
16.1.m: furnished with the seven expedients, delighting with the qualities of the eight sentiments, / filled with nine poetic merits, devoid of the ten faults,

16.1.s:
vibhāṣābhūṣitāṃ tadvadekāyattāṃ manoharām ..
pañcakāraṇasaṃyuktāṃ catuṣkaraṇasammatām ..19 ..
16.1.d:
विभाषाभूषितां तद्वदेकायत्तां मनोहराम् ..
पञ्चकारणसंयुक्तां चतुष्करणसम्मताम् ..19 ..
16.1.m: likewise adorned with secondary dialects, resting on a single [theme], captivating, / endowed with the five causes, approved by the four means of expression,

16.1.s:
Comments on Prabhaasa
punaśca dvividhāṃ tadvajjñānasaṃdohadāyinīm ..
vyāsena kathitāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ pāpanāśinīm .. 7.1.1.20 ..
16.1.d:
चोम्मेन्त्स् ओन् प्रभअस
पुनश्च द्विविधां तद्वज्ज्ञानसंदोहदायिनीम् ..
व्यासेन कथितां पुण्यां शृणुध्वं पापनाशिनीम् .. 7.1.1.20 ..
16.1.m: and furthermore twofold in nature, granting a multitude of wisdom, / spoken by Vyāsa, sacred, destroying sins: listen to it!

16.1.s:
yāṃ śrutvā pāpakarmāpi gaccheddhi paramāṃ gatim ..
duḥkhatrayavinirmuktaḥ sarvātaṅkavivarjitaḥ .. 21 ..
16.1.d:
यां श्रुत्वा पापकर्मापि गच्छेद्धि परमां गतिम् ..
दुःखत्रयविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वातङ्कविवर्जितः .. 21 ..
16.1.m: Hearing which even an evildoer would surely attain the highest state, / freed from the threefold misery, released from all distress.

16.1.s:
na nāstike kathāṃ puṇyāmimāṃ brūyātkadācana ..
śraddadhānāya śāntāya kīrtanīyā dvijātaye ..22 ..
16.1.d:
न नास्तिके कथां पुण्यामिमां ब्रूयात्कदाचन ..
श्रद्दधानाय शान्ताय कीर्तनीया द्विजातये ..22 ..
16.1.m: One should never narrate this sacred tale to an atheist; / it should be recited to a tranquil, faithful twice-born.

16.1.s:
niṣekādiḥ śmaśānānto mantrairyasyodito vidhiḥ ..
tasya śāstre'dhikāro'sti jñeyo nānyasya kasyacit.. 23 ..
16.1.d:
निषेकादिः श्मशानान्तो मन्त्रैर्यस्योदितो विधिः ..
तस्य शास्त्रेऽधिकारोऽस्ति ज्ञेयो नान्यस्य कस्यचित्.. 23 ..
16.1.m: He whose rites from conception to the cremation ground are prescribed with mantras / is known to have entitlement to this scripture, not anyone else.

16.1.s:
catuḥpakṣāvadātasya viśuddhirbrāhmaṇasya ca ..
sadvṛttasyādhikāro'sti śāstre'sminvedasammate .. 24 ..
16.1.d:
चतुःपक्षावदातस्य विशुद्धिर्ब्राह्मणस्य च ..
सद्वृत्तस्याधिकारोऽस्ति शास्त्रेऽस्मिन्वेदसम्मते .. 24 ..
16.1.m: And of a brahmin pure on all four sides, / of good conduct, there is eligibility in this scripture approved by the Vedas.

16.1.s:
yathā surāṇāṃ pravaro devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..
nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṃgā varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā .. 25 ..
16.1.d:
यथा सुराणां प्रवरो देवदेवो महेश्वरः ..
नदीनां च यथा गंगा वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो यथा .. 25 ..
16.1.m: Just as the god of gods, Maheśvara, is foremost among the gods, / and just as the Gaṅgā is among rivers, and the brahmin among the classes,

16.1.s:
akṣarāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāmoṃkāraḥ prathamo yathā ..
pūjyānāṃ tu yathā mātā gurūṇāṃ ca yathā pitā ..
tathaiva sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ skandakīrtitam .. 26 ..
16.1.d:
अक्षराणां तु सर्वेषामोंकारः प्रथमो यथा ..
पूज्यानां तु यथा माता गुरूणां च यथा पिता ..
तथैव सर्वशास्त्राणां प्रधानं स्कन्दकीर्तितम् .. 26 ..
16.1.m: and just as the sound Oṃ is first among all letters, / and just as a mother among those worthy of honor, and a father among elders, / even so the [scripture] proclaimed by Skanda is principal among all scriptures.

16.1.s:
purā kailāsaśikhare brahmādīnāṃ ca sannidhau ..
skāndaṃ purāṇaṃ kathitaṃ pārvatyagre pinākinā .. .. 27 ..
16.1.d:
पुरा कैलासशिखरे ब्रह्मादीनां च सन्निधौ ..
स्कान्दं पुराणं कथितं पार्वत्यग्रे पिनाकिना .. .. 27 ..
16.1.m: Formerly, upon the peak of Kailāsa, in the presence of Brahmā and the others, / the Skanda Purāṇa was spoken by the bearer of the Pināka before Pārvatī.

16.1.s:
pārvatyā ṣaṇmukhasyāgre tena nandigaṇāya vai ..
nandinā tu kumārāya tena vyāsāya dhīmate .. 28 ..
16.1.d:
पार्वत्या षण्मुखस्याग्रे तेन नन्दिगणाय वै ..
नन्दिना तु कुमाराय तेन व्यासाय धीमते .. 28 ..
16.1.m: By Pārvatī before the six-faced one; by him, indeed, to the host of Nandi; / by Nandi to Kumāra; and by him to the wise Vyāsa.

16.1.s: vyāsena me samākhyātaṃ bhavadbhyo'haṃ prakīrtaye .. 29 ..
16.1.d: व्यासेन मे समाख्यातं भवद्भ्योऽहं प्रकीर्तये .. 29 ..
16.1.m: By Vyāsa it was related to me; I proclaim it to you.

16.1.s:
yūyaṃ sadbhāvasaṃyuktā yataḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ ..
tena me bhāṣituṃ śraddhā bhavatāṃ skandasaṃhitām .. 7.1.1.30 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye praśnādhyāyavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 1 ..
16.1.d:
यूयं सद्भावसंयुक्ता यतः सर्वे महर्षयः ..
तेन मे भाषितुं श्रद्धा भवतां स्कन्दसंहिताम् .. 7.1.1.30 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये प्रश्नाध्यायवर्णनं नाम प्रथमोऽध्यायः .. 1 ..
16.1.m:
Since all of you great seers are endowed with pure devotion, / therefore I have the desire to declare the Skanda Compendium to you.
Thus ends the first chapter, named 'Description of the Chapter of Questions,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsa Kṣetra Māhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.2.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathāyā lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi guṇadoṣānsavistarān ..
ārṣeyapauruṣeyāṇāṃ kāvyacihnaparīkṣaṇam ..
kathaṃ jñeyaṃ mahābuddhe śrotumicchāmahe vayam .. 1 ..
16.2.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथाया लक्षणं ब्रूहि गुणदोषान्सविस्तरान् ..
आर्षेयपौरुषेयाणां काव्यचिह्नपरीक्षणम् ..
कथं ज्ञेयं महाबुद्धे श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् .. 1 ..
16.2.m: The seers said: / Declare the characteristics of a narrative, its merits and faults in detail, / and the examination of the poetic marks of sages' and human works; / how are they to be known, O highly intelligent one? We wish to hear.

16.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha saṃkṣepato vakṣye purāṇānāmanukramam ..
lakṣaṇaṃ caiva saṃkhyāṃ ca uktabhedāṃstathaiva ca .. 2 ..
16.2.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ संक्षेपतो वक्ष्ये पुराणानामनुक्रमम् ..
लक्षणं चैव संख्यां च उक्तभेदांस्तथैव च .. 2 ..
16.2.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall state concisely the order of the Purāṇas, / their characteristics, their number, and the divisions mentioned.

16.2.s:
purā tapaścacārogramamarāṇāṃ pitāmahaḥ ..
āvirbhūtāstato vedāḥ saṣaḍaṃgapadakramāḥ .. 3 ..
16.2.d:
पुरा तपश्चचारोग्रममराणां पितामहः ..
आविर्भूतास्ततो वेदाः सषडंगपदक्रमाः .. 3 ..
16.2.m: Formerly, the grandfather of the immortals performed fierce austerity; / from that the Vedas appeared, together with the six auxiliary limbs, word-recitations, and step-by-step recitations.

16.2.s:
tataḥ purāṇamakhilaṃ sarvaśāstramayaṃ dhruvam ..
nityaśabdamayaṃ puṇyaṃ śata koṭipravistaram .. 4 ..
16.2.d:
ततः पुराणमखिलं सर्वशास्त्रमयं ध्रुवम् ..
नित्यशब्दमयं पुण्यं शत कोटिप्रविस्तरम् .. 4 ..
16.2.m: Then the entire Purāṇa, consisting of all scriptures, enduring, / consisting of eternal sound, holy, extending to a billion [verses],

16.2.s:
nirgataṃ brahmaṇo vaktrādbrāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca ..
śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyakam .. 5 ..
16.2.d:
निर्गतं ब्रह्मणो वक्त्राद्ब्राह्मं वैष्णवमेव च ..
शैवं भागवतं चैव भविष्यं नारदीयकम् .. 5 ..
16.2.m: emerged from the mouth of Brahmā: the Brāhma, the Vaiṣṇava, / the Śaiva, the Bhāgavata, the Bhaviṣya, the Nāradīya,

16.2.s:
mārkaṇḍeyamathāgneyaṃ brahmavaivartameva ca ..
laiṅgaṃ tathā ca vārāhaṃ skāṃdaṃ vāmanameva ca .. 6 ..
16.2.d:
मार्कण्डेयमथाग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तमेव च ..
लैङ्गं तथा च वाराहं स्कांदं वामनमेव च .. 6 ..
16.2.m: the Mārkaṇḍeya, then the Āgneya, the Brahmavaivarta, / the Laiṅga, as well as the Vārāha, the Skānda, and the Vāmana,

16.2.s:
kaurmyaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍaṃ ca vāyavīyamanantaram ..
aṣṭādaśaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. .. 7 ..
16.2.d:
कौर्म्यं मात्स्यं गारुडं च वायवीयमनन्तरम् ..
अष्टादशं समुद्दिष्टं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. .. 7 ..
16.2.m: the Kaurma, the Mātsya, the Gāruḍa, and immediately following, the Vāyavīya: / [these] eighteen are declared, destroying all sins.

16.2.s: ekameva purā hyāsīdbrahmāṇḍaṃ śatakoṭidhā .. 8 ..
16.2.d: एकमेव पुरा ह्यासीद्ब्रह्माण्डं शतकोटिधा .. 8 ..
16.2.m: For formerly there was only one, the Brahmāṇḍa, in a hundred million [verses].

16.2.s:
tato'ṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā vedavyāso yugeyuge ..
prakhyāpayati loke'sminsākṣānnārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ .. 9 ..
16.2.d:
ततोऽष्टादशधा कृत्वा वेदव्यासो युगेयुगे ..
प्रख्यापयति लोकेऽस्मिन्साक्षान्नारायणांशजः .. 9 ..
16.2.m: Then, having divided it into eighteen, Veda Vyāsa, / born from a portion of Nārāyaṇa himself, makes it known in this world age after age.

16.2.s:
anyānyupapurāṇāni muninā kathitāni tu ..
tāni vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi saṃkṣepādavadhāryatām .. 7.1.2.10 ..
16.2.d:
अन्यान्युपपुराणानि मुनिना कथितानि तु ..
तानि वः कथयिष्यामि संक्षेपादवधार्यताम् .. 7.1.2.10 ..
16.2.m: Other secondary Purāṇas were spoken by the sage; / I will declare them to you; let them be heard in brief:

16.2.s:
ādyaṃ sanatkumāroktaṃ nārasiṃhamataḥ param ..
tṛtīyaṃ skāndamuddiṣṭaṃ kumāreṇānubhāṣitam .. 11..
16.2.d:
आद्यं सनत्कुमारोक्तं नारसिंहमतः परम् ..
तृतीयं स्कान्दमुद्दिष्टं कुमारेणानुभाषितम् .. 11..
16.2.m: The first is spoken by Sanatkumāra, and next to it the Nārasiṃha; / the third is taught as the Skānda, repeated by Kumāra;

16.2.s:
caturthaṃ śivadharmākhyaṃ sākṣānnandīśabhāṣitam..
durvāsasoktamāścaryyaṃ nāradoktamataḥ param ..12..
16.2.d:
चतुर्थं शिवधर्माख्यं साक्षान्नन्दीशभाषितम्..
दुर्वाससोक्तमाश्चर्य्यं नारदोक्तमतः परम् ..12..
16.2.m: the fourth is named Śivadharma, spoken by Nandīśa himself; / the wonderful [Purāṇa] spoken by Durvāsas, and next to it that spoken by Nārada;

16.2.s:
kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam..
brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ cānyatkālikāhvayameva ca.. 13..
16.2.d:
कापिलं मानवं चैव तथैवोशनसेरितम्..
ब्रह्माण्डं वारुणं चान्यत्कालिकाह्वयमेव च.. 13..
16.2.m: the Kāpila, the Mānava, and likewise that uttered by Uśanas; / the Brahmāṇḍa, the Vāruṇa, and another named Kālikā;

16.2.s:
māheśvaraṃ tathā sāṃbaṃ sauraṃ sarvārthasaṃcayam...
parāśaroktaṃ paramaṃ mārīcaṃ bhārgavāhvayam ..14..
16.2.d:
माहेश्वरं तथा सांबं सौरं सर्वार्थसंचयम्...
पराशरोक्तं परमं मारीचं भार्गवाह्वयम् ..14..
16.2.m: the Māheśvara, as well as the Sāmba, the Saura, a collection of all purposes; / the supreme one spoken by Parāśara, the Mārīca, and that named Bhārgava.

16.2.s: etānyupapurāṇāni kathitāni dvijottamāḥ..15..
16.2.d: एतान्युपपुराणानि कथितानि द्विजोत्तमाः..15..
16.2.m: These secondary Purāṇas have been declared, O best of the twice-born.

16.2.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
purāṇasaṃkhyāmācakṣva sūta vistaraśaḥ kramāt..
dānadharmamaśeṣajña yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 16..
16.2.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
पुराणसंख्यामाचक्ष्व सूत विस्तरशः क्रमात्..
दानधर्ममशेषज्ञ यथावदनुपूर्वशः .. 16..
16.2.m: The seers said: / Tell in detail and in order, Sūta, the verse count of the Purāṇas, / and the duty of giving, O knower of everything, properly and successively.

16.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
idameva purāṇe'sminpurāṇapuruṣastadā ..
yaduktavānsa viśvātmā manave tannibodhata ..17..
16.2.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
इदमेव पुराणेऽस्मिन्पुराणपुरुषस्तदा ..
यदुक्तवान्स विश्वात्मा मनवे तन्निबोधत ..17..
16.2.m: Sūta said: / What the ancient Spirit, the self of the universe, said to Manu / at that time regarding this very Purāṇa, understand that:

16.2.s:
purāṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam ..
anantaraṃ ca vaktrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ..18..
16.2.d:
पुराणं सर्वशास्त्राणां ब्रह्माण्डं प्रथमं स्मृतम् ..
अनन्तरं च वक्त्रेभ्यो वेदास्तस्य विनिर्गताः..18..
16.2.m: The Purāṇa called Brahmāṇḍa is remembered as the first of all scriptures; / and thereafter the Vedas came forth from his mouths.

16.2.s:
purāṇamekamevāsīttasminkalpāntaretathā..
trivargasādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram .. 19..
16.2.d:
पुराणमेकमेवासीत्तस्मिन्कल्पान्तरेतथा..
त्रिवर्गसाधनं पुण्यं शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् .. 19..
16.2.m: There was only one Purāṇa in that intermediate kalpa, / the holy means to attain the three goals of life, extending to a billion [verses].

16.2.s:
vinirdagdheṣu lokeṣu kṛṣṇenānantarūpiṇā ..
sāṅgāṃśca caturo vedānpurāṇanyāyavistaram ..7.1.2.20...
16.2.d:
विनिर्दग्धेषु लोकेषु कृष्णेनानन्तरूपिणा ..
साङ्गांश्च चतुरो वेदान्पुराणन्यायविस्तरम् ..7.1.2.20...
16.2.m: When the worlds were burned up, Kṛṣṇa, whose form is infinite, / gathered together the four Vedas along with their auxiliary limbs, the expanse of Purāṇas and logic,

16.2.s:
mīmāṃsāṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca parigṛhyātmasātkṛtam ..
matsyarūpeṇa ca punaḥ kalpādāvudakārṇave..21..
16.2.d:
मीमांसां धर्मशास्त्रं च परिगृह्यात्मसात्कृतम् ..
मत्स्यरूपेण च पुनः कल्पादावुदकार्णवे..21..
16.2.m: Mīmāṃsā, and the treatise on dharma, assimilating them into himself; / and again, in the form of a fish, at the beginning of the kalpa in the ocean of waters,

16.2.s:
aśeṣameva kathitaṃ brahmaṇe divyacakṣuṣe ..
brahmā jagāda ca munīṃstrikālajñānadarśanaḥ .. 22 ..
16.2.d:
अशेषमेव कथितं ब्रह्मणे दिव्यचक्षुषे ..
ब्रह्मा जगाद च मुनींस्त्रिकालज्ञानदर्शनः .. 22 ..
16.2.m: he narrated it in its entirety to Brahmā who possessed divine vision; / and Brahmā, seeing knowledge of the three times, declared it to the sages.

16.2.s: pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇasyābhavattataḥ .. 23 ..
16.2.d: प्रवृत्तिः सर्वशास्त्राणां पुराणस्याभवत्ततः .. 23 ..
16.2.m: From that came the emergence of all scriptures and the Purāṇa.

16.2.s:
tataḥ kālakrameṇāsau vyāsarūpadharo hariḥ ..
aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni saṃkṣepsyati yugeyuge .. 24 ..
16.2.d:
ततः कालक्रमेणासौ व्यासरूपधरो हरिः ..
अष्टादशपुराणानि संक्षेप्स्यति युगेयुगे .. 24 ..
16.2.m: Then, in the course of time, Hari, assuming the form of Vyāsa, / condenses the eighteen Purāṇas age after age,

16.2.s:
caturlakṣapramāṇāni dvāparedvāpare sadā ..
tadāṣṭādaśadhā kṛṣṇā bhūrloke'sminprabhāṣate .. 25 ..
16.2.d:
चतुर्लक्षप्रमाणानि द्वापरेद्वापरे सदा ..
तदाष्टादशधा कृष्णा भूर्लोकेऽस्मिन्प्रभाषते .. 25 ..
16.2.m: to a measure of four hundred thousand [verses] always in each Dvāpara; / then, having made it eighteenfold, Kṛṣṇa proclaims it in this world of mortals.

16.2.s:
adyā'pi devaloke tu śatakoṭipravistaram ..
tadartho'tra caturlakṣaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa niveśitaḥ .. 26 ..
16.2.d:
अद्याऽपि देवलोके तु शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् ..
तदर्थोऽत्र चतुर्लक्षः संक्षेपेण निवेशितः .. 26 ..
16.2.m: Even today, however, in the realm of the gods it extends to a billion [verses]; / its meaning here has been abridged and arranged into four hundred thousand.

16.2.s:
purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca sāṃprataṃ tadihocyate..
nāmatastāni vakṣyāmi saṃkhyāṃ ca munisattamāḥ .. 27 ..
16.2.d:
पुराणानि दशाष्टौ च सांप्रतं तदिहोच्यते..
नामतस्तानि वक्ष्यामि संख्यां च मुनिसत्तमाः .. 27 ..
16.2.m: The eighteen Purāṇas are now stated here; / I shall declare them by name and number, O best of sages.

16.2.s:
brahmaṇā'bhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ yāvanmātraṃ marīcaye ..
brāhmaṃ taddaśasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ tadihocyate .. 28 ..
16.2.d:
ब्रह्मणाऽभिहितं पूर्वं यावन्मात्रं मरीचये ..
ब्राह्मं तद्दशसाहस्रं पुराणं तदिहोच्यते .. 28 ..
16.2.m: That which was spoken formerly by Brahmā to Marīci, just that amount— / that Brāhma Purāṇa of ten thousand [verses] is spoken of here.

16.2.s:
likhitvā tacca yo dadyājjaladhenusamanvitam ..
vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca brahmaloke mahīyate .. 29 ..
16.2.d:
लिखित्वा तच्च यो दद्याज्जलधेनुसमन्वितम् ..
वैशाख्यां पौर्णमास्यां च ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 29 ..
16.2.m: Whoever writes it down and gives it away accompanied by a water-cow / on the full moon day of the month of Vaiśākha is honored in the world of Brahmā.

16.2.s:
etadeva yadā padmamabhūddhairaṇmayaṃ jagat ..
tadvṛttāṃtāśrayāṃtaṃ tatpādmamityucyate budhaiḥ .. 7.1.2.30 ..
16.2.d:
एतदेव यदा पद्ममभूद्धैरण्मयं जगत् ..
तद्वृत्तांताश्रयांतं तत्पाद्ममित्युच्यते बुधैः .. 7.1.2.30 ..
16.2.m: When this very universe became a golden lotus, / based upon that event, it is called Pādma by the wise.

16.2.s:
pādmaṃ tatpañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇīha paṭhyate ..
tatpurāṇaṃ ca yo dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam ..
jyeṣṭhe māsi tilairyuktaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 31 ..
16.2.d:
पाद्मं तत्पञ्चपञ्चाशत्सहस्राणीह पठ्यते ..
तत्पुराणं च यो दद्यात्सुवर्णकमलान्वितम् ..
ज्येष्ठे मासि तिलैर्युक्तं सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 31 ..
16.2.m: That Pādma is recited here as consisting of fifty-five thousand [verses]. / And whoever should donate that Purāṇa along with a golden lotus, / accompanied by sesame seeds in the month of Jyeṣṭha, he obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

16.2.s:
vārāhakalpavṛttāntamadhikṛtya parātparaḥ ..
yatrāha dharmānakhilāṃstaduktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ ..32..
16.2.d:
वाराहकल्पवृत्तान्तमधिकृत्य परात्परः ..
यत्राह धर्मानखिलांस्तदुक्तं वैष्णवं विदुः ..32..
16.2.m: Taking as its subject the events of the Vārāha Kalpa, the Supreme / proclaimed all duties; what is stated therein is known as the Vaiṣṇava.

16.2.s:
caritairañcitaṃ viṣṇostalloke vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ ..
trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam .. 33 ..
16.2.d:
चरितैरञ्चितं विष्णोस्तल्लोके वैष्णवं विदुः ..
त्रयोविंशतिसाहस्रं पुराणं तत्प्रकीर्तितम् .. 33 ..
16.2.m: Adorned with the deeds of Viṣṇu, it is known as the Vaiṣṇava in the world; / that Purāṇa is declared to have twenty-three thousand [verses].

16.2.s:
tadāṣāḍhe ca yo dadyādghṛtadhenusamanvitam ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ viśuddhāyāṃ saṃ padaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam .. 34 ..
16.2.d:
तदाषाढे च यो दद्याद्घृतधेनुसमन्वितम् ..
पौर्णमास्यां विशुद्धायां सं पदं याति वैष्णवम् .. 34 ..
16.2.m: And whoever should donate it in Āṣāḍha along with a cow made of clarified butter / on the clear full moon day, he goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

16.2.s:
śrutakalpaprasaṅgena dharmānvāyurathābravīt ..
yatra tadvāyavīyaṃ syādrudramāhātmyasaṃyutam .. 35 ..
16.2.d:
श्रुतकल्पप्रसङ्गेन धर्मान्वायुरथाब्रवीत् ..
यत्र तद्वायवीयं स्याद्रुद्रमाहात्म्यसंयुतम् .. 35 ..
16.2.m: In connection with the Śruta Kalpa, Vāyu then declared duties; / where that is contained, it is the Vāyavīya, accompanied by the māhātmya of Rudra.

16.2.s:
caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ nānā vṛttāntasaṃyutam ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣaiśca sādhuvṛttasamanvitam.. 36 ..
16.2.d:
चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रं नाना वृत्तान्तसंयुतम् ..
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षैश्च साधुवृत्तसमन्वितम्.. 36 ..
16.2.m: It contains twenty-four thousand [verses] with various narratives, / and is endowed with the conduct of the virtuous along with dharma, artha, kāma, and mokṣa.

16.2.s:
śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi guḍadhenusamanvitam ..
yo dadyāddadhisaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine ..
śivaloke sa pūtātmā kalpamekaṃ vasennaraḥ .. 37 ..
16.2.d:
श्रावण्यां श्रावणे मासि गुडधेनुसमन्वितम् ..
यो दद्याद्दधिसंयुक्तं ब्राह्मणाय कुटुम्बिने ..
शिवलोके स पूतात्मा कल्पमेकं वसेन्नरः .. 37 ..
16.2.m: On the full moon day of the month of Śrāvaṇa, whoever should donate it / accompanied by a cow made of molasses and curds to a householder brahmin, / that man, purified in soul, will dwell in the world of Śiva for one kalpa.

16.2.s:
punaḥ saṃjāyate martyo brāhmaṇo vedavittamaḥ ..
vedavidyārthatattvajño vyākhyātattvārthavittamaḥ .. 38 ..
16.2.d:
पुनः संजायते मर्त्यो ब्राह्मणो वेदवित्तमः ..
वेदविद्यार्थतत्त्वज्ञो व्याख्यातत्त्वार्थवित्तमः .. 38 ..
16.2.m: He is born again as a mortal brahmin, foremost among knowers of the Veda, / knowing the true nature of Vedic lore and meaning, foremost among those who know the true meaning of commentaries.

16.2.s:
yatrādhikṛtya gāyatrīṃ varṇyate dharmavistaraḥ ..
vṛtrāsuravadhopetaṃ tadbhāgavatamucyate .. 39 ..
16.2.d:
यत्राधिकृत्य गायत्रीं वर्ण्यते धर्मविस्तरः ..
वृत्रासुरवधोपेतं तद्भागवतमुच्यते .. 39 ..
16.2.m: Where, taking the Gāyatrī as its subject, an extensive account of dharma is described, / and which contains the slaying of Vṛtrāsura, that is called the Bhāgavata.

16.2.s:
sārasvatasya kalpasya madhye ye syurnarāmarāḥ..
tadvṛttāntodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyodvāhasamanvitam .. 7.1.2.40 ..
16.2.d:
सारस्वतस्य कल्पस्य मध्ये ये स्युर्नरामराः..
तद्वृत्तान्तोद्भवं पुण्यं पुण्योद्वाहसमन्वितम् .. 7.1.2.40 ..
16.2.m: Whatever mortals and gods were in the middle of the Sārasvata Kalpa, / it arises from their narrative; it is meritorious and accompanied by holy marriages.

16.2.s:
likhitvā tacca yo dadyāddhemasiṃhasamanvitam ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. ..41..
16.2.d:
लिखित्वा तच्च यो दद्याद्धेमसिंहसमन्वितम् ..
पौर्णमास्यां प्रौष्ठपद्यां स याति परमां गतिम् .. ..41..
16.2.m: Having written it down, whoever donates it along with a golden lion / on the full moon day of Prauṣṭhapada, goes to the supreme state.

16.2.s: aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi purāṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam..42..
16.2.d: अष्टादशसहस्राणि पुराणं तत्प्रकीर्तितम्..42..
16.2.m: That Purāṇa is proclaimed to have eighteen thousand [verses].

16.2.s:
yatrāha nārado dharmānbṛhatkalpāśrayāṃstviha ..
pañcaviṃśatsahasrāṇi nāradīyaṃ taducyate ..43..
16.2.d:
यत्राह नारदो धर्मान्बृहत्कल्पाश्रयांस्त्विह ..
पञ्चविंशत्सहस्राणि नारदीयं तदुच्यते ..43..
16.2.m: Where Nārada declared duties here based on the Bṛhat Kalpa, / that, consisting of twenty-five thousand [verses], is called the Nāradīya.

16.2.s:
tadiṣe pañcadaśyāṃ tu yo dadyāddhenusaṃyutam..
uttamāṃ siddhimāpnoti iha loke paratra ca..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..44..
16.2.d:
तदिषे पञ्चदश्यां तु यो दद्याद्धेनुसंयुतम्..
उत्तमां सिद्धिमाप्नोति इह लोके परत्र च..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ..44..
16.2.m: Whoever gives it in Iṣa on the fifteenth day along with a cow, / attains the highest perfection in this world and in the next; / he obtains all desires; no doubt should be entertained here.

16.2.s:
yatrādhikṛtya śakunīndharmādharmavicāraṇam ..
purāṇaṃ navasāhasraṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ taducyate .. 45..
16.2.d:
यत्राधिकृत्य शकुनीन्धर्माधर्मविचारणम् ..
पुराणं नवसाहस्रं मार्कण्डेयं तदुच्यते .. 45..
16.2.m: Where, taking the birds as its subject, there is an inquiry into dharma and adharma, / that Purāṇa of nine thousand [verses] is called the Mārkaṇḍeya.

16.2.s:
parilikhya ca yo dadyātsauvarṇakarisaṃyutam ..
kārtikyāṃ pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalabhāgbhavet .. 46 ..
16.2.d:
परिलिख्य च यो दद्यात्सौवर्णकरिसंयुतम् ..
कार्तिक्यां पौण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलभाग्भवेत् .. 46 ..
16.2.m: Having copied it down, whoever donates it along with a golden elephant / on the Kārttika full moon day, becomes a sharer in the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.

16.2.s:
yattadīśānakalpasya vṛttāntamadhikṛtya ca ..
vaśiṣṭhāyā'gninā proktamāgneyaṃ tatpracakṣate .. 47 ..
16.2.d:
यत्तदीशानकल्पस्य वृत्तान्तमधिकृत्य च ..
वशिष्ठायाऽग्निना प्रोक्तमाग्नेयं तत्प्रचक्षते .. 47 ..
16.2.m: That which, based on the narrative of the Īśāna Kalpa, / was spoken to Vasiṣṭha by Agni, is declared to be the Āgneya.

16.2.s:
likhitvā tacca yo dadyāddhemapadmasamanvitam ..
mārgaśīrṣe vidhānena tiladhenuyutaṃ tathā ..
tacca ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ sarvakratuphalapradam .. 48 ..
16.2.d:
लिखित्वा तच्च यो दद्याद्धेमपद्मसमन्वितम् ..
मार्गशीर्षे विधानेन तिलधेनुयुतं तथा ..
तच्च षोडशसाहस्रं सर्वक्रतुफलप्रदम् .. 48 ..
16.2.m: Having written it down, whoever should donate it along with a golden lotus / in Mārgaśīrṣa according to the rule, and likewise with a cow made of sesame seeds, / it has sixteen thousand [verses] and grants the fruit of all sacrifices.

16.2.s:
yatrādhikṛtya māhātmyamādityasya caturmukhaḥ ..
aghorakalpavṛttāntaprasaṃgena jagatpatiḥ ..
manave kathayāmāsa bhūtagrāmasya lakṣaṇam .. 49 ..
16.2.d:
यत्राधिकृत्य माहात्म्यमादित्यस्य चतुर्मुखः ..
अघोरकल्पवृत्तान्तप्रसंगेन जगत्पतिः ..
मनवे कथयामास भूतग्रामस्य लक्षणम् .. 49 ..
16.2.m: Where, taking the māhātmya of the Sun as his subject, the four-faced / Lord of the universe, in connection with the narrative of the Aghora Kalpa, / spoke to Manu about the characteristics of the host of beings;

16.2.s:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca ..
bhaviṣyacaritaprāyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tadihocyate .. 7.1.2.50 ..
16.2.d:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि तथा पञ्चशतानि च ..
भविष्यचरितप्रायं भविष्यं तदिहोच्यते .. 7.1.2.50 ..
16.2.m: it consists of fourteen thousand and five hundred [verses], / mostly containing future deeds, and is called here the Bhaviṣya.

16.2.s:
tatpauṣamāsi yo dadyātpaurṇamāsyāṃ vimatsaraḥ ..
guḍakumbhasamāyuktamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. .. 51 ..
16.2.d:
तत्पौषमासि यो दद्यात्पौर्णमास्यां विमत्सरः ..
गुडकुम्भसमायुक्तमग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् .. .. 51 ..
16.2.m: Whoever should give it on the full moon day in the month of Pauṣa, free from malice, / along with a jar of molasses, obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

16.2.s:
rathaṃtarasya kalpasya vṛttāntamadhikṛtya ca ..
sāvarṇinā nāradāya kṛṣṇamāhātmyasaṃyutam ..
proktaṃ brahmavarāhasya caritaṃ varṇyate'tra ca ..52..
16.2.d:
रथंतरस्य कल्पस्य वृत्तान्तमधिकृत्य च ..
सावर्णिना नारदाय कृष्णमाहात्म्यसंयुतम् ..
प्रोक्तं ब्रह्मवराहस्य चरितं वर्ण्यतेऽत्र च ..52..
16.2.m: Taking as subject the narrative of the Rathaṃtara Kalpa, / spoken by Sāvarṇi to Nārada, accompanied by the māhātmya of Kṛṣṇa, / and the deed of the divine Boar is described here;

16.2.s:
tadaṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ brahmavaivartamucyate ..
purāṇaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ yo dadyādbrāhmaṇottame ..
māghamāse paurṇamāsyāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate .. 53 ..
16.2.d:
तदष्टादशसाहस्रं ब्रह्मवैवर्तमुच्यते ..
पुराणं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणोत्तमे ..
माघमासे पौर्णमास्यां ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 53 ..
16.2.m: that, consisting of eighteen thousand [verses], is called the Brahmavaivarta. / Whoever should give the Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa to an excellent brahmin / on the full moon day in the month of Māgha, is honoured in the world of Brahmā.

16.2.s:
yatrāgniliṅgamadhyasthaḥ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthānāgneyamadhikṛtya ca .. 54 ..
16.2.d:
यत्राग्निलिङ्गमध्यस्थः प्राह देवो महेश्वरः ..
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षार्थानाग्नेयमधिकृत्य च .. 54 ..
16.2.m: Where the divine Maheśvara, standing within the liṅga of fire, / spoke of the goals of dharma, artha, kāma, and mokṣa, having taken as his subject the Āgneya

16.2.s: kalpaṃ tallaiṅgamityuktaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmaṇā svayam .. 55 ..
16.2.d: कल्पं तल्लैङ्गमित्युक्तं पुराणं ब्रह्मणा स्वयम् .. 55 ..
16.2.m: Kalpa, that Purāṇa was called Laiṅga by Brahmā himself.

16.2.s:
tadekādaśasāhasraṃ phālgunyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ..
tiladhenusamāyuktaṃ sa yāti śivasātmyatām ..56..
16.2.d:
तदेकादशसाहस्रं फाल्गुन्यां यः प्रयच्छति ..
तिलधेनुसमायुक्तं स याति शिवसात्म्यताम् ..56..
16.2.m: Whoever presents that eleven-thousand-[verse text] on the full moon day of Phālguna, / accompanied by a cow made of sesame seeds, attains oneness with Śiva.

16.2.s:
mahāvarāhasya punarmāhātmyamadhikṛtya ca ..
viṣṇunā'bhihitaṃ kṣoṇyai tadvārāhamihocyate ..57..
16.2.d:
महावराहस्य पुनर्माहात्म्यमधिकृत्य च ..
विष्णुनाऽभिहितं क्षोण्यै तद्वाराहमिहोच्यते ..57..
16.2.m: Taking again the māhātmya of the Great Boar as its subject, / what was told by Viṣṇu to the Earth is called here the Vārāha.

16.2.s:
mānavasya prasaṃgena dhanyasya munisattamāḥ ..
caturviṃśatsahasrāṇi tatpurāṇamihocyate .. 58 ..
16.2.d:
मानवस्य प्रसंगेन धन्यस्य मुनिसत्तमाः ..
चतुर्विंशत्सहस्राणि तत्पुराणमिहोच्यते .. 58 ..
16.2.m: In connection with the blessed Manu, O best of sages, / that Purāṇa is said here to consist of twenty-four thousand [verses].

16.2.s:
kāñcanaṃ garuḍaṃ kṛtvā tiladhenusamanvitam..
paurṇamāsyāmatho dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine..
vārāhasyaprasādena padamāpnoti vaiṣṇavam..59..
yatra māheśvarāndharmānadhikṛtya ca ṣaṇmukham ..
kalpe tatpuruṣe vṛtte caritairupabṛṃhitam ..7.1.2.6...
16.2.d:
काञ्चनं गरुडं कृत्वा तिलधेनुसमन्वितम्..
पौर्णमास्यामथो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुम्बिने..
वाराहस्यप्रसादेन पदमाप्नोति वैष्णवम्..59..
यत्र माहेश्वरान्धर्मानधिकृत्य च षण्मुखम् ..
कल्पे तत्पुरुषे वृत्ते चरितैरुपबृंहितम् ..7.1.2.6...
16.2.m:
Having fashioned a golden Garuḍa along with a cow made of sesame seeds, / whoever should then give it on the full moon day to a householder brahmin, / reaches the realm of Viṣṇu through the grace of the Boar.
Where, taking the duties pertaining to Maheśvara and the six-faced [Skanda] as its subject, / having occurred in the Tatpuruṣa Kalpa, it is amplified by narratives;

16.2.s:
skāṃdaṃ nāma purāṇaṃ tadekāśīti nigadyate..
sahasrāṇi śataṃ caikamiti martyeṣu paṭhyate..61..
16.2.d:
स्कांदं नाम पुराणं तदेकाशीति निगद्यते..
सहस्राणि शतं चैकमिति मर्त्येषु पठ्यते..61..
16.2.m: that is called the Purāṇa named Skānda, consisting of eighty-one / thousand and one hundred [verses], as it is recited among mortals.

16.2.s:
parilekhya ca yo dadyāddhemaśūlasamanvitam ..
śaivaṃ sa padamāpnoti makaropagame raveḥ .. 62 ..
16.2.d:
परिलेख्य च यो दद्याद्धेमशूलसमन्वितम् ..
शैवं स पदमाप्नोति मकरोपगमे रवेः .. 62 ..
16.2.m: Having written it down, whoever should donate it along with a golden trident / when the Sun enters Capricorn, attains the realm of Śiva.

16.2.s:
trivikramasya māhātmyamadhikṛtya caturmukhaḥ ..
trivargamabhyadhāttattu vāmanaṃ parikīrtitam .. 63..
16.2.d:
त्रिविक्रमस्य माहात्म्यमधिकृत्य चतुर्मुखः ..
त्रिवर्गमभ्यधात्तत्तु वामनं परिकीर्तितम् .. 63..
16.2.m: Taking the māhātmya of Trivikrama as his subject, the four-faced [Brahmā] / spoke of the three aims of life; that is celebrated as the Vāmana.

16.2.s: purāṇaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kaurmakalpānugaṃ śivam.. 64 ..
16.2.d: पुराणं दशसाहस्रं कौर्मकल्पानुगं शिवम्.. 64 ..
16.2.m: It is an auspicious Purāṇa of ten thousand [verses], following the Kaurma Kalpa.

16.2.s:
yaḥ śaradviṣuve dadyāddhemavastrasamanvitam..
kṣaumāvṛtaṃ yutaṃ dhenvā sa padaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam ..65..
16.2.d:
यः शरद्विषुवे दद्याद्धेमवस्त्रसमन्वितम्..
क्षौमावृतं युतं धेन्वा स पदं याति वैष्णवम् ..65..
16.2.m: Whoever should donate it at the autumn equinox along with gold and cloth, / wrapped in linen and accompanied by a cow, goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

16.2.s:
yacca dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasya ca rasātale ..
māhātmyaṃ kathayāmāsa kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ ..66..
16.2.d:
यच्च धर्मार्थकामानां मोक्षस्य च रसातले ..
माहात्म्यं कथयामास कूर्मरूपी जनार्दनः ..66..
16.2.m: And where Janārdana in the form of a tortoise, in the nether regions, / narrated the māhātmya of dharma, artha, kāma, and mokṣa,

16.2.s:
indradyumnaprasaṃgena ṛṣīṇāṃ śakrasannidhau ..
saptadaśasahasrāṇi lakṣmīkalpānuṣaṅgikam ..67..
16.2.d:
इन्द्रद्युम्नप्रसंगेन ऋषीणां शक्रसन्निधौ ..
सप्तदशसहस्राणि लक्ष्मीकल्पानुषङ्गिकम् ..67..
16.2.m: in connection with Indradyumna to the ṛṣis in the presence of Śakra, / [consisting of] seventeen thousand [verses], connected with the Lakṣmī Kalpa;

16.2.s:
yo dadyādayane kaurmaṃ hemakūrmasamanvitam..
gosahasrapradānasya sa phalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ..68..
16.2.d:
यो दद्यादयने कौर्मं हेमकूर्मसमन्वितम्..
गोसहस्रप्रदानस्य स फलं प्राप्नुयान्नरः..68..
16.2.m: whoever donates that Kaurma at the solstice along with a golden tortoise, / that person obtains the fruit of the gift of a thousand cows.

16.2.s:
śrutīnāṃ yatra kalpādau pravṛttyarthaṃ janārdanaḥ..
matsyarūpī ca manave narasiṃhopavarṇanam ..69..
16.2.d:
श्रुतीनां यत्र कल्पादौ प्रवृत्त्यर्थं जनार्दनः..
मत्स्यरूपी च मनवे नरसिंहोपवर्णनम् ..69..
16.2.m: Where, at the beginning of the kalpa, for the propagation of the Vedas, Janārdana / in the form of a fish spoke to Manu, recounting Narasiṃha,

16.2.s:
adhikṛtyābravītsaptakalpavṛttaṃ munivratāḥ...
tanmātsyamiti jānīdhvaṃ sahasrāṇi catudarśa .. 7.1.2.70 ..
16.2.d:
अधिकृत्याब्रवीत्सप्तकल्पवृत्तं मुनिव्रताः...
तन्मात्स्यमिति जानीध्वं सहस्राणि चतुदर्श .. 7.1.2.70 ..
16.2.m: and taking as his subject the events of seven kalpas, O observers of sages' vows, / know that to be the Mātsya, consisting of fourteen thousand [verses].

16.2.s:
viṣuve haimamatsyena dhenvā kṣaumayugānvitam ..
yo dadyātpṛthivī tena dattā bhavati cākhilā .... ..71..
16.2.d:
विषुवे हैममत्स्येन धेन्वा क्षौमयुगान्वितम् ..
यो दद्यात्पृथिवी तेन दत्ता भवति चाखिला .... ..71..
16.2.m: Whoever gives it at the equinox along with a golden fish, a cow, and a pair of linen garments, / by him the entire earth has been gifted.

16.2.s:
yadā vā garuḍe kalpe viśvāṇḍādgaruḍo'bhavat ..
adhikṛtyābravītkṛṣṇo gāruḍaṃ tadihocyate ..72..
16.2.d:
यदा वा गरुडे कल्पे विश्वाण्डाद्गरुडोऽभवत् ..
अधिकृत्याब्रवीत्कृष्णो गारुडं तदिहोच्यते ..72..
16.2.m: When, in the Garuḍa Kalpa, Garuḍa came into being from the cosmic egg, / taking that as subject, Kṛṣṇa spoke; that is here called the Gāruḍa.

16.2.s:
tadaṣṭādaśa caikaṃ ca sahasrāṇīha paṭhyate ...
svarṇahaṃsasamāyuktaṃ yo dadyādayane pare ..
sa siddhiṃ labhate mukhyāṃ śivaloke ca saṃsthitim .. 73 ..
16.2.d:
तदष्टादश चैकं च सहस्राणीह पठ्यते ...
स्वर्णहंससमायुक्तं यो दद्यादयने परे ..
स सिद्धिं लभते मुख्यां शिवलोके च संस्थितिम् .. 73 ..
16.2.m: It is recited here as nineteen thousand [verses]. / Whoever gives it on the other solstice along with a golden goose / attains the foremost perfection and an abode in the world of Śiva. (73)

16.2.s:
brahmā brahmāṇḍamāhātmyamadhikṛtyābravītpunaḥ ..
tacca dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dviśatādhikam ..74..
16.2.d:
ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माण्डमाहात्म्यमधिकृत्याब्रवीत्पुनः ..
तच्च द्वादशसाहस्रं ब्रह्माण्डं द्विशताधिकम् ..74..
16.2.m: Brahmā spoke once more, taking as his subject the majesty of the cosmos: / that Brahmāṇḍa consists of twelve thousand two hundred [verses]. (74)

16.2.s:
bhaviṣyāṇāṃ ca kalpānāṃ śrūyate yatra vistaraḥ ..
tadbrahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ tu brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam .. 79 ..
yo dadyāttu vyatīpāta ūrṇāyugasamanvitam ..
rājasūyasahasrasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 76 ..
hemadhenvāyutaṃ tacca brahmalokaphalapradam..
caturlakṣamidaṃ proktaṃ vyāsenādbhutakarmaṇā .. 77 ..
idaṃ lokahitārthāya saṃkṣiptaṃ dvāpare dvijāḥ .. 78 ..
idamadyāpi deveṣu śatakoṭipravistaram ..
upabhedānpravakṣyāmi loke ye saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 79 ..
16.2.d:
भविष्याणां च कल्पानां श्रूयते यत्र विस्तरः ..
तद्ब्रह्माण्डं पुराणं तु ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम् .. 79 ..
यो दद्यात्तु व्यतीपात ऊर्णायुगसमन्वितम् ..
राजसूयसहस्रस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः .. 76 ..
हेमधेन्वायुतं तच्च ब्रह्मलोकफलप्रदम्..
चतुर्लक्षमिदं प्रोक्तं व्यासेनाद्भुतकर्मणा .. 77 ..
इदं लोकहितार्थाय संक्षिप्तं द्वापरे द्विजाः .. 78 ..
इदमद्यापि देवेषु शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम् ..
उपभेदान्प्रवक्ष्यामि लोके ये संप्रतिष्ठिताः .. 79 ..
16.2.m:
Where the expansion of future aeons is heard, / that Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa has been proclaimed by Brahmā. (75)
Whoever gives it on a vyatīpāta accompanied by a pair of woolen clothes, / that man obtains the fruit of a thousand Rājasūya sacrifices. (76)
Endowed with a golden cow, that [gift] bestows the fruit of the world of Brahmā. / This [body of lore] of four hundred thousand [verses] was proclaimed by Vyāsa of wondrous deeds. (77)
This was abridged in the Dvāpara age, O twice-born ones, for the welfare of the world. (78)
Even today this extends to one billion [verses] among the gods. / I shall declare the secondary divisions that are established in the world. (79)

16.2.s:
pādme purāṇe yatproktaṃ nārasiṃhopavarṇanam ..
taccāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ nārasiṃhamihocyate .. 7.1.2.80 ..
16.2.d:
पाद्मे पुराणे यत्प्रोक्तं नारसिंहोपवर्णनम् ..
तच्चाष्टादशसाहस्रं नारसिंहमिहोच्यते .. 7.1.2.80 ..
16.2.m: What is proclaimed in the Pādma Purāṇa as an account of Nārasiṃha, / that, having eighteen thousand [verses], is called the Nārasiṃha here. (80)

16.2.s:
nandine yatra māhātmyaṃ kārtikeyena varṇitam ..
loke nandipurāṇaṃ vai khyātametaddvijottamāḥ .. 81 ..
16.2.d:
नन्दिने यत्र माहात्म्यं कार्तिकेयेन वर्णितम् ..
लोके नन्दिपुराणं वै ख्यातमेतद्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 81 ..
16.2.m: Where the majesty [of Śiva] was described to Nandin by Kārtikeya, / that is indeed renowned in the world as the Nandi Purāṇa, O best of the twice-born. (81)

16.2.s:
yatra sāmbaṃ puraskṛtya bhaviṣyati kathānakam ..
procyate tatpunarloke sāṃbameva munivratāḥ .. 82 ..
16.2.d:
यत्र साम्बं पुरस्कृत्य भविष्यति कथानकम् ..
प्रोच्यते तत्पुनर्लोके सांबमेव मुनिव्रताः .. 82 ..
16.2.m: The narrative that will occur placing Sāmba foremost / is proclaimed in the world as the Sāmba itself, O you of ascetic vows. (82)

16.2.s:
evamādityasaṃjñaṃ tu tatraiva paripaṭhyate ..
aṣṭādaśabhyastu pṛthakpurāṇaṃ yacca dṛśyate ..
vijānīdhvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāstadetebhyo vinirgatam .. 83 ..
16.2.d:
एवमादित्यसंज्ञं तु तत्रैव परिपठ्यते ..
अष्टादशभ्यस्तु पृथक्पुराणं यच्च दृश्यते ..
विजानीध्वं द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तदेतेभ्यो विनिर्गतम् .. 83 ..
16.2.m: Likewise, the [Purāṇa] named Āditya is recited right there. / And whatever Purāṇa is seen separate from the eighteen, / know, O best of the twice-born, that it has come forth from these. (83)

16.2.s:
pañcāṅgāni purāṇasya cākhyānamitaratsmṛtam ..
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca ..
vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam .. 84 ..
16.2.d:
पञ्चाङ्गानि पुराणस्य चाख्यानमितरत्स्मृतम् ..
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च ..
वंशानुवंशचरितं पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम् .. 84 ..
16.2.m: Fivefold are the characteristics of a Purāṇa; the rest is remembered as narrative: / primary creation, secondary creation, genealogy, the Manvantaras, / and the history of lineages: a Purāṇa has five characteristics. (84)

16.2.s:
brahmaviṣṇvarkarudrāṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ bhuvanasya ca ..
saṃhāraśca pradṛśyeta purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam .. 85 ..
16.2.d:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वर्करुद्राणां माहात्म्यं भुवनस्य च ..
संहारश्च प्रदृश्येत पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम् .. 85 ..
16.2.m: The majesty of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the Sun, and Rudra, and of the world, / and dissolution are seen: a Purāṇa has five characteristics. (85)

16.2.s:
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśca parikīrtyate ..
sarveṣvapi purāṇeṣu tadvirūḍhe ca yatphalam .. 86 ..
16.2.d:
धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च मोक्षश्च परिकीर्त्यते ..
सर्वेष्वपि पुराणेषु तद्विरूढे च यत्फलम् .. 86 ..
16.2.m: Dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation are celebrated / in all the Purāṇas, as well as the fruit when it has arisen. (86)

16.2.s:
sātvikeṣu ca kalpeṣu māhātmyamadhikaṃ hareḥ ..
rājaseṣu ca māhātmyamadhikaṃ brahmaṇo viduḥ .. 87 ..
16.2.d:
सात्विकेषु च कल्पेषु माहात्म्यमधिकं हरेः ..
राजसेषु च माहात्म्यमधिकं ब्रह्मणो विदुः .. 87 ..
16.2.m: In sattvic aeons, the majesty of Hari is greater; / in rajasic [aeons], they know the majesty of Brahmā to be greater; (87)

16.2.s:
tadvadagre ca māhātmyaṃ tāmaseṣu śivasya hi ..
saṃkīrṇe ca sarasvatyāḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca nigadyate .. 88 ..
16.2.d:
तद्वदग्रे च माहात्म्यं तामसेषु शिवस्य हि ..
संकीर्णे च सरस्वत्याः पितॄणां च निगद्यते .. 88 ..
16.2.m: likewise, in tamasic [aeons], the majesty of Śiva is foremost; / and in mixed [aeons], that of Sarasvatī and the ancestors is proclaimed. (88)

16.2.s:
caturbhirbhagavānviṣṇurdvābhyāṃ brahmā tathā raviḥ ..
aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu śeṣeṣu bhagavāñchivaḥ .. 89 ..
16.2.d:
चतुर्भिर्भगवान्विष्णुर्द्वाभ्यां ब्रह्मा तथा रविः ..
अष्टादशपुराणेषु शेषेषु भगवाञ्छिवः .. 89 ..
16.2.m: Lord Viṣṇu [is praised] by four, Brahmā by two, and likewise the Sun; / in the remaining of the eighteen Purāṇas, it is the Lord Śiva. (89)

16.2.s:
vedavanniścalaṃ manye purāṇaṃ vai dvijottamāḥ ..
vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ sarve purāṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 7.1.2.90 ..
16.2.d:
वेदवन्निश्चलं मन्ये पुराणं वै द्विजोत्तमाः ..
वेदाः प्रतिष्ठिताः सर्वे पुराणे नात्र संशयः .. 7.1.2.90 ..
16.2.m: I consider the Purāṇa to be unshakeable like the Veda, O best of the twice-born; / all Vedas are established in the Purāṇa, of this there is no doubt. (90)

16.2.s:
bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ cālayiṣyati ..
itihāsapurāṇaistu niścalo'yaṃ kṛtaḥ purā .. 91 ..
16.2.d:
बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद्वेदो मामयं चालयिष्यति ..
इतिहासपुराणैस्तु निश्चलोऽयं कृतः पुरा .. 91 ..
16.2.m: The Veda fears a person of little learning, thinking: 'May he not shake me!' / It was formerly made unshakeable by means of the Itihāsas and Purāṇas. (91)

16.2.s:
yanna dṛṣṭaṃ hi vedeṣu na dṛṣṭaṃ smṛtiṣu dvijāḥ ..
ubhayoryatra dṛṣṭaṃ ca tatpurāṇeṣu gīyate .. 92 ..
16.2.d:
यन्न दृष्टं हि वेदेषु न दृष्टं स्मृतिषु द्विजाः ..
उभयोर्यत्र दृष्टं च तत्पुराणेषु गीयते .. 92 ..
16.2.m: What is not seen in the Vedas, and not seen in the Smṛtis, O twice-born ones, / and what is seen in both, that is sung in the Purāṇas. (92)

16.2.s:
yo veda caturo vedānsāṃgopaniṣado dvijaḥ ..
purāṇaṃ naiva jānāti na ca sa syādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 93 ..
16.2.d:
यो वेद चतुरो वेदान्सांगोपनिषदो द्विजः ..
पुराणं नैव जानाति न च स स्याद्विचक्षणः .. 93 ..
16.2.m: A twice-born man who knows the four Vedas together with the auxiliary sciences and Upaniṣads, / but does not know the Purāṇa, would not be a discerning man. (93)

16.2.s:
aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni kṛtvā satyavatīsutaḥ ..
bhāratākhyānamakarodvedārthairupabṛṃhitam .. 94 ..
16.2.d:
अष्टादशपुराणानि कृत्वा सत्यवतीसुतः ..
भारताख्यानमकरोद्वेदार्थैरुपबृंहितम् .. 94 ..
16.2.m: Having composed the eighteen Purāṇas, the son of Satyavatī / created the story of the Bhārata, reinforced with the meanings of the Vedas. (94)

16.2.s:
lakṣeṇaikena tatproktaṃ dvāparānte mahātmanā ..
vālmīkinā ca yatproktaṃ rāmopākhyānamuttamam .. 95 ..
16.2.d:
लक्षेणैकेन तत्प्रोक्तं द्वापरान्ते महात्मना ..
वाल्मीकिना च यत्प्रोक्तं रामोपाख्यानमुत्तमम् .. 95 ..
16.2.m: It was proclaimed in one hundred thousand [verses] at the end of the Dvāpara age by that great soul. / And that excellent narrative of Rāma which was proclaimed by Vālmīki, (95)

16.2.s:
brahmaṇā vihitaṃ yacca śatakoṭipravistaram..
āha tannāradāyaiva tena vālmīkaye punaḥ .. 96 ..
16.2.d:
ब्रह्मणा विहितं यच्च शतकोटिप्रविस्तरम्..
आह तन्नारदायैव तेन वाल्मीकये पुनः .. 96 ..
16.2.m: and which was arranged by Brahmā extending to one billion [verses], / he told to Nārada, and he in turn to Vālmīki. (96)

16.2.s: vālmīkinā ca loke tu dharmakāmārthasādhakam .. .. 97 ..
16.2.d: वाल्मीकिना च लोके तु धर्मकामार्थसाधकम् .. .. 97 ..
16.2.m: And by Vālmīki in the world, [a work] accomplishing dharma, desire, and wealth [was composed]. (97)

16.2.s:
evaṃ sapādāḥ pañcaite lakṣāḥ puṇyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
purātanasya kalpasya purāṇe tu vidurbudhāḥ .. 98 ..
16.2.d:
एवं सपादाः पञ्चैते लक्षाः पुण्याः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
पुरातनस्य कल्पस्य पुराणे तु विदुर्बुधाः .. 98 ..
16.2.m: Thus these five hundred and twenty-five thousand sacred [verses] / in the Purāṇa of the ancient aeon the wise know. (98)

16.2.s:
itihāsapurāṇāni bhidyante kāla gauravāt ..
skāndaṃ tathā ca brahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ laiṅgameva ca .. 99 ..
16.2.d:
इतिहासपुराणानि भिद्यन्ते काल गौरवात् ..
स्कान्दं तथा च ब्रह्माण्डं पुराणं लैङ्गमेव च .. 99 ..
16.2.m: The Itihāsas and Purāṇas diverge on account of the weight of time: / the Skānda, and likewise the Brahmāṇḍa, and the Laiṅga Purāṇa. (99)

16.2.s:
vārāhakalpe viprendrāsteṣāṃ bhedaḥ pravartate ..
aṣṭādaśaprakāreṇa brahmāṇḍaṃ bhinnameva hi .. 7.1.2.100 ..
16.2.d:
वाराहकल्पे विप्रेन्द्रास्तेषां भेदः प्रवर्तते ..
अष्टादशप्रकारेण ब्रह्माण्डं भिन्नमेव हि .. 7.1.2.100 ..
16.2.m: In the Vārāha aeon, O lords of brahmins, their division took place; / the Brahmāṇḍa was indeed divided in eighteen ways. (100)

16.2.s:
aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni tena jātāni bhūtale ..
laiṅgamekādaśavidhaṃ prabhinnaṃ dvāpare śubham .. 101 ..
16.2.d:
अष्टादशपुराणानि तेन जातानि भूतले ..
लैङ्गमेकादशविधं प्रभिन्नं द्वापरे शुभम् .. 101 ..
16.2.m: By that, eighteen Purāṇas came into being on the face of the earth. / The auspicious Laiṅga was divided into eleven parts in the Dvāpara age. (101)

16.2.s:
skāndaṃ tu saptadhā bhinnaṃ veda vyāsenadhīmatā ..
ekāśītisahasrāṇi śataṃ caikaṃ tu saṃkhyayā .. 102 ..
16.2.d:
स्कान्दं तु सप्तधा भिन्नं वेद व्यासेनधीमता ..
एकाशीतिसहस्राणि शतं चैकं तु संख्यया .. 102 ..
16.2.m: The Skānda, however, was divided sevenfold by the wise Vyāsa, / in number eighty-one thousand one hundred [verses]. (102)

16.2.s:
tasyā''dyo yo vibhāgastu skandamāhātmyasaṃyutaḥ ..
māheśvaraḥ samākhyāto dvitīyo vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 103 ..
16.2.d:
तस्या'ऽद्यो यो विभागस्तु स्कन्दमाहात्म्यसंयुतः ..
माहेश्वरः समाख्यातो द्वितीयो वैष्णवः स्मृतः .. 103 ..
16.2.m: Its first division, endowed with the majesty of Skanda, / is declared as the Māheśvara; the second is remembered as the Vaiṣṇava; (103)

16.2.s:
tṛtīyo brahmaṇaḥ proktaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃkṣepasūcakaḥ ..
kāśīmāhātmyasaṃyuktaścaturthaḥ paripaṭhyate .. 104 ..
16.2.d:
तृतीयो ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्तः सृष्टिसंक्षेपसूचकः ..
काशीमाहात्म्यसंयुक्तश्चतुर्थः परिपठ्यते .. 104 ..
16.2.m: the third is proclaimed to belong to Brahmā, indicating a summary of creation; / the fourth, endowed with the majesty of Kāśī, is recited; (104)

16.2.s:
revāyāḥ pañcamo bhāgaḥ sojjayinyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpo nāgaraśca tīrthamāhātmyasūcakaḥ .. 105 ..
16.2.d:
रेवायाः पञ्चमो भागः सोज्जयिन्याः प्रकीर्तितः ..
षष्ठः कल्पो नागरश्च तीर्थमाहात्म्यसूचकः .. 105 ..
16.2.m: the fifth part is proclaimed to belong to the Revā and Ujjayinī; / the sixth is the Nāgara aeon, indicating the majesty of sacred fords; (105)

16.2.s:
saptamo yo vibhāgo'yaṃ smṛtaḥ prābhāsiko dvijāḥ..
sarve dvādaśasāhasrā vibhāgāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ .. 106 ..
16.2.d:
सप्तमो यो विभागोऽयं स्मृतः प्राभासिको द्विजाः..
सर्वे द्वादशसाहस्रा विभागाः संप्रकीर्तिताः .. 106 ..
16.2.m: the seventh division is remembered as the Prābhāsika, O twice-born ones; / all divisions are proclaimed to be twelve thousand [verses]. (106)

16.2.s:
asminprābhāsikaḥ sarvo varṇyate kṣetravistaraḥ ..
tīrthānāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ śaṃkarasya ca .. 107 ..
16.2.d:
अस्मिन्प्राभासिकः सर्वो वर्ण्यते क्षेत्रविस्तरः ..
तीर्थानां चैव माहात्म्यं माहात्म्यं शंकरस्य च .. 107 ..
16.2.m: In this, the entire extent of the sacred field of Prabhāsa is described, / along with the majesty of the sacred fords and the majesty of Śaṃkara, (107)

16.2.s:
anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ māhātmyaṃ ca prakīrtyate ..
iti bhedaḥ purāṇānāṃ saṃkṣepātkathito dvijāḥ .. 108 ..
16.2.d:
अन्येषां चैव देवानां माहात्म्यं च प्रकीर्त्यते ..
इति भेदः पुराणानां संक्षेपात्कथितो द्विजाः .. 108 ..
16.2.m: and the majesty of other deities is also proclaimed. / Thus the division of the Purāṇas has been told in brief, O twice-born ones. (108)

16.2.s:
imamaṣṭādaśānāṃ tu purāṇānāmanukramam..
yaḥ paṭheddhavyakavyeṣu sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ..109..
idaṃ pavitraṃ hi yaśonidhānamidaṃ pitṝṇāmapi vallabhaṃ ca..
idaṃ ca deveṣvamṛtāya nityamidaṃ mahāpātakahṛcca puṃsām..7.1.2.11...
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sasaṃkhyākāṣṭādaśamahāpurāṇopapurāṇavarṇanapūrvaka purāṇapustakadānaphalavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ..2..
16.2.d:
इममष्टादशानां तु पुराणानामनुक्रमम्..
यः पठेद्धव्यकव्येषु स याति भवनं हरेः..109..
इदं पवित्रं हि यशोनिधानमिदं पितॄणामपि वल्लभं च..
इदं च देवेष्वमृताय नित्यमिदं महापातकहृच्च पुंसाम्..7.1.2.11...
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ससंख्याकाष्टादशमहापुराणोपपुराणवर्णनपूर्वक पुराणपुस्तकदानफलवर्णनं नाम द्वितीयोऽध्यायः..2..
16.2.m:
Whoever recites this sequence of the eighteen Purāṇas / at the offerings to the gods and ancestors goes to the abode of Hari. (109)
This is holy, a repository of glory, and dear even to the ancestors; / this is always like nectar among the gods, and it destroys the great sins of mortals. (110)
Thus ends the second chapter, named 'The Description of the Fruit of the Gift of Purāṇa Manuscripts Preceded by the Description of the Eighteen Mahāpurāṇas and the Upapurāṇas with Their Verse-Counts', in the first [subdivision], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of an eighty-one-thousand-[verse] compendium. (2)

16.3.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
kathito bhavatā sargaḥ pratisargastathaiva ca..
vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇānāmanukramaḥ..1..
16.3.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
कथितो भवता सर्गः प्रतिसर्गस्तथैव च..
वंशानुवंशचरितं पुराणानामनुक्रमः..1..
16.3.m: The seers said: / Primary creation and secondary creation have been described by you, / as well as the history of lineages and the sequence of the Purāṇas, (1)

16.3.s:
manvantarapramāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍasya ca vistaraḥ..
jyotiścakrasvarūpaṃ ca yathāvadanuvarṇitam..
śrotumicchāmahe tvattaḥ sāṃprataṃ tīrthavistaram..2..
16.3.d:
मन्वन्तरप्रमाणं च ब्रह्मांडस्य च विस्तरः..
ज्योतिश्चक्रस्वरूपं च यथावदनुवर्णितम्..
श्रोतुमिच्छामहे त्वत्तः सांप्रतं तीर्थविस्तरम्..2..
16.3.m: and the measure of the Manvantaras, the extent of the cosmos, / and the nature of the circle of luminaries have been described as they truly are. / We now wish to hear from you the extent of the sacred fords. (2)

16.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pāpaghnāni śubhāni ca..
tāni sūtaja kārtsnyena yathāvadvaktumarhasi..3..
16.3.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पापघ्नानि शुभानि च..
तानि सूतज कार्त्स्न्येन यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि..3..
16.3.m: Whatever sacred fords there are on earth that destroy sin and are auspicious, / all of them you should tell in full, as they truly are, O son of Sūta. (3)

16.3.s:
sūta uvāca..
idaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ purā devyā kailāsaśikharottame..
nānādhātuvicitrāṃge nānāratnasamanvite..4..
16.3.d:
सूत उवाच..
इदं पृष्टं पुरा देव्या कैलासशिखरोत्तमे..
नानाधातुविचित्रांगे नानारत्नसमन्विते..4..
16.3.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly, this was asked by the Goddess on the supreme peak of Kailāsa,
whose slopes are adorned with various minerals and endowed with diverse jewels,

16.3.s:
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite..
yakṣavidyādharākīrṇe hyapsarogaṇasevite..5.
16.3.d:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णे नानापुष्पोपशोभिते..
यक्षविद्याधराकीर्णे ह्यप्सरोगणसेविते..5.
16.3.m:
overspread with various trees and creepers, embellished with various flowers,
crowded with Yakṣas and Vidyādharas, and attended by hosts of apsarases.

16.3.s:
tatra brahamā ca viṣṇuśca skandanandigaṇeśvarāḥ..
caṃdrādityau grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ nakṣatradhruvamaṇḍalam..6..
16.3.d:
तत्र ब्रहमा च विष्णुश्च स्कन्दनन्दिगणेश्वराः..
चंद्रादित्यौ ग्रहैः सार्धं नक्षत्रध्रुवमण्डलम्..6..
16.3.m:
There were Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Skanda, Nandin, and the lords of the Gaṇas,
the moon and the sun together with the planets, the lunar mansions, and the circle of the Pole Star;
