16.3.s:
vāyuśca varuṇaścaiva kubero dhanadastathā..
īśānaścāgniriṃdraśca yamo nirṛtireva ca..7..
16.3.d:
वायुश्च वरुणश्चैव कुबेरो धनदस्तथा..
ईशानश्चाग्निरिंद्रश्च यमो निरृतिरेव च..7..
16.3.m:
and Vāyu, Varuṇa, Kubera, the giver of wealth,
Īśāna, Agni, Indra, Yama, and Nirṛti;

16.3.s:
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve parvatā uragāstathā..
brāhmyādyā mātaraścaiva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ..8..
16.3.d:
सरितः सागराः सर्वे पर्वता उरगास्तथा..
ब्राह्म्याद्या मातरश्चैव ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः..8..
16.3.m:
all the rivers and oceans, mountains, and serpents;
Brāhmī and the other Mothers, and the seers rich in austerity;

16.3.s:
mūrtimaṃti ca tīrthāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca..
dānavāsuradaityāśca piśācā bhūtarākṣasāḥ..7.1.3.10
tatra siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ śatayojanavistṛtam..11.
16.3.d:
मूर्तिमंति च तीर्थानि क्षेत्राण्यायतनानि च..
दानवासुरदैत्याश्च पिशाचा भूतराक्षसाः..7.1.3.10
तत्र सिंहासनं दिव्यं शतयोजनविस्तृतम्..11.

16.3.s:
lakṣāyutasahasraiśca rudrakoṭibhirāvṛtam..
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ siṃhadvāraiḥ sutoraṇaiḥ..12..
16.3.d:
लक्षायुतसहस्रैश्च रुद्रकोटिभिरावृतम्..
तन्मध्ये सर्वतोभद्रं सिंहद्वारैः सुतोरणैः..12..
16.3.m:
surrounded by hundreds of thousands and tens of thousands of crores of Rudras.
In its midst was an all-auspicious pavilion with lion-gates and splendid archways,

16.3.s:
svacchamauktikasaṃkāśaṃ prākāraśikharāvṛtam..
nandīśvaramahākāladvārapālagaṇairvṛtam..13..
16.3.d:
स्वच्छमौक्तिकसंकाशं प्राकारशिखरावृतम्..
नन्दीश्वरमहाकालद्वारपालगणैर्वृतम्..13..
16.3.m:
resembling clear pearls, enclosed by walls and spires,
surrounded by the hosts of gatekeepers [led by] Nandīśvara and Mahākāla,

16.3.s:
kiṃkiṇījālamukharaiḥ satyatākairalaṃkṛtam..
vitānacchatrakhaṃḍaiśca muktādāmapralaṃbitaiḥ..14..
16.3.d:
किंकिणीजालमुखरैः सत्यताकैरलंकृतम्..
वितानच्छत्रखंडैश्च मुक्तादामप्रलंबितैः..14..
16.3.m:
resounding with networks of small bells, decorated with true banners,
and adorned with canopies, umbrella-cloths, and dangling pearl garlands,

16.3.s:
ghaṃṭācāmaraśobhāḍhayairdarpaṇaiścopaśobhitam..
kalaśairdvāravinyastaratnapallavasaṃyutaiḥ..15..
16.3.d:
घंटाचामरशोभाढयैर्दर्पणैश्चोपशोभितम्..
कलशैर्द्वारविन्यस्तरत्नपल्लवसंयुतैः..15..
16.3.m:
beautified with bells, chowries, and mirrors,
with jars placed at the doorways accompanied by jewel-sprouts,

16.3.s:
citritaṃ citraśāstrajñai ratnacūrṇaiḥ samujvalaiḥ..
svastikaiḥ patravalyādyairliṃgodbhavalatādibhiḥ..16..
16.3.d:
चित्रितं चित्रशास्त्रज्ञै रत्नचूर्णैः समुज्वलैः..
स्वस्तिकैः पत्रवल्याद्यैर्लिंगोद्भवलतादिभिः..16..
16.3.m:
painted by artists with radiant jewel-powders,
with svastikas, foliage-creepers, and vines showing the origin of the liṅga,

16.3.s:
śatasiṃhāsanākīrṇaṃ vedikābhiśca śobhitam..
āsīnai rudravṛndaiśca rudrakanyākadambakaiḥ..17..
16.3.d:
शतसिंहासनाकीर्णं वेदिकाभिश्च शोभितम्..
आसीनै रुद्रवृन्दैश्च रुद्रकन्याकदम्बकैः..17..
16.3.m:
crowded with a hundred thrones, adorned with altars,
and filled with seated throngs of Rudras and multitudes of Rudra-maidens,

16.3.s:
lakṣapatradalāḍhyaiśca śvetapadmaiśca bhūṣitam..
apsarobhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ puṣpaprakaravistṛtam..18..
16.3.d:
लक्षपत्रदलाढ्यैश्च श्वेतपद्मैश्च भूषितम्..
अप्सरोभिः समाकीर्णं पुष्पप्रकरविस्तृतम्..18..
16.3.m:
adorned with white lotuses endowed with a hundred thousand petals,
crowded with apsarases, spread with heaps of flowers,

16.3.s:
dhūpitaṃ dhūpavarttībhiḥ kuṃkumodakasecitam..
vaṃśavīṇāmṛdaṃgaiśca gomukhairmukhavādanaiḥ..19..
16.3.d:
धूपितं धूपवर्त्तीभिः कुंकुमोदकसेचितम्..
वंशवीणामृदंगैश्च गोमुखैर्मुखवादनैः..19..
16.3.m:
perfumed with incense sticks, sprinkled with saffron water,
[resounding] with flutes, vīṇās, mṛdaṅgas, horn-instruments, and mouth-blown instruments,

16.3.s:
śaṃkhabherīninādena dundubhidhvanitena ca..
garjadbhirgaṇavṛndaiśca meghasvanitanisvanaiḥ..7.1.3.20 ..
16.3.d:
शंखभेरीनिनादेन दुन्दुभिध्वनितेन च..
गर्जद्भिर्गणवृन्दैश्च मेघस्वनितनिस्वनैः..7.1.3.20 ..
16.3.m:
with the blare of conchs and bherī-drums, with the rumbling of dundubhi-drums,
and with the hosts of Gaṇas roaring with sounds like the rumbling of clouds,

16.3.s:
gaṇānāṃ stotraśabdena sāmavedaraveṇa ca..
prekṣaṇīyairmahānādairgeyahuṅkāraśobhitam..21..
16.3.d:
गणानां स्तोत्रशब्देन सामवेदरवेण च..
प्रेक्षणीयैर्महानादैर्गेयहुङ्कारशोभितम्..21..
16.3.m:
adorned with the praises of the Gaṇas, the chanting of the Sāmaveda,
and spectacular, great shouts accompanied by vocal huṅkāras,

16.3.s:
vṛṣanarditaśabdena gajavājiraveṇa ca..
kāṃcīnūpuraśabdena samākīrṇadigaṃtaram..22..
16.3.d:
वृषनर्दितशब्देन गजवाजिरवेण च..
कांचीनूपुरशब्देन समाकीर्णदिगंतरम्..22..
16.3.m:
filling all directions with the bellowing of bulls, the neighing and trumpeting of horses and elephants,
and the jingling of waistbands and anklets—

16.3.s:
sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śrīmacchaṃkarasyaiva maṃdiram..
vaṃśa vīṇāmṛdaṃgaiśca nāditaṃ tatra tatra ha ..
ṛgvedo mūrtimāṃścaiva śakranīlasamadyutiḥ .. 23 ..
16.3.d:
सर्वसंपत्करं श्रीमच्छंकरस्यैव मंदिरम्..
वंश वीणामृदंगैश्च नादितं तत्र तत्र ह ..
ऋग्वेदो मूर्तिमांश्चैव शक्रनीलसमद्युतिः .. 23 ..
16.3.m:
the glorious abode of Śaṃkara, which bestows all prosperity.
It echoed here and there with flutes, vīṇās, and mṛdaṅgas.
And the personified Ṛgveda, having the brilliance of a sapphire,

16.3.s:
divyagandhānuliptāṃgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
saṃsthitaḥ pūrvatastasya dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā .. 24 ..
16.3.d:
दिव्यगन्धानुलिप्तांगो दिव्याभरणभूषितः ..
संस्थितः पूर्वतस्तस्य दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा .. 24 ..
16.3.m:
his body anointed with divine perfumes, adorned with celestial ornaments,
stood to his east, blazing with his own splendor.

16.3.s:
uttareṇa yajurvedaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ ..
divyakuṇḍaladhārī ca mahākāyo mahābhujaḥ .. 25 ..
16.3.d:
उत्तरेण यजुर्वेदः शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभः ..
दिव्यकुण्डलधारी च महाकायो महाभुजः .. 25 ..
16.3.m:
To the north stood the Yajurveda, resembling pure crystal,
wearing divine earrings, having a massive body and mighty arms.

16.3.s:
sthitaḥ paścima digbhāge sāmavedaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
raktāṃbaradharaḥ śrīmānpaprarāgasamaprabhaḥ ..26..
16.3.d:
स्थितः पश्चिम दिग्भागे सामवेदः सनातनः ..
रक्तांबरधरः श्रीमान्पप्ररागसमप्रभः ..26..
16.3.m:
Stationed on the western side was the eternal Sāmaveda,
wearing red garments, glorious, having the lustre of a ruby,

16.3.s:
sragdāmadhārī citraśca gītabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
athavāṃ'janavacchayāmaḥ sthito dakṣiṇatastathā .. 27 ..
16.3.d:
स्रग्दामधारी चित्रश्च गीतभूषणभूषितः ..
अथवांऽजनवच्छयामः स्थितो दक्षिणतस्तथा .. 27 ..
16.3.m:
wearing garlands, wondrous, adorned with musical embellishments.
Or, Atharvan, dark as collyrium, was likewise stationed to the south,

16.3.s:
piṃgākṣo lohitagrīvo harikeśo mahātanuḥ ..
itihāsaṣaḍaṃgāni purāṇānyakhilāni ca .. 28 ..
16.3.d:
पिंगाक्षो लोहितग्रीवो हरिकेशो महातनुः ..
इतिहासषडंगानि पुराणान्यखिलानि च .. 28 ..
16.3.m:
tawny-eyed, red-necked, yellow-haired, with a massive frame.
The Itihāsas, the six Vedāṅgas, all the Purāṇas,

16.3.s:
vedopaniṣadaśchando mīmāṃsāraṇyakaṃ tathā ..
svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau rahasyāni tathaiva ca ..29..
16.3.d:
वेदोपनिषदश्छन्दो मीमांसारण्यकं तथा ..
स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ रहस्यानि तथैव च ..29..
16.3.m:
the Upaniṣads of the Veda, the metrics, Mīmāṃsā, the Āraṇyakas,
the utterances of Svāhā and Vaṣaṭ, and likewise the secret doctrines—

16.3.s:
etaiḥ samanvitaiścaiva tatra brahmā svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..
śaktirūpadharairmantrairyogaiśvaryasamanvitaiḥ.. .. 7.1.3.30 ..
16.3.d:
एतैः समन्वितैश्चैव तत्र ब्रह्मा स्वयं स्थितः ..
शक्तिरूपधरैर्मन्त्रैर्योगैश्वर्यसमन्वितैः.. .. 7.1.3.30 ..
16.3.m:
accompanied by these, Brahmā himself stood there.
Along with the mantras bearing the form of Śakti, endowed with the sovereign power of yoga,

16.3.s:
sahasrapatrakamalairaṃkitaiḥ surapūjitaiḥ ..
pūjitairgaṇarudraiśca brahmaviṣviṃdravaṃditaiḥ ..31..
16.3.d:
सहस्रपत्रकमलैरंकितैः सुरपूजितैः ..
पूजितैर्गणरुद्रैश्च ब्रह्मविष्विंद्रवंदितैः ..31..
16.3.m:
marked with thousand-petaled lotuses, worshipped by the gods,
venerated by the Rudras of the Gaṇas, praised by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Indra,

16.3.s:
cāmarākṣepavyajanairvījitaiśca samantataḥ ..
śobhitaśca sadā śrīmāṃścaṃdrakoṭisamaprabhaḥ .. 32 ..
16.3.d:
चामराक्षेपव्यजनैर्वीजितैश्च समन्ततः ..
शोभितश्च सदा श्रीमांश्चंद्रकोटिसमप्रभः .. 32 ..
16.3.m:
fanned on all sides with waved chowries and fans,
always glorious, having the splendour of ten million moons,

16.3.s:
jñānāmṛtasutṛptātmā yogaiśvaryaprasādakaḥ ..
yogīṃdramānasāṃbhoja rājahaṃso dvijottamaḥ .. 33 ..
16.3.d:
ज्ञानामृतसुतृप्तात्मा योगैश्वर्यप्रसादकः ..
योगींद्रमानसांभोज राजहंसो द्विजोत्तमः .. 33 ..
16.3.m:
his soul fully contented with the nectar of knowledge, grantor of the sovereign power of yoga,
a royal swan upon the lotus of the minds of lords of yoga, best of the twice-born,

16.3.s:
ajñānatimiradhvaṃsī ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhūṣaṇaḥ ..
sarvasaukhyapradātā ca tatrāste caṃdraśekharaḥ ..34..
16.3.d:
अज्ञानतिमिरध्वंसी षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वभूषणः ..
सर्वसौख्यप्रदाता च तत्रास्ते चंद्रशेखरः ..34..
16.3.m:
dispeller of the darkness of ignorance, adorned with the thirty-six principles,
bestower of all happiness—there sat the moon-crested [Lord].

16.3.s:
tasyotsaṃgagatā devī taptakāṃcanasaprabhā ..
pūjito yoginīvṛndaiḥ sādhakaiḥ surakinnaraiḥ .. 35 ..
16.3.d:
तस्योत्संगगता देवी तप्तकांचनसप्रभा ..
पूजितो योगिनीवृन्दैः साधकैः सुरकिन्नरैः .. 35 ..
16.3.m:
Seated on his lap was the Goddess, possessing the luster of molten gold,
worshipped by throngs of yoginīs, spiritual practitioners, gods, and Kinnaras,

16.3.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ..
yogasiddhipradā nityaṃ mokṣābhyudayadāyinīm .. 36 ..
16.3.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णा सर्वाभरणभूषिता ..
योगसिद्धिप्रदा नित्यं मोक्षाभ्युदयदायिनीम् .. 36 ..
16.3.m:
complete with all auspicious marks, decorated with all ornaments,
perpetually bestowing yogic perfections, granting liberation and prosperity,

16.3.s:
saubhāgyakadalīkandamūlabījaṃ ca pārvatī ..
devasya mukhamālokya vismitā cārulocanā .. 37 ..
16.3.d:
सौभाग्यकदलीकन्दमूलबीजं च पार्वती ..
देवस्य मुखमालोक्य विस्मिता चारुलोचना .. 37 ..
16.3.m:
the root-seed of the plantain of good fortune—Pārvatī.
Looking upon the face of the god, astonished, the lovely-eyed one,

16.3.s:
ānaṃdabhāvaṃ saṃjñāya ānandāsrāvilekṣaṇam ..
uvāca devī madhuraṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā satī .. 38 .. ..
16.3.d:
आनंदभावं संज्ञाय आनन्दास्राविलेक्षणम् ..
उवाच देवी मधुरं कृतांजलिपुटा सती .. 38 .. ..
16.3.m:
perceiving his state of bliss, his eyes brimming with tears of joy,
the virtuous Goddess spoke sweetly, folding her hands in reverence.

16.3.s:
devyuvāca .. ..
janmakoṭisahasrāṇi janmakoṭiśatāni ca ..
śodhitastvaṃ jagannātha mayā prāṇanaciṃtayā .. 39 ..
16.3.d:
देव्युवाच .. ..
जन्मकोटिसहस्राणि जन्मकोटिशतानि च ..
शोधितस्त्वं जगन्नाथ मया प्राणनचिंतया .. 39 ..
16.3.m:
The Goddess said:
For thousands of crores of births and hundreds of crores of births,
you have been sought by me, O Lord of the Universe, by meditation upon your life-breath,

16.3.s:
arddhāṃga saṃsthayā vāpi tvadvaktradhyānakāmyayā ..
tathāpi te jagannātha nāṃto labdhvo maheśvara .. 7.1.3.40 ..
16.3.d:
अर्द्धांग संस्थया वापि त्वद्वक्त्रध्यानकाम्यया ..
तथापि ते जगन्नाथ नांतो लब्ध्वो महेश्वर .. 7.1.3.40 ..
16.3.m:
or even by abiding as half your body, longing to meditate upon your face;
yet no limit to you has been found, O Lord of the Universe, O Great Lord!

16.3.s:
anantarūpiṇe tubhyaṃ devadeva namo'stu te ..
namo vedarahasyāya namo vedaiḥ stutāya ca .. 41 ..
16.3.d:
अनन्तरूपिणे तुभ्यं देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ..
नमो वेदरहस्याय नमो वेदैः स्तुताय च .. 41 ..
16.3.m:
Praise be to you whose form is infinite, O God of gods! Praise be to you!
Praise be to the secret of the Vedas! Praise to the one praised by the Vedas!

16.3.s:
śmaśānaratinityāya namo gaganacāriṇe ..
jyeṣṭhasāmarahasyāya śatarudrapriyāya ca .. 42 ..
16.3.d:
श्मशानरतिनित्याय नमो गगनचारिणे ..
ज्येष्ठसामरहस्याय शतरुद्रप्रियाय च .. 42 ..
16.3.m:
Praise to him who ever delights in the cremation ground, praise to the sky-farer,
to the secret of the Jyeṣṭhasāman, and to the one dear to the hundred Rudras!

16.3.s:
namo vṛṣakṛtāṃkāya yajurvedadharāya ca ..
brahmāṃḍakoṭisaṃlagnamāline gaganātmane .. 43 ..
16.3.d:
नमो वृषकृतांकाय यजुर्वेदधराय च ..
ब्रह्मांडकोटिसंलग्नमालिने गगनात्मने .. 43 ..
16.3.m:
Praise to him whose emblem is the bull, and who upholds the Yajurveda,
to the one who wears the garland of crores of clinging universes, whose self is space!

16.3.s:
maṇicitritakandāya namaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye ..
namo vedasvarūpāya dvija siddhipriyāya ca .. 44 ..
16.3.d:
मणिचित्रितकन्दाय नमः सर्वार्थसिद्धये ..
नमो वेदस्वरूपाय द्विज सिद्धिप्रियाय च .. 44 ..
16.3.m:
Praise to the bulbous root patterned with gems! Praise to the attainment of all aims!
Praise to the one whose form is the Veda, and who loves the perfection of the twice-born!

16.3.s:
puṃstrīvikārarūpāya namaścaṃdrārddhadhāriṇe ..
namognaye sahomāya ādityavaruṇāya ca .. 45 ..
16.3.d:
पुंस्त्रीविकाररूपाय नमश्चंद्रार्द्धधारिणे ..
नमोग्नये सहोमाय आदित्यवरुणाय च .. 45 ..
16.3.m:
Praise to the one whose form has the modifications of male and female, to the crescent-moon bearer!
Praise to Agni together with Soma, and to the Sun and Varuṇa!

16.3.s:
pṛthivyai cāṃtarikṣāya vāyave dīkṣitāya ca ..
saṃyogāya viyogāya dhātre kartre'pahāriṇe .. 46 ..
16.3.d:
पृथिव्यै चांतरिक्षाय वायवे दीक्षिताय च ..
संयोगाय वियोगाय धात्रे कर्त्रेऽपहारिणे .. 46 ..
16.3.m:
To the earth, the intermediate space, the wind, and the consecrated sacrificer;
to union, separation, the creator, the doer, and the destroyer!

16.3.s:
pradīptaśūlahastāya brahmadaṇḍadharāya ca ..
namaḥ patīnāṃ pataye mahatāṃ pataye namaḥ .... .. 47 ..
16.3.d:
प्रदीप्तशूलहस्ताय ब्रह्मदण्डधराय च ..
नमः पतीनां पतये महतां पतये नमः .... .. 47 ..
16.3.m:
To the one holding a blazing trident in his hand, and bearing the staff of Brahmā;
praise to the master of masters, praise to the master of the great!

16.3.s:
namaḥ kālāgnirudrāya saptalokanivāsine ..
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ .. 48 ..
16.3.d:
नमः कालाग्निरुद्राय सप्तलोकनिवासिने ..
त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानां भूतानां पतये नमः .. 48 ..
16.3.m:
Praise to Rudra as the fire of time, the dweller in the seven worlds!
You are the refuge of all beings; praise to the master of beings!

16.3.s:
namaste bhagavanrudra namaste bhagavañchiva ..
namaste parataḥ śreṣṭha namaste parataḥ para .. 49 ..
16.3.d:
नमस्ते भगवन्रुद्र नमस्ते भगवञ्छिव ..
नमस्ते परतः श्रेष्ठ नमस्ते परतः पर .. 49 ..
16.3.m:
Praise to you, O Lord Rudra! Praise to you, O Lord Śiva!
Praise to you, supreme beyond the high! Praise to you, higher than the highest!

16.3.s:
jihvācāpalyabhāvena khedito'si mayā prabho ..
tatkṣantavyaṃ maheśāna jñānadivya namo'stu te ..7.1.3.50 ..
16.3.d:
जिह्वाचापल्यभावेन खेदितोऽसि मया प्रभो ..
तत्क्षन्तव्यं महेशान ज्ञानदिव्य नमोऽस्तु ते ..7.1.3.50 ..
16.3.m:
Out of the restlessness of my tongue, you have been vexed by me, O Lord;
that should be forgiven, O Great Lord, O divine in knowledge, praise be to you!

16.3.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
mamotsaṃgasthitā devi kiṃ tvaṃ sāsrāvilekṣaṇā ..
adyāpi kimapūrṇaṃ te tatsarvaṃ karavāṇyaham .. 51 ..
16.3.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ममोत्संगस्थिता देवि किं त्वं सास्राविलेक्षणा ..
अद्यापि किमपूर्णं ते तत्सर्वं करवाण्यहम् .. 51 ..
16.3.m:
Īśvara said:
Seated on my lap, O goddess, why are your eyes clouded with tears? / What is still unfulfilled for you today? I shall do all of that. (51)

16.3.s:
varaṃ bravīhi bhadraṃ te stavenānena suvrate ..
dadāmi te na saṃdehaḥ śokaṃ tyaja maheśvari .. 52 ..
16.3.d:
वरं ब्रवीहि भद्रं ते स्तवेनानेन सुव्रते ..
ददामि ते न संदेहः शोकं त्यज महेश्वरि .. 52 ..
16.3.m: Choose a boon, bless you, because of this hymn of praise, O lady of good vows! / I grant it to you without doubt; abandon your grief, O Maheśvarī! (52)

16.3.s:
niṣkale sakale devi sthūle sūkṣme carācare ..
na tatpaśyāmi deveśi yattvayā rahitaṃ bhavet .. 53 ..
16.3.d:
निष्कले सकले देवि स्थूले सूक्ष्मे चराचरे ..
न तत्पश्यामि देवेशि यत्त्वया रहितं भवेत् .. 53 ..
16.3.m: In the partless and in the embodied, O goddess, in the gross and in the subtle, in all that moves and is still, / I see nothing, O ruler of gods, that could exist devoid of you. (53)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ te hṛdaye gauri tvaṃ ca me hṛdi saṃsthitā ..
ahaṃ bhrātā ca putraśca baṃdhurbhartā tathaiva ca .. 54 ..
16.3.d:
अहं ते हृदये गौरि त्वं च मे हृदि संस्थिता ..
अहं भ्राता च पुत्रश्च बंधुर्भर्ता तथैव च .. 54 ..
16.3.m: I dwell in your heart, O Gaurī, and you abide in my heart; / I am the brother and the son, the kinsman and likewise the husband. (54)

16.3.s:
tvaṃ tu me bhaginī bhāryā duhitā bāṃdhavī snuṣā ..
ahaṃ yajñapatiryajvā tvaṃ ca śraddhā sadakṣiṇā .. 55 ..
16.3.d:
त्वं तु मे भगिनी भार्या दुहिता बांधवी स्नुषा ..
अहं यज्ञपतिर्यज्वा त्वं च श्रद्धा सदक्षिणा .. 55 ..
16.3.m: You are indeed my sister, wife, daughter, female relation, and daughter-in-law; / I am the lord of the sacrifice and the sacrificer, and you are faith accompanied by the priestly gift. (55)

16.3.s:
oṃkāro'haṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ sāmāhamṛgyajustathā ..
ahamagniśca hotā ca yajamānastathaiva ca .. 56 ..
16.3.d:
ओंकारोऽहं वषट्कारः सामाहमृग्यजुस्तथा ..
अहमग्निश्च होता च यजमानस्तथैव च .. 56 ..
16.3.m: I am the syllable Om, the vaṣaṭ-call; I am the Sāman, the Ṛc, and the Yajus; / I am the fire, the invoking priest, and likewise the patron of the sacrifice. (56)

16.3.s:
adhvaryurahamudgātā brahmāhaṃ brahmavittathā ..
tvaṃ tu devyaraṇī caiva patnī tu parikīrtyase .. 57 ..
16.3.d:
अध्वर्युरहमुद्गाता ब्रह्माहं ब्रह्मवित्तथा ..
त्वं तु देव्यरणी चैव पत्नी तु परिकीर्त्यसे .. 57 ..
16.3.m: I am the Adhvaryu, the Udgātṛ, Brahmā, and the knower of the Veda; / you, O goddess, are proclaimed as the fire-drill and the sacrificer's wife. (57)

16.3.s:
svāhā svadhā ca suśroṇi tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
ahamiṣṭo mahāyajñaḥ pūrvo yajñastvamucyase .. 58 ..
16.3.d:
स्वाहा स्वधा च सुश्रोणि त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
अहमिष्टो महायज्ञः पूर्वो यज्ञस्त्वमुच्यसे .. 58 ..
16.3.m: Svāhā and Svadhā, O fair-hipped lady; everything is established in you. / I am the offered great sacrifice; you are called the primeval sacrifice. (58)

16.3.s:
puruṣo'haṃ varārohe prakṛtistvaṃ nigadyase ..
ahaṃ viṣṇurmahāvīryastvaṃ lakṣmīrlokabhāvinī .. 59 ..
16.3.d:
पुरुषोऽहं वरारोहे प्रकृतिस्त्वं निगद्यसे ..
अहं विष्णुर्महावीर्यस्त्वं लक्ष्मीर्लोकभाविनी .. 59 ..
16.3.m: I am Puruṣa, O beautiful woman; you are declared to be Prakṛti. / I am Viṣṇu of great prowess; you are Lakṣmī, who causes the world to prosper. (59)

16.3.s:
ahamindro mahātejāḥ prācī tvaṃ parameśvarī ..
prajāpatīnāṃ rūpeṇa sarvamāhaṃ vyavasthitaḥ .. 7.1.3.60 ..
16.3.d:
अहमिन्द्रो महातेजाः प्राची त्वं परमेश्वरी ..
प्रजापतीनां रूपेण सर्वमाहं व्यवस्थितः .. 7.1.3.60 ..
16.3.m: I am Indra of great splendor; you are the eastern quarter, O supreme sovereign. / In the form of the lords of creatures, I exist as all. (60)

16.3.s:
teṣāṃ yā nāyikāstāstvaṃ rūpaistaistairavasthitā ..
divaso'haṃ mahādevi rajanī tvaṃ nigadyase .. 61 ..
16.3.d:
तेषां या नायिकास्तास्त्वं रूपैस्तैस्तैरवस्थिता ..
दिवसोऽहं महादेवि रजनी त्वं निगद्यसे .. 61 ..
16.3.m: You abide in those various forms as their sovereign consorts. / I am the day, O great goddess; you are declared to be the night. (61)

16.3.s:
nimeṣo'haṃ muhūrtaśca tvaṃ kalā siddhireva ca ..
ahaṃ tejo'dhikaḥ sūryastvaṃ tu saṃdhyā prakīrttyase .. 62 ..
16.3.d:
निमेषोऽहं मुहूर्तश्च त्वं कला सिद्धिरेव च ..
अहं तेजोऽधिकः सूर्यस्त्वं तु संध्या प्रकीर्त्त्यसे .. 62 ..
16.3.m: I am the twinkle of an eye and the hour; you are the minute and accomplishment itself. / I am the sun exceeding in radiance; you are celebrated as the twilight. (62)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ bījadharaḥ śreṣṭhastvaṃ tu kṣetraṃ varānane.
ahaṃ vanaspatiḥ plakṣastvaṃ vanaspatirucyase .. .. 63 ..
16.3.d:
अहं बीजधरः श्रेष्ठस्त्वं तु क्षेत्रं वरानने.
अहं वनस्पतिः प्लक्षस्त्वं वनस्पतिरुच्यसे .. .. 63 ..
16.3.m: I am the supreme bearer of the seed, while you are the field, O fair-faced lady. / I am the lord of the forest, the fig tree; you are spoken of as the sacred tree. (63)

16.3.s:
śeṣarūpadharo nitye phaṇāmaṇivibhūṣitaḥ ..
revatī tvaṃ viśālākṣi madavibhramalocanā .. 64 ..
16.3.d:
शेषरूपधरो नित्ये फणामणिविभूषितः ..
रेवती त्वं विशालाक्षि मदविभ्रमलोचना .. 64 ..
16.3.m: I bear the form of Śeṣa, O eternal one, adorned with the jewel on the hood; / you are Revatī, O large-eyed one, with eyes rolling in intoxication. (64)

16.3.s:
mokṣo'haṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ tvaṃ tu devi parā gatiḥ ..
apāṃ patirahaṃ bhadre tvaṃ tu devi saridvarā .. 65 ..
16.3.d:
मोक्षोऽहं सर्वदुःखानां त्वं तु देवि परा गतिः ..
अपां पतिरहं भद्रे त्वं तु देवि सरिद्वरा .. 65 ..
16.3.m: I am liberation from all sorrows; you, O goddess, are the supreme goal. / I am the lord of the waters, O auspicious one; you, O goddess, are the best of rivers. (65)

16.3.s:
vaḍavāgnirahaṃ bhadre tvaṃ tu dīptiḥ prakīrtitā ..
prajāpatirahaṃ karttā tvaṃ prajā prakṛtistathā .. .. 66 ..
16.3.d:
वडवाग्निरहं भद्रे त्वं तु दीप्तिः प्रकीर्तिता ..
प्रजापतिरहं कर्त्ता त्वं प्रजा प्रकृतिस्तथा .. .. 66 ..
16.3.m: I am the submarine fire, O auspicious one; you are proclaimed as its brilliance. / I am the lord of creatures, the maker; you are the creatures and likewise primordial nature. (66)

16.3.s:
nāgānāmadhipaścāhaṃ pātālatalavāsinām ..
tvaṃ nāgī nāgarājo'haṃ sahasraphaṇabhūṣitaḥ .. 67 ..
16.3.d:
नागानामधिपश्चाहं पातालतलवासिनाम् ..
त्वं नागी नागराजोऽहं सहस्रफणभूषितः .. 67 ..
16.3.m: I am the lord of the serpents dwelling in the realm of Pātāla; / you are the serpent-goddess, and I am the king of serpents adorned with a thousand hoods. (67)

16.3.s:
niśākaravaraścāhaṃ śreṣṭhā tvaṃ rajanīkarī ..
kāmo'haṃ kāmado devi tvaṃ ratiḥ smṛtireva ca .. 68 ..
16.3.d:
निशाकरवरश्चाहं श्रेष्ठा त्वं रजनीकरी ..
कामोऽहं कामदो देवि त्वं रतिः स्मृतिरेव च .. 68 ..
16.3.m: I am the best maker of night [the moon]; you are the supreme illuminator of the night. / I am Kāma, the bestower of desire, O goddess; you are Rati and memory itself. (68)

16.3.s:
durvāsāścāpyahaṃ bhadre tvaṃ kṣamā samacāriṇī ..
lobhamohatapaścāhaṃ tvaṃ tṛṣṇā tāmasī smṛtā .. 69 ..
16.3.d:
दुर्वासाश्चाप्यहं भद्रे त्वं क्षमा समचारिणी ..
लोभमोहतपश्चाहं त्वं तृष्णा तामसी स्मृता .. 69 ..
16.3.m: I am Durvāsas, O auspicious one; you are forbearance walking beside him. / I am greed, delusion, and austerity; you are remembered as desire steeped in darkness. (69)

16.3.s:
kakudmānvṛṣabhaścāhaṃ yogamātā tapasvinī ..
vāyurapyahamavyaktastvaṃ gatirmanasūdanī .. 7.1.3.70 ..
16.3.d:
ककुद्मान्वृषभश्चाहं योगमाता तपस्विनी ..
वायुरप्यहमव्यक्तस्त्वं गतिर्मनसूदनी .. 7.1.3.70 ..
16.3.m: I am the humped bull; you are the ascetic mother of yoga. / I am also the unmanifest wind; you are its motion, destroyer of the mind. (70)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ mocayitā lobhe nirmamā tvaṃ yaśasvini ..
nayo'haṃ sarvakāryeṣu nītistvaṃ kamalekṣaṇā .. 71 ..
16.3.d:
अहं मोचयिता लोभे निर्ममा त्वं यशस्विनि ..
नयोऽहं सर्वकार्येषु नीतिस्त्वं कमलेक्षणा .. 71 ..
16.3.m: I am the deliverer in greed; you are the unattached one, O renowned lady. / I am prudence in all affairs; you are policy, O lotus-eyed lady. (71)

16.3.s:
ahamannaṃ ca bhoktā ca oṣadhī tvaṃ nigadyase ..
ahamagniśca dhūmaśca tvamūṣmā jvālameva ca .. 72 ..
16.3.d:
अहमन्नं च भोक्ता च ओषधी त्वं निगद्यसे ..
अहमग्निश्च धूमश्च त्वमूष्मा ज्वालमेव च .. 72 ..
16.3.m: I am the food and the eater; you are declared to be the medicinal herb. / I am the fire and the smoke; you are the heat and the flame. (72)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ saṃvarttako meghastvaṃ ca dhārā hyanekaśaḥ ..
ahaṃ munīnāṃ rūpeṇa tvaṃ tatpatnī prakīrtitā .. 73 ..
16.3.d:
अहं संवर्त्तको मेघस्त्वं च धारा ह्यनेकशः ..
अहं मुनीनां रूपेण त्वं तत्पत्नी प्रकीर्तिता .. 73 ..
16.3.m: I am the cloud of world-dissolution, and you are its manifold streams. / I appear in the form of the sages; you are proclaimed as their wives. (73)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ saṃsārakarttā vai tvaṃ tu sṛṣṭirvarānane ..
ahaṃ śukrāsthiromāṇi tvaṃ majjā balameva ca .. 74 ..
16.3.d:
अहं संसारकर्त्ता वै त्वं तु सृष्टिर्वरानने ..
अहं शुक्रास्थिरोमाणि त्वं मज्जा बलमेव च .. 74 ..
16.3.m: I am the maker of the cycle of existence; you are the creation, O fair-faced lady. / I am semen, bones, and hairs; you are marrow and strength. (74)

16.3.s:
parjanyo'haṃ mahābhāge tvaṃ vṛṣṭiḥ parameśvari ..
ahaṃ saṃvatsaro devi tvamṛtuḥ parikīrttitā .. 75 ..
16.3.d:
पर्जन्योऽहं महाभागे त्वं वृष्टिः परमेश्वरि ..
अहं संवत्सरो देवि त्वमृतुः परिकीर्त्तिता .. 75 ..
16.3.m: I am the rain-cloud, O highly fortunate one; you are the rain, O supreme sovereign. / I am the year, O goddess; you are celebrated as the season. (75)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ kṛtayugo devi tvaṃ tu tretā nigadyase ..
yugo'haṃ dvāparaḥ śrīmāṃstvaṃ kaliḥ parameśvari .. 76 ..
16.3.d:
अहं कृतयुगो देवि त्वं तु त्रेता निगद्यसे ..
युगोऽहं द्वापरः श्रीमांस्त्वं कलिः परमेश्वरि .. 76 ..
16.3.m: I am the Kṛta age, O goddess; you are declared to be the Tretā age. / I am the glorious Dvāpara age; you are the Kali age, O supreme sovereign. (76)

16.3.s:
ākāśaścāpyahaṃ bhadre pṛthivī tvamihocyase ..
ahamadṛśyamūrtiśca dṛśyamūrtistvamucyase .. 77 ..
16.3.d:
आकाशश्चाप्यहं भद्रे पृथिवी त्वमिहोच्यसे ..
अहमदृश्यमूर्तिश्च दृश्यमूर्तिस्त्वमुच्यसे .. 77 ..
16.3.m: I am space, O auspicious one; you are spoken of here as the earth. / I am the invisible form, and you are called the visible form. (77)

16.3.s:
varado'haṃ varārohe maṃtrastvamiti cocyase ..
ahaṃ draṣṭā ca śrotā ca tvaṃ dṛśyā śrutireva ca ..78..
16.3.d:
वरदोऽहं वरारोहे मंत्रस्त्वमिति चोच्यसे ..
अहं द्रष्टा च श्रोता च त्वं दृश्या श्रुतिरेव च ..78..
16.3.m: I am the bestower of boons, O lady of beautiful hips; and you are spoken of as the mantra. / I am the seer and the hearer; you are the visible and the heard revelation. (78)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ vaktā ramayitā tvaṃ vācyā parameśvari ..
ahaṃ śrotā ca gātā ca tvaṃ gītirgeyameva ca..79..
16.3.d:
अहं वक्ता रमयिता त्वं वाच्या परमेश्वरि ..
अहं श्रोता च गाता च त्वं गीतिर्गेयमेव च..79..
16.3.m: I am the speaker and the delighter; you are that which is to be spoken, O supreme sovereign. / I am the listener and the singer; you are the song and that which is to be sung. (79)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ trātā ca gandhaśca tvaṃ tu nighrāṇameva ca ..
ahaṃ sparśayitā kartā sparśyastvaṃ sṛṣṭameva ca .. 7.1.3.80 ..
16.3.d:
अहं त्राता च गन्धश्च त्वं तु निघ्राणमेव च ..
अहं स्पर्शयिता कर्ता स्पर्श्यस्त्वं सृष्टमेव च .. 7.1.3.80 ..
16.3.m: I am the protector and the fragrance; you are the sense of smell. / I am the caresser and the agent; you are the touched and the created. (80)

16.3.s:
ahaṃ sarvamidaṃ bhūtaṃ tvaṃ tu devi na saṃśayaḥ ..
sraṣṭā'haṃ tava deveśi tvaṃ sṛjasyakhilaṃ jagat .. 81 ..
16.3.d:
अहं सर्वमिदं भूतं त्वं तु देवि न संशयः ..
स्रष्टाऽहं तव देवेशि त्वं सृजस्यखिलं जगत् .. 81 ..
16.3.m: I am this entire universe, and you are too, O goddess, without doubt. / I am your creator, O ruler of gods, and you create the entire world. (81)

16.3.s:
tvayā mayā ca deveśi otaprotamidaṃ jagat ..
ekadhā daśadhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā .. 82 ..
16.3.d:
त्वया मया च देवेशि ओतप्रोतमिदं जगत् ..
एकधा दशधा चैव तथा शतसहस्रधा .. 82 ..
16.3.m: By you and by me, O ruler of gods, this world is woven warp and woof, / in a single form, in tenfold form, and likewise in hundreds and thousands of forms. (82)

16.3.s:
aiśvaryeṇa tu saṃyuktau sarvaprāṇi vyavasthitau ..
ahaṃ tvaṃ ca viśālākṣi satataṃ saṃpratiṣṭhitau .. 83 ..
16.3.d:
ऐश्वर्येण तु संयुक्तौ सर्वप्राणि व्यवस्थितौ ..
अहं त्वं च विशालाक्षि सततं संप्रतिष्ठितौ .. 83 ..
16.3.m: Endowed with sovereignty, abiding in all living beings, / I and you, O large-eyed one, are constantly established. (83)

16.3.s:
krīḍāmi krīḍayā devi tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane ..
tvaṃ dhṛtirdhāriṇī lakṣmīḥ kāṃtā matprakṛtirdhruvam .. 84 ..
16.3.d:
क्रीडामि क्रीडया देवि त्वया सार्द्धं वरानने ..
त्वं धृतिर्धारिणी लक्ष्मीः कांता मत्प्रकृतिर्ध्रुवम् .. 84 ..
16.3.m: I play sportively with you, O goddess, O fair-faced one! / You are firmness, the earth, fortune, the beloved, and certainly my Prakṛti. (84)

16.3.s:
ratiḥ smṛtiḥ kāmacārī mama cāṃganivāsinī ..
devi kiṃ bahunoktena prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī .. 85 ..
16.3.d:
रतिः स्मृतिः कामचारी मम चांगनिवासिनी ..
देवि किं बहुनोक्तेन प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी .. 85 ..
16.3.m: Pleasure, memory, moving at will, and dwelling within my body— / O goddess, what need is there to say much? You are dearer than life itself. (85)

16.3.s:
varaṃ varaya devaśi yatkiṃcinmanasi sthitam..
tatte dadāmi tuṣṭo'haṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham .. 86 ..
16.3.d:
वरं वरय देवशि यत्किंचिन्मनसि स्थितम्..
तत्ते ददामि तुष्टोऽहं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम् .. 86 ..
16.3.m: Choose a boon, O ruler of gods, whatever lies in your heart; / pleased as I am, I give that to you, even if it were very hard to attain. (86)

16.3.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
dhanyāhaṃ kṛtapuṇyāhaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ mayā ..
yattvayā'haṃ jagannātha harṣadṛṣṭyā'valokitā .. 87 ..
16.3.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
धन्याहं कृतपुण्याहं तपः सुचरितं मया ..
यत्त्वयाऽहं जगन्नाथ हर्षदृष्ट्याऽवलोकिता .. 87 ..
16.3.m:
The goddess said:
I am blessed, my merit is accomplished, my austerity has been well performed, / since I have been looked upon by you, O Lord of the universe, with a gaze of joy. (87)

16.3.s:
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dātuṃ mamecchasi ..
tanme kathaya deveśa sāṃprataṃ tīrthavistaram .. .. 88 ..
16.3.d:
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव वरं दातुं ममेच्छसि ..
तन्मे कथय देवेश सांप्रतं तीर्थविस्तरम् .. .. 88 ..
16.3.m: If you are pleased with me, O god, and wish to give me a boon, / then tell me now, O lord of gods, the detailed account of sacred fords. (88)

16.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pāpaghnāni śivāni ca ..
tāni deveśa kārtsnyena yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 89 ..
16.3.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पापघ्नानि शिवानि च ..
तानि देवेश कार्त्स्न्येन यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 89 ..
16.3.m: Whatever sacred fords there are on earth that destroy sin and are auspicious, / you ought to tell of them in full, as they are, O lord of gods. (89)

16.3.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ puṇyaṃ devarṣisatkṛtam .. 7.1.3.90 ..
16.3.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
सर्वपापहरं नृणां पुण्यं देवर्षिसत्कृतम् .. 7.1.3.90 ..
16.3.m:
Īśvara said:
Listen, O goddess, I shall proclaim the supreme māhātmya of sacred fords, / which takes away all sins of mortals, is meritorious, and is honored by divine seers. (90)

16.3.s:
tīrthānāṃ darśanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ snānaṃ caiva sureśvari ..
śravaṇaṃ ca praśaṃsaṃti sadaiva ṛṣisattamāḥ .. 91 ..
16.3.d:
तीर्थानां दर्शनं श्रेष्ठं स्नानं चैव सुरेश्वरि ..
श्रवणं च प्रशंसंति सदैव ऋषिसत्तमाः .. 91 ..
16.3.m: The best seers ever praise the darśana of sacred fords, / ritual ablution in them, O ruler of gods, and hearing about them. (91)

16.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthamaṃtarikṣe ca puṣkaram ..
kedāraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca vipāśā cormilā tathā .. 92 ..
16.3.d:
पृथिव्यां नैमिषं तीर्थमंतरिक्षे च पुष्करम् ..
केदारं च प्रयागं च विपाशा चोर्मिला तथा .. 92 ..
16.3.m: On earth is the sacred ford of Naimiṣa, and in the atmosphere Puṣkara; / and Kedāra, Prayāga, Vipāśā, and likewise Urmilā, (92)

16.3.s:
karṇaveṇā mahādevī caṃdrabhāgā sarasvatī ..
gaṃgāsāgarasaṃbhedastathā vārāṇasī śubhā .. 93 ..
16.3.d:
कर्णवेणा महादेवी चंद्रभागा सरस्वती ..
गंगासागरसंभेदस्तथा वाराणसी शुभा .. 93 ..
16.3.m: Karṇaveṇā, Mahādevī, Candrabhāgā, Sarasvatī, / the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean, and auspicious Vārāṇasī. (93)

16.3.s:
arghatīrthaṃ samākhyātaṃ gaṃgādvāraṃ tathaiva ca ..
himasthānaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tathā māyāpurī śubhā .. 94 ..
16.3.d:
अर्घतीर्थं समाख्यातं गंगाद्वारं तथैव च ..
हिमस्थानं महातीर्थं तथा मायापुरी शुभा .. 94 ..
16.3.m: Arghatīrtha is proclaimed, and likewise Gaṅgādvāra, / the great sacred ford Himasthāna, and likewise auspicious Māyāpurī,

16.3.s:
śatabhadrā mahābhāgā sindhuścaiva mahā nadī ..
airāvatī ca kapilā śoṇaścaiva mahānadaḥ .. 95 ..
16.3.d:
शतभद्रा महाभागा सिन्धुश्चैव महा नदी ..
ऐरावती च कपिला शोणश्चैव महानदः .. 95 ..
16.3.m: the most fortunate Śatabhadrā, and the Sindhu, that great river, / the Airāvatī, the Kapilā, and the Śoṇa, that great river,

16.3.s:
payodhiḥ kauśikī tadvattathā godāvarī śubhā ..
devakhātaṃ gayā caiva tathā dvārāvatī śubhā .. 96 ..
16.3.d:
पयोधिः कौशिकी तद्वत्तथा गोदावरी शुभा ..
देवखातं गया चैव तथा द्वारावती शुभा .. 96 ..
16.3.m: likewise the Ocean, the Kauśikī, and the auspicious Godāvarī, / Devakhāta, Gayā, and auspicious Dvārāvatī,

16.3.s: prabhāsaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 97 ..
16.3.d: प्रभासं च महातीर्थं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 97 ..
16.3.m: and the great sacred ford Prabhāsa, which destroys all sins.

16.3.s:
evamādīni tīrthāni yāni saṃti mahītale ..
tāni dṛṣṭvā tu deveśi punarjanma na vindate ..98..
16.3.d:
एवमादीनि तीर्थानि यानि संति महीतले ..
तानि दृष्ट्वा तु देवेशि पुनर्जन्म न विन्दते ..98..
16.3.m: Having seen these and other sacred fords that exist on the face of the earth, / O queen of the gods, one does not undergo rebirth again.

16.3.s:
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāmiha bhūtale ..
saṃjātāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ..99..
16.3.d:
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्धकोटी च तीर्थानामिह भूतले ..
संजातानि पवित्राणि सर्वपापहराणि च ..99..
16.3.m: Three and a half crores of sacred fords on this earth / have come into being, pure and removing all sins.

16.3.s:
gaṃtavyāni mahādevi svadharmasya vivṛddhaye ..
aśakyāni śivānyevaṃ gaṃtuṃ caiva sureśvari ..
manasā tāni sarvāṇi gaṃtavyāni samāhitaiḥ .. 7.1.3.100 ..
16.3.d:
गंतव्यानि महादेवि स्वधर्मस्य विवृद्धये ..
अशक्यानि शिवान्येवं गंतुं चैव सुरेश्वरि ..
मनसा तानि सर्वाणि गंतव्यानि समाहितैः .. 7.1.3.100 ..
16.3.m: One must visit them, O great goddess, for the increase of one's own dharma. / But since it is impossible to visit them [all] physically, O queen of gods, / they should all be visited mentally by the concentrated.

16.3.s:
. devyuvāca..
bhagavanprāṇinaḥ sarve sarvopadravasaṃkulāḥ..
alpāyuṣaḥ sadā baddhā vyāmohairmaṃdirodbhavaiḥ..101..
16.3.d:
. देव्युवाच..
भगवन्प्राणिनः सर्वे सर्वोपद्रवसंकुलाः..
अल्पायुषः सदा बद्धा व्यामोहैर्मंदिरोद्भवैः..101..
16.3.m: The goddess said: / O Lord, all living beings are beset with all kinds of distress; / short-lived, they are constantly bound by delusions born of home and family.

16.3.s:
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kiṃ nu vai dāruṇe kalau ..
tasmātteṣāṃ hitārthāya tattīrthaṃ tvaṃ prakīrtaya ..
yena dṛṣṭena sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ labhyate phalam ..102..
16.3.d:
त्रेतायां द्वापरे चैव किं नु वै दारुणे कलौ ..
तस्मात्तेषां हितार्थाय तत्तीर्थं त्वं प्रकीर्तय ..
येन दृष्टेन सर्वेषां तीर्थानां लभ्यते फलम् ..102..
16.3.m: If it is so in the Tretā and Dvāpara [ages], what of the dreadful Kali [age]? / Therefore, for their benefit, proclaim that sacred ford / by seeing which the fruit of all sacred fords is obtained.

16.3.s:
evamuktastu pārvatyā prahasya parameśvaraḥ ..
uvāca parayā prītyā vācā madhurayā prabhuḥ ..103.. ..
16.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु पार्वत्या प्रहस्य परमेश्वरः ..
उवाच परया प्रीत्या वाचा मधुरया प्रभुः ..103.. ..
16.3.m: Thus addressed by Pārvatī, the supreme Lord, smiling, / the master spoke with supreme affection in sweet words:

16.3.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
tvameva hi carāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvasya jagatoraṇiḥ ..
tvayā virahito devi muhūrtamapi notsahe ..104..
16.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
त्वमेव हि चराः प्राणाः सर्वस्य जगतोरणिः ..
त्वया विरहितो देवि मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे ..104..
16.3.m: Īśvara said: / You alone are my moving breath of life, the kindling-stick of the entire universe; / separated from you, O goddess, I cannot bear even a moment.

16.3.s:
śivasya ca tathā śakteraṃtaraṃ nāsti pārvati ..
na tadasti mahādevi yanna jānāsi śobhane .. 105 ..
16.3.d:
शिवस्य च तथा शक्तेरंतरं नास्ति पार्वति ..
न तदस्ति महादेवि यन्न जानासि शोभने .. 105 ..
16.3.m: Between Śiva and Śakti there is no difference, O Pārvatī; / there is nothing, O great goddess, beautiful one, that you do not know.

16.3.s:
tvayā vinā'haṃ na kvāsmi na tvaṃ devi mayā vinā ..
caṃdracaṃdrikayoryadvadagneruṣṇatvameva hi .. 106 ..
16.3.d:
त्वया विनाऽहं न क्वास्मि न त्वं देवि मया विना ..
चंद्रचंद्रिकयोर्यद्वदग्नेरुष्णत्वमेव हि .. 106 ..
16.3.m: Without you, where am I? And you are not without me, O goddess— / just as between the moon and moonlight, or heat in fire.

16.3.s:
tava devi mamāpīha nāsti caivāṃtaraṃ priye ..
sarvaṃ caiva sureśāni yathāvatkathayāmyaham .. 107 ..
16.3.d:
तव देवि ममापीह नास्ति चैवांतरं प्रिये ..
सर्वं चैव सुरेशानि यथावत्कथयाम्यहम् .. 107 ..
16.3.m: Between you, O goddess, and me here, there is indeed no difference, my beloved; / and I will tell you everything as it truly is, O queen of gods.

16.3.s:
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ tu gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ..
nāstikāya na dātavyaṃ na ca pāparatāya ca .. 108 ..
16.3.d:
रहस्यानां रहस्यं तु गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः ..
नास्तिकाय न दातव्यं न च पापरताय च .. 108 ..
16.3.m: This secret of secrets, however, must be guarded with effort; / it must not be given to an atheist, nor to one devoted to sin.

16.3.s:
dātavyaṃ bhakti yuktāya svaśiṣyāya sutāya vā ..
pūrvameva mayā khyātaṃ sārātsārataraṃ priye ..109..
16.3.d:
दातव्यं भक्ति युक्ताय स्वशिष्याय सुताय वा ..
पूर्वमेव मया ख्यातं सारात्सारतरं प्रिये ..109..
16.3.m: It should be given to one endowed with devotion, to one's own disciple or son. / That which is more essential than the essence was previously proclaimed by me, beloved:

16.3.s:
tīrthopaniṣadaḥ khyātā liṃgopaniṣadastathā ..
yogopaniṣado devi pūrvaṃ vai kathitāstava .. 7.1.3.110 ..
16.3.d:
तीर्थोपनिषदः ख्याता लिंगोपनिषदस्तथा ..
योगोपनिषदो देवि पूर्वं वै कथितास्तव .. 7.1.3.110 ..
16.3.m: the Secret Doctrines of the sacred fords were proclaimed, likewise the Secret Doctrines of the liṅgas, / and the Secret Doctrines of yoga, O goddess, were formerly told to you.

16.3.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
leśenāpi na siddhyaṃti kāṃkṣamāṇāḥ paraṃ padam ..
yonīrbhramaṃto dṛśyaṃte narā nāstikavṛttayaḥ.. .. 111 ..
16.3.d:
.. पार्वत्युवाच .. ..
लेशेनापि न सिद्ध्यंति कांक्षमाणाः परं पदम् ..
योनीर्भ्रमंतो दृश्यंते नरा नास्तिकवृत्तयः.. .. 111 ..
16.3.m: Pārvatī said: / Though desiring the supreme state, they do not succeed even in the least; / men of atheistic conduct are seen wandering from womb to womb.

16.3.s:
tīrthavratāni sevante pratyayo naiva jāyate ..
mohitaṃ tu jagatpūrvaṃ mithyājñānena śaṃkara .. 112 ..
16.3.d:
तीर्थव्रतानि सेवन्ते प्रत्ययो नैव जायते ..
मोहितं तु जगत्पूर्वं मिथ्याज्ञानेन शंकर .. 112 ..
16.3.m: They observe vows at sacred fords, yet conviction never arises. / Formerly the world was deluded by false knowledge, O Śaṃkara;

16.3.s: kiṃ te phalaṃ suraśreṣṭha jagadvyāmohane kṛte .. 113 ..
16.3.d: किं ते फलं सुरश्रेष्ठ जगद्व्यामोहने कृते .. 113 ..
16.3.m: what fruit was yours, O best of gods, when that bewilderment of the world was made?

16.3.s:
sārātsārataraṃ nātha tava prāṇapriyaṃ hi yat ..
tanme kathaya deveśa priyāhaṃ yadi te prabho .. 114 ..
16.3.d:
सारात्सारतरं नाथ तव प्राणप्रियं हि यत् ..
तन्मे कथय देवेश प्रियाहं यदि ते प्रभो .. 114 ..
16.3.m: Tell me, O Lord of gods, if I am dear to you, O master, / that which is more essential than the essence, my Lord, which is as dear to you as life itself.

16.3.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tayā devyā śrīkaṃṭhaḥ suranāyakaḥ ..
prahasyovāca bhagavāngaṃbhīrārthamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 115 ..
16.3.d:
इत्युक्तः स तया देव्या श्रीकंठः सुरनायकः ..
प्रहस्योवाच भगवान्गंभीरार्थमिदं वचः .. 115 ..
16.3.m: Thus addressed by that goddess, the Lord Śrīkaṇṭha, leader of the gods, / smiled and spoke these words of profound meaning:

16.3.s:
..īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā pṛṣṭo'haṃ yastvayā'dhunā ..
niṣphalaṃ tatpravakṣyāmi vastutattvaṃ yathāsthitam .. 116 ..
16.3.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणुष्वावहिता भूत्वा पृष्टोऽहं यस्त्वयाऽधुना ..
निष्फलं तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि वस्तुतत्त्वं यथास्थितम् .. 116 ..
16.3.m: Īśvara said: / Listen attentively, since I am now asked by you; / I will tell you the true nature of things as it is, which is never without result.

16.3.s:
pūrvamuktāni tīrthāni yāni te surasuṃdari ..
tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭī ca brahmāṃḍe sacarācare ..117..
16.3.d:
पूर्वमुक्तानि तीर्थानि यानि ते सुरसुंदरि ..
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्द्धकोटी च ब्रह्मांडे सचराचरे ..117..
16.3.m: Those sacred fords previously spoken of to you, O beauty of the gods, / three and a half crores throughout the cosmic egg of moving and unmoving beings—

16.3.s: teṣāṃ ca gopitaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāsaṃ caiva suvrate ..118..
16.3.d: तेषां च गोपितं तीर्थं प्रभासं चैव सुव्रते ..118..
16.3.m: among them the sacred ford Prabhāsa has been kept concealed, O woman of good vows.

16.3.s:
evamuktaṃ mahādevi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
dṛṣṭvā saṃskārarahitāḥ kalau pāpena mohitāḥ .. 119 ..
16.3.d:
एवमुक्तं महादेवि प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
दृष्ट्वा संस्काररहिताः कलौ पापेन मोहिताः .. 119 ..
16.3.m: Thus has the supreme sacred field Prabhāsa been spoken of, O great goddess. / But seeing it, those devoid of proper purifications, deluded by sin in the Kali age,

16.3.s:
rājasāstāmasāścaiva pāpopahatacetasaḥ ..
paradāraparadravyaparahiṃsāratā narāḥ .. 7.1.3.120 ..
16.3.d:
राजसास्तामसाश्चैव पापोपहतचेतसः ..
परदारपरद्रव्यपरहिंसारता नराः .. 7.1.3.120 ..
16.3.m: governed by passion and darkness, their minds afflicted by sin, / men devoted to other men's wives, other men's wealth, and harming others,

16.3.s:
udvegaṃ ca paraṃ yāṃti pratapyaṃti yatastataḥ ..
ātmasaṃbhāvitā mūḍhā mithyājñānena mohitāḥ..
varṇāśramaviruddhaṃ tu tīrthe kurvanti ye'dhamāḥ..121..
16.3.d:
उद्वेगं च परं यांति प्रतप्यंति यतस्ततः ..
आत्मसंभाविता मूढा मिथ्याज्ञानेन मोहिताः..
वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धं तु तीर्थे कुर्वन्ति येऽधमाः..121..
16.3.m: fall into supreme agitation and suffer torment here and there. / Self-conceited fools, deluded by false knowledge, / those base men who act contrary to caste and stage of life at a sacred ford,

16.3.s:
tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvaṃti daṃbhena kapaṭena ca..
tīrthe mṛtā na sidhyaṃti te narā varavarṇini .. 122 ..
16.3.d:
तीर्थयात्रां प्रकुर्वंति दंभेन कपटेन च..
तीर्थे मृता न सिध्यंति ते नरा वरवर्णिनि .. 122 ..
16.3.m: who undertake a pilgrimage to a sacred ford with deceit and hypocrisy— / even if they die at a sacred ford, those men do not attain perfection, O fair-complexioned one.

16.3.s:
etadarthaṃ mayā devi tīrthāni vividhāni ca ..
liṃgāni caiva suśroṇi gopitāni prayatnataḥ ..
na siddhidāni deveśi kalau kalmaṣakāriṇām .. 123 ..
16.3.d:
एतदर्थं मया देवि तीर्थानि विविधानि च ..
लिंगानि चैव सुश्रोणि गोपितानि प्रयत्नतः ..
न सिद्धिदानि देवेशि कलौ कल्मषकारिणाम् .. 123 ..
16.3.m: For this reason, O goddess, the various sacred fords / and the liṅgas, O shapely-hipped woman, were kept concealed with effort; / they do not grant perfection, O queen of gods, to evildoers in the Kali age.

16.3.s:
ye narāstu jitakrodhā jitalobhā jiteṃdriyāḥ ..
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścādambhamatsarāḥ .. 124 ..
16.3.d:
ये नरास्तु जितक्रोधा जितलोभा जितेंद्रियाः ..
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चादम्भमत्सराः .. 124 ..
16.3.m: Those men, however, who have conquered anger, conquered greed, and conquered the senses, / brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras free from deceit and malice,

16.3.s:
madbhāvabhāvitā devi tīrthaṃ sevaṃti suvratāḥ ..
teṣāṃ caiva hitārthāya kathayāmi yaśaśvini .. 125 ..
16.3.d:
मद्भावभाविता देवि तीर्थं सेवंति सुव्रताः ..
तेषां चैव हितार्थाय कथयामि यशश्विनि .. 125 ..
16.3.m: filled with devotion to me, O goddess, who observe vows and frequent the sacred ford— / for their benefit alone I speak, O renowned one.

16.3.s:
prabhāsamiti vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ trailokyavaṃditam ..
tatkṣetraṃ naiva jānaṃti mama māyāvimohitāḥ .. 126 ..
16.3.d:
प्रभासमिति विख्यातं क्षेत्रं त्रैलोक्यवंदितम् ..
तत्क्षेत्रं नैव जानंति मम मायाविमोहिताः .. 126 ..
16.3.m: The sacred field known as Prabhāsa is praised throughout the three worlds; / deluded by my māyā, they do not recognize that sacred field.

16.3.s:
parohaṃ tvekacittaiśca bahujanmabhirarcitaḥ ..
te vidaṃti paraṃ kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 127 ..
16.3.d:
परोहं त्वेकचित्तैश्च बहुजन्मभिरर्चितः ..
ते विदंति परं क्षेत्रं प्रभासं पापनाशनम् .. 127 ..
16.3.m: Only those by whom I, the Supreme, have been worshipped with single-minded focus through many births, / know the supreme sacred field Prabhāsa, which destroys sin.

16.3.s:
madbhāvabhāvitā devi mama vrataniṣeviṇaḥ ..
teṣāṃ prabhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ viditaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 128 ..
16.3.d:
मद्भावभाविता देवि मम व्रतनिषेविणः ..
तेषां प्रभासिकं क्षेत्रं विदितं नात्र संशयः .. 128 ..
16.3.m: Those imbued with devotion to me, O goddess, who observe my vows— / by them the sacred field of Prabhāsa is known; of this there is no doubt.

16.3.s:
yamaiśca niyamairyuktā ahaṃkāravivarjjitāḥ ..
teṣāmarthe vadiṣyāmi tava praśnaṃ sudurllabham ..
brahmaviṣṇvindradevānāṃ purāṇaṃ kathitaṃ mayā .. 129 ..
16.3.d:
यमैश्च नियमैर्युक्ता अहंकारविवर्ज्जिताः ..
तेषामर्थे वदिष्यामि तव प्रश्नं सुदुर्ल्लभम् ..
ब्रह्मविष्ण्विन्द्रदेवानां पुराणं कथितं मया .. 129 ..
16.3.m: Endowed with restraints and observances, free from egotism— / for their sake I will answer your question, which is very hard to obtain. / Formerly it was told by me to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, and the gods.

16.3.s:
so'haṃ devi vadiṣyāmi karṇaṃ dehi varānane ..
pṛthivyāmapi sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ surasuṃdari .. 7.1.3.130 ..
16.3.d:
सोऽहं देवि वदिष्यामि कर्णं देहि वरानने ..
पृथिव्यामपि सर्वेषां तीर्थानां सुरसुंदरि .. 7.1.3.130 ..
16.3.m: That I will declare, O goddess; give ear, O fair-faced one! / Among all the sacred fords on earth, O beauty of the gods,

16.3.s:
ekaṃ me vallabhaṃ tatra prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
tasmiṃścaiva mahākṣetre tīrthaiḥ somena pūjitaḥ ..
varāṃstasmai pradāyātha sadaikāṃte sthito hyaham ..131..
16.3.d:
एकं मे वल्लभं तत्र प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
तस्मिंश्चैव महाक्षेत्रे तीर्थैः सोमेन पूजितः ..
वरांस्तस्मै प्रदायाथ सदैकांते स्थितो ह्यहम् ..131..
16.3.m: there is one dear to me: the supreme sacred field Prabhāsa. / And in that great sacred field, worshipped with sacred fords by Soma, / after granting boons to him, I abide perpetually in solitude.

16.3.s:
tena guhyaṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ tava devi prakāśitam..
tatra me yogayuktasya divyaṃ liṃgaṃ babhūva ha .. 132 ..
16.3.d:
तेन गुह्यं कृतं स्थानं तव देवि प्रकाशितम्..
तत्र मे योगयुक्तस्य दिव्यं लिंगं बभूव ह .. 132 ..
16.3.m: That secret place made by him has been revealed to you, O goddess; / there, as I was absorbed in yoga, a celestial liṅga appeared.

16.3.s:
divyatejassamā yuktaṃ vahnimekhalamaṃḍitam ..
lakṣamātrasthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ tu mānavaiḥ .. 133 ..
16.3.d:
दिव्यतेजस्समा युक्तं वह्निमेखलमंडितम् ..
लक्षमात्रस्थितं शांतं दुर्निरीक्ष्यं तु मानवैः .. 133 ..
16.3.m: Endowed with celestial splendour, encircled by a girdle of fire, / extending a mere hundred thousand [measures], tranquil, yet difficult for mortals to behold.

16.3.s:
icchājñānakriyākhyāśca tisro vai śaktayaśca yāḥ ..
tasmālliṃgātsamutpannā jagatkartṛtvahetave .. 134 ..
16.3.d:
इच्छाज्ञानक्रियाख्याश्च तिस्रो वै शक्तयश्च याः ..
तस्माल्लिंगात्समुत्पन्ना जगत्कर्तृत्वहेतवे .. 134 ..
16.3.m: And the three powers known as will, knowledge, and action / arose from that liṅga for the purpose of creating the universe.

16.3.s:
tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yāti jagadetaccarācaram ..
punastenaiva saṃbhūtaṃ dṛśyate sacarācaram .. 135 ..
16.3.d:
तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे लयं याति जगदेतच्चराचरम् ..
पुनस्तेनैव संभूतं दृश्यते सचराचरम् .. 135 ..
16.3.m: Into that liṅga this universe of moving and unmoving beings dissolves, / and from that alone it is seen to arise again with its moving and unmoving beings.

16.3.s:
guhyaṃ caiva tu saṃbhūtaṃ na kaścidveda tatparam ..
janmābhyāsena talliṃgaṃ jñāyate bhuvi mānavaiḥ .. 136 ..
16.3.d:
गुह्यं चैव तु संभूतं न कश्चिद्वेद तत्परम् ..
जन्माभ्यासेन तल्लिंगं ज्ञायते भुवि मानवैः .. 136 ..
16.3.m: It arose as a mystery, and no one knows what lies beyond it. / Through the practice of [many] births, that liṅga is recognized by mortals on earth.

16.3.s:
kṣetraṃ prabhāsikaṃ proktaṃ kṣetrajño'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
tatra someśanāmāhamasminkṣetraṃ varānane .. 137 ..
16.3.d:
क्षेत्रं प्रभासिकं प्रोक्तं क्षेत्रज्ञोऽहं न संशयः ..
तत्र सोमेशनामाहमस्मिन्क्षेत्रं वरानने .. 137 ..
16.3.m: The sacred field is called Prabhāsa, and I am the Knower of the Field without doubt. / There, in this sacred field, O fair-faced lady, I bear the name Someśa.

16.3.s:
mamāṃśasaṃbhavā ye ca asminkṣetre samudbhavāḥ ..
teṣāṃ tu viditaṃ liṃgaṃ pūrvakalpe tu bhairavam .. 138 ..
16.3.d:
ममांशसंभवा ये च अस्मिन्क्षेत्रे समुद्भवाः ..
तेषां तु विदितं लिंगं पूर्वकल्पे तु भैरवम् .. 138 ..
16.3.m: Those who are born of my portion and are born in this sacred field, / to them this formidable liṅga was known even in a previous kalpa.

16.3.s:
anyairapi yugairdevi idaṃ liṃgaṃ sudurlabham ..
ghore kaliyuge pāpe viśeṣeṇa ca durlabham .. 139 ..
16.3.d:
अन्यैरपि युगैर्देवि इदं लिंगं सुदुर्लभम् ..
घोरे कलियुगे पापे विशेषेण च दुर्लभम् .. 139 ..
16.3.m: Even in other ages, O goddess, this liṅga is very difficult to attain; / in the dreadful and sinful Kali age, it is especially difficult to attain.

16.3.s: anyannidarśanaṃ tatra tatpravakṣyāmi pārvati .. 7.1.3.140 ..
16.3.d: अन्यन्निदर्शनं तत्र तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि पार्वति .. 7.1.3.140 ..
16.3.m: There is another illustration in this matter; I shall declare it, O Pārvatī.

16.3.s:
kalau yuge mahāghore hetuvādaratā narāḥ ..
vadiṣyaṃti mahāpāpāḥ sarve pākhaṇḍasaṃsthitāḥ .. 141 ..
16.3.d:
कलौ युगे महाघोरे हेतुवादरता नराः ..
वदिष्यंति महापापाः सर्वे पाखण्डसंस्थिताः .. 141 ..
16.3.m: In the exceedingly dreadful Kali age, men devoted to sophistry, / greatly sinful and entirely given to heresy, will say:

16.3.s:
mithyā caitatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mūrkhaiścāpi prakīrtitam ..
kva kṣetraṃ kva prabhāvaśca kutra vai santi devatāḥ .. 142 ..
16.3.d:
मिथ्या चैतत्कृतं सर्वं मूर्खैश्चापि प्रकीर्तितम् ..
क्व क्षेत्रं क्व प्रभावश्च कुत्र वै सन्ति देवताः .. 142 ..
16.3.m: “All this is falsely made up and proclaimed by fools! / Where is the sacred field, where is its power, and where indeed are the deities?”

16.3.s: sarvaṃ cāpi tathālīkaṃ mūḍhaiścāpi prakīrtitam .. 143 ..
16.3.d: सर्वं चापि तथालीकं मूढैश्चापि प्रकीर्तितम् .. 143 ..
16.3.m: “And it is all likewise false, proclaimed by fools!”

16.3.s:
evaṃ mūrkhā vadiṣyaṃti prahasiṣyanti cāpare ..
nārakā nāstikā lokāḥ pāpopahatacetasaḥ ..
siddhiṃ naiva prayāsyaṃti saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge..144..
16.3.d:
एवं मूर्खा वदिष्यंति प्रहसिष्यन्ति चापरे ..
नारका नास्तिका लोकाः पापोपहतचेतसः ..
सिद्धिं नैव प्रयास्यंति संप्राप्ते तु कलौ युगे..144..
16.3.m: Thus the fools will say, and others will mock. / Hell-bound, atheistic people, their minds ruined by sin, / will never attain perfection when the Kali age arrives.

16.3.s:
tīrthe caiva mṛtā ye tu śivanindāparāyaṇāḥ..
tiryagyoniprasūtāśca dṛśyante sarvayoniṣu..145..
16.3.d:
तीर्थे चैव मृता ये तु शिवनिन्दापरायणाः..
तिर्यग्योनिप्रसूताश्च दृश्यन्ते सर्वयोनिषु..145..
16.3.m: And those who die in the sacred ford, being devoted to reviling Śiva, / are seen born in animal wombs, among all types of wombs.

16.3.s:
etasmātkāraṇāddevi tīrthe caiva suduḥkhitāḥ ..
dṛśyante yugamāhātmyātsatyaśaucavivarjitāḥ .. 146 ..
16.3.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्देवि तीर्थे चैव सुदुःखिताः ..
दृश्यन्ते युगमाहात्म्यात्सत्यशौचविवर्जिताः .. 146 ..
16.3.m: For this reason, O goddess, even in the sacred ford they are seen to be deeply distressed, / devoid of truth and purity on account of the power of the age.

16.3.s:
idaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva gopane ..
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ siddhiryena sudurllabhā .. 147 ..
16.3.d:
इदं हि कारणं प्रोक्तं क्षेत्राणां चैव गोपने ..
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं सिद्धिर्येन सुदुर्ल्लभा .. 147 ..
16.3.m: This is stated as the reason for the concealment of sacred fields. / All this has been declared to you, on account of which perfection is very difficult to attain.

16.3.s:
yugeyuge tu tīrthāni kīrtitāni sureśvari ..
teṣāṃ me vallabhaṃ devi prabhāsaṃ kṣetrameva ca .. 148 ..
16.3.d:
युगेयुगे तु तीर्थानि कीर्तितानि सुरेश्वरि ..
तेषां मे वल्लभं देवि प्रभासं क्षेत्रमेव च .. 148 ..
16.3.m: In age after age sacred fords have been praised, O ruler of the gods; / among them, O goddess, the sacred field Prabhāsa is indeed dear to me.

16.3.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
kṣetrabījaṃ mahādevi kimanyatparipṛcchasi .. 149 ..
16.3.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि रहस्यं पापनाशनम् ..
क्षेत्रबीजं महादेवि किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि .. 149 ..
16.3.m: Thus this secret that destroys sin has been declared, O goddess, / the seed of the sacred field, O great goddess. What else do you ask?

16.3.s:
idaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ ye śroṣyaṃti vai kṣetramahāprabhāvam ..
te cāpi yāsyanti mama prabhāvāttriviṣṭapaṃ puṇyajanādhivāsam .. 7.1.3.150 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devīpraśnavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ .. 3 ..
16.3.d:
इदं महापातकनाशनं ये श्रोष्यंति वै क्षेत्रमहाप्रभावम् ..
ते चापि यास्यन्ति मम प्रभावात्त्रिविष्टपं पुण्यजनाधिवासम् .. 7.1.3.150 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देवीप्रश्नवर्णनं नाम तृतीयोऽध्यायः .. 3 ..
16.3.m:
Those who will listen to this great majesty of the sacred field, which destroys grave sins, / they too, by my power, shall go to heaven, the abode of the virtuous.
Thus ends the third chapter, named 'Description of the Goddess’s Question' in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the seventh part of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.
